jobs.title: Business Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Helm Operations, we build the software that keeps the world’s maritime operations moving. From tugboats in Vancouver Harbour to offshore service vessels in the North Sea, our customers rely on Helm CONNECT to manage their crews, maintenance, compliance, and day\-to\-day operations — and we don’t take that responsibility lightly.

World\-class software doesn’t happen by chance. It takes people who care deeply about quality, take ownership, collaborate effectively, and continually look for better ways to work. That’s The Helm Way, and that’s where you come in.

As Helm continues to grow internationally, Europe is a key part of our next stage of growth. **We’re looking for a Business Development Engineer based in Central Europe or the UK,** with the ability to work within relevant European business hours, who can help us expand our presence across the region by building relationships with maritime operators, uncovering operational challenges, and showing prospective customers how Helm CONNECT can make a meaningful difference in their businesses.

This is not a traditional sales role. You’ll need the curiosity to understand how maritime businesses operate, the technical confidence to have credible conversations about software and workflows, and the commercial drive to turn opportunities into long\-term customer relationships.

You’ll work closely with our Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Marketing teams to identify opportunities, develop the European market, and help more maritime organizations discover a better way to run their operations.

We’re looking for someone who is comfortable creating momentum rather than waiting for it — someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded, technically capable, and hungry to build something in a growing market.

**Your Mission**

Proactively prospect and generate new business opportunities across Europe through outbound outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels)

Qualify inbound leads and route sales\-ready prospects to the appropriate Account Executive

Book and support product demonstrations, with a quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Maintain a disciplined outreach cadence, with a benchmark of approximately 10 qualified contacts per demo booked

Research target accounts and personalize outreach to reflect regional market nuances across European sub\-regions (UK, DACH, Nordics, Southern Europe, etc.)

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of prospecting activity, pipeline status, and account information in the CRM

Collaborate closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoff of qualified opportunities and alignment on target accounts

Use AI and sales enablement tools to improve research efficiency, lead enrichment, and outreach personalization at scale

Represent Helm Operations professionally in all prospect\-facing interactions, building credibility and trust from first contact

**What Success Looks Like**

Consistently achieving the quarterly target of 30 completed demos

Generating $1–2 million in annual pipeline once fully ramped (target: incremental $500,000 for the remainder of 2026\)

Building a reliable, repeatable prospecting engine that keeps Account Executives consistently supplied with qualified opportunities

Establishing Helm as a trusted, responsive partner for prospects across the European market

**Qualifications**

Fluent in English (written and spoken)

1–3\+ years of experience in a Business Development, SDR/BDR, or similar outbound sales role, ideally in B2B SaaS

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging across different cultural and market contexts

Comfortable with high\-volume, target\-driven outbound prospecting

Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement platforms

**Bonus points if you have:**

Additional languages such as Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Italian, Portugese

Experience selling into the maritime, shipping, logistics, or industrial/technical B2B markets

Prior experience in a remote, internationally distributed sales team

Familiarity with using AI tools to support prospecting and outreach workflows

**Compensation \& Commission Structure**

Base salary: €45,000 \~ €60,000

**Commission:**

2% on Initial Sale and Professional Services (PS) revenue directly attributable to BDE\-sourced activity, excluding any PS managed by partners

€5 per qualified demo booked and attended

€40 per net\-new sales opportunity created (net\-new only; excludes upsells)

Estimated OTE: \~€57,000 at target performance (30 demos/quarter, 50% demo\-to\-opportunity conversion, 35% company win rate)

**Why You’ll Love Working at Helm**

We live by our core values:

Together We Win  
Collaboration is our superpower. We achieve more by sharing knowledge, supporting one another, and working toward common goals.

Own It  
We take initiative, follow through, and deliver on our commitments.

Care Deeply  
We care about our products, our customers, the quality of our work, and each other.

Enjoy the Ride  
We celebrate wins, learn through challenges, and make space for connection and joy along the way.

Eye of the Tiger  
We bring a healthy hunger for challenge, take proactive action, and embrace opportunities to learn and grow.

Perks and Benefits

* A 100% remote working environment.
* Flexible working hours with overlap during core business hours.
* Base salary of €45,000–€60,000 base \+ commission
* Paid vacation and your birthday off.
* Comprehensive benefits from your first day.
* Fitness reimbursement.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan eligibility after six months.
* Learning and professional development pathways.
* An inclusive culture with remote\-team activities and events.

The salary offered will depend on the successful candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market considerations. The actual salary may be higher or lower than the range posted.

Total On\-Target Earnings include base salary plus a target performance bonus.

*As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence tools to support certain stages of our recruitment process, which may include résumé screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.*

*These tools help us improve efficiency, support consistency, and enhance the candidate experience. All hiring decisions are made by qualified people, and we monitor our processes to support fairness and compliance with applicable requirements.*

Research has shown that women and members of underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed qualification.

This posting describes what we are ideally looking for, but we encourage you to apply even when you do not meet every requirement. Everyone brings different strengths and experiences, and we hire for both demonstrated capability and future potential.

Helm is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer where everyone is welcome.

Each person brings a unique story and perspective, and we believe our diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, identities, and experiences is where our greatest ideas come from.

We welcome people of all races, ethnicities, ages, religions, abilities, genders, gender identities, gender expressions, and sexual orientations. We want everyone to feel able to bring their authentic selves to work, share our values, shape our vision, drive innovation, and contribute to a culture we celebrate every day.

We sincerely thank everyone who applies. Due to the volume of applications received, we will contact candidates whose experience most closely aligns with the requirements of the role.

Job Type: Contract  
Contract length: 12 months

Pay: 45\.000,00€ \- 60\.000,00€ per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Advisor
jobs.description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------


Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi\-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  

  

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Location: Germany (Remote)**
------------------------------

**Our Team’s Vision:**
----------------------


Customer Success Advisors exist to help customers **sustain value**.


We serve as our customers’ strategic business partners, building trusted relationships that ensure they continuously realize the outcomes that drove their investment in Illumio. Through executive engagement, success planning, lifecycle management, and cross\-functional leadership, we help customers measure success, overcome business obstacles, and identify opportunities to deepen the value Illumio delivers over time.


Customer Success Advisors orchestrate the expertise of the broader Illumio organization. Working alongside Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Engineering, and our partner ecosystem, they bring together the right people at the right time to help customers achieve their business objectives. By aligning customer priorities with Illumio’s capabilities, CSAs ensure every engagement contributes to long\-term customer success.


Joining the Customer Success Advisor team means becoming part of an organization dedicated to customer advocacy, trusted partnerships, and measurable business outcomes. If you’re passionate about building executive relationships, leading through influence, coordinating across teams, and helping customers achieve lasting success, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on both our customers and Illumio’s continued growth.

**Your Impact:**
----------------


As a Customer Success Advisor (CSA), you are a critical part of the Customer Success Organization reporting to the Director of Customer Success. Your role will be directly tied to value generation for our customers, by helping them develop the right strategy to onboard, adopt, and successfully utilize Illumio's products to achieve their desired outcomes. The results of your efforts should lead to healthy, adopted, referenceable customers that achieved value\-based outcomes and are eager to expand their use of Illumio across their organization.

* Develop cross\-functional knowledge that spans IT Security, IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Application Portfolio Management practices. Your ability to partner with all teams within Illumio (like Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, Engineering, Office of the CTO) to drive a strategic roadmap for your customers will be vital to your success.
* Customer Adoption \- inspect customer adoption issues and run specific plans to increase adoption health where required to ensure that all customers are wildly successful with Illumio's platform.
* Renewals \- tie adoption health to renewal and ensure that value is being delivered. You will be expected to forecast your upcoming renewals whilst managing the process from start to finish.
* Expansion \- partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and ensure we realize the expansion sales potential within your portfolio. Identify growth opportunities in your portfolio of accounts to improve NRR (Net Retention Rate) for the company.
* Establish “trusted advisor” relationships with the executive stakeholders and technical teams on the customer side while working seamlessly with our account team to extend Illumio’s reputation and position as a vendor.
* Establish, confirm, and document the “definition of success” with the customers executive sponsors through quarterly ‘Executive Business Reviews’.
* Build a strategic roadmap for every customer that defines how they should consume and adopt Illumio’s products to meet their desired outcomes.
* Monitor the Adoption Health across all accounts within your portfolio.
* Marshall the support of our cross\-functional organization to successfully onboard a customer quickly and with the highest quality possible.
* Identify product or feature gaps, coordinate responses and timelines with the Illumio product team and successfully orchestrate their delivery.
* Capture and document Customer Use Cases, value stories, and other useful information to help contribute to, and increase the depth of our Customer Success repository.

**Your Toolkit:**
-----------------

* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, or related, customer\-facing role
* Ideally you will have worked within the Cyber Security or Enterprise SaaS space
* Proven ability to build trust and communicate effectively with C\-Suite, VP, and Director\-level contacts, along with day\-to\-day users of the platform
* Excellent communication skills verbal, written and presentation
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to set priorities and be flexible in an ever\-changing environment


\#LI\-SL1 \#LI\-REMOTE

**Our Commitment**


Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

*All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E\-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third\-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

*For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*


Compensation Range: €96K \- €120K

jobs.title: Sales Director - Fuels & Lubricants
jobs.description:
**Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.**


**Join us on the** **Sales** **team as a** **Sales Director**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. **Start your journey with Anova today!**

  


You’ll take Business Development Representative (BDR)\-sourced opportunities and run point on Enterprise and Mid\-Market deals, turning Anova’s IIoT tank\-monitoring data into a business case that drives real decisions for fuels \& lubricant distributors leadership teams. You’ll lead executive\-level discovery and value\-based presentations that quantify ROI, partnering closely with Sales Engineers on technical discovery, demos, and objection handling, and with Customer Success Managers to ensure what you sell actually delivers once it’s live.

 **Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the full sales cycle for Enterprise and Mid\-Market prospects, converting qualified opportunities sourced by the Business Development Representative (BDR) team into closed\-won business
* Land new logos across Anova’s target verticals by partnering with BDRs to qualify, develop, and advance inbound and outbound pipeline
* Make data\-driven recommendations that connect Anova’s IIoT tank\-monitoring and telemetry capabilities to each prospect’s inventory, logistics, and asset\-utilization challenges
* Lead executive\-level discovery and value\-based presentations during land and expansion phases that quantify the ROI customers will gain
* Build and manage an accurate pipeline and forecast, advancing Enterprise and Mid\-Market deals through every stage to consistently hit quota
* Kick off training and enablement with the customer (hardware, install, \& mobile apps) that the Customer Success Manager (CSM) will complete — Sales Director (SD) not responsible for training itself
* Completes tier 2 and 3 support requests if escalated by CSM
* Coordinates with Sales Engineer and/or CSM to run product demonstrations, and remove technical barriers to closing
* Maintain deep expertise in Anova’s IIoT product portfolio, competitive landscape, and industry best practices to position the platform against alternatives
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date opportunity and account data in Salesforce to support pipeline visibility and forecasting
* Finalize contract terms and pricing to close deals, partnering with Sales Engineering on data collection and integration handoff
* Build renewal plans beginning 6 months out from contract end, flagging account risks or expansion opportunities and securing renewal terms ahead of forecast
* Travel as needed to meet with prospects and customers and represent Anova at industry events

 **What you’ll need to succeed:**

  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise or mid\-market B2B sales, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
* Experience managing a full sales cycle in complex, multi\-stakeholder deals (6\+ month cycles)
* Experience with value\-based/consultative selling and delivering ROI\-driven presentations to executive\-level stakeholders
* Experience negotiating and finalizing contract terms and pricing
* Proficiency with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) for pipeline and forecast management
* Ability to travel to meet with prospects/customers and represent Anova at industry events
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering across sales engineering, customer success, or technical teams to close and grow accounts
* Self\-starter with strong time and territory management skills
* Full professional proficiency in English language, both oral and written

  


**Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Experience selling into the fuels, lubricants, or oil \& gas distribution industry
* Experience in adjacent industries such as supply chain, logistics, chemical distribution, or other industrial verticals
* Experience in IIoT, industrial technology, SaaS, or telemetry/monitoring solutions
* Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger)
* Experience owning renewal/expansion motions in addition to net\-new logo acquisition
* Adept at learning and positioning new technology hardware/cloud\-based platforms against competitive alternatives

  


**ABOUT ANOVA**



We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

  



We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

 **If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.**

  

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: Masterarbeit zum Thema Optimierung der Defect-Klassifikation und -Zusammenfassung mithilfe von Machine Learning und Generativer KI (SS27)
jobs.description:
As a family\-run, high\-tech company with nearly 19,000 employees at 71 locations worldwide, we are looking for forward thinkers with unconventional ideas and drive to join our team. Our company culture, which values collaboration and mutual trust, creates the ideal framework for boldly trying new things and questioning the status quo. Our technologies inspire people to develop and produce things that are currently unimaginable. Whether lasers, machine tools, EUV or electronics \- TRUMPF is building technological worlds for future generations. Are you ready for new challenges?


**Während des Studiums bei TRUMPF durchstarten – Innovation entdecken und Technik gestalten!**

Übernehmen Sie spannende Projekte, bringen Sie Ihre Ideen aktiv ein und arbeiten Sie eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Neben individueller Betreuung erwarten Sie zahlreiche Angebote speziell für Studierende, die Ihre persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung fördern. Sammeln Sie wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen, erweitern Sie Ihr Netzwerk und gestalten Sie mit uns die Technologien von morgen!


**Das erwartet Sie bei uns**

* Mit KI\- und ML\-Techniken wie Random Forest und SVM klassifizieren Sie Defects und verbessern die Zuverlässigkeit maschineller Clusterings
* Durch die Nutzung von GPUs und Cloud\-Diensten wie Azure ML oder Google Colab optimieren Sie die Performance von Trainings\- und Vorhersagemodellen
* Ein automatisiertes System zur Bug\-Report\-Erstellung und Verknüpfung mit Taskboards entwickeln Sie unter Verwendung generativer und erklärbarer KI
* In der Entwicklung setzen Sie moderne Tools ein, darunter C\# mit .NET 9\.0, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio 2022 oder VS Code, Docker sowie Python mit scikit\-learn, Keras oder vergleichbaren Bibliotheken
**Das bringen Sie mit**

* Ein Studium der Fachrichtung Informatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs bildet Ihre fachliche Grundlage
* Erste Erfahrungen in Machine Learning oder AI bringen Sie mit
* Grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse, vorzugsweise in Python oder C\#, runden Ihr technisches Profil ab
* Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift ergänzen Ihr Sprachprofil
* Mit analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten, einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise sowie einer schnellen Auffassungsgabe gehen Sie neue Aufgabenstellungen an
**Das bieten wir Ihnen**

* Attraktive Vergütung
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit)
* Vor Ort oder teilweise mobil nach Absprache
* Netzwerkmöglichkeiten mit anderen Studierenden
* Vergünstigtes Essen im Betriebsrestaurant
* TRUMPF Fitnessstudio und verschiedene Sportgruppen
* Gute Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel
**Ort:** Ditzingen


**Beginn:** Sommersemester 2027


**Dauer:** 6 Monate


**Haben wir Sie überzeugt?** Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen Ihre Ansprechpartnerin Sinem Ergin gerne per E\-Mail unter Sinem.Ergin.external@trumpf.com zur Verfügung. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir aus datenschutzrechtlichen Gründen keine Bewerbungen per E\-Mail annehmen dürfen. Alle unsere ausgeschriebenen Stellen sind aktuell noch zu besetzen. Auf unserer Karriereseite finden Sie alle FAQs rund um Ihre Bewerbung bei uns.

jobs.title: Supervisor Service (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Supervisor Service besteht deine wichtigste Aufgabe darin, dafür zu sorgen, dass jeder Gast unser Haus mit einem großartigen Erlebnis verlässt. Darüber hinaus bist du für die täglichen operativen Abläufe im Service verantwortlich. In dieser Funktion bist du sowohl für unsere Gäste als auch für die Mitarbeitenden die erste Ansprechperson.

**Funktionsbeschreibung**
-------------------------

* Du koordinierst das Team und arbeitest aktiv im Service mit. Dabei setzt du die richtigen Mitarbeitenden an den richtigen Stellen ein.
* Du kümmerst dich um die Personaleinsatzplanung, Dienstpläne, Zeiterfassung und bei Bedarf um Schulungen.
* Du führst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen, motivierst, coachst und schulst sie direkt am Arbeitsplatz und unterstützt sie dort, wo es nötig ist.
* Du bist für die Warenbestände und deren Kontrolle verantwortlich.
* Du bist Gastgeber bzw. Gastgeberin und sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Gäste im Restaurant von Anfang an herzlich willkommen fühlen.
* Du kümmerst dich um die Kasse und stellst sicher, dass alle Abläufe korrekt und reibungslos funktionieren.
* Du förderst die Weiterentwicklung des Teams und stärkst die Zusammenarbeit untereinander.

**Funktionsanforderungen**
--------------------------

* Als Serviceleiter / Chef de Rang verfügst du über fundierte Fachkenntnisse im Servicebereich.
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung in einer leitenden Funktion gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über gute Weinkenntnisse.
* Du bist lernbereit und möchtest die Arbeitsweise von Fletcher kennenlernen.
* Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast ein gutes Gespür für Verkauf und Gastorientierung.
* Du strebst stets nach dem bestmöglichen Ergebnis und legst großen Wert auf Qualität.
* Auch in wechselnden Situationen oder unter Zeitdruck behältst du den Überblick.
* Du wartest nicht ab, sondern ergreifst selbstständig Initiative.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in deutscher und englischer Sprache.

**Angebot**
-----------

* Ein Bruttomonatsgehalt, das deiner Ausbildung und Erfahrung entspricht.
* Wir wenden die Bedingungen gemäß dem Manteltarifvertrag für das Gaststätten\- und Hotelgewerbe des Landes Nordrhein\-Westfalen an.
* Raum für deine persönliche Entwicklung.
* Eine kostenlose Übernachtung in einem der über 115 Fletcher\-Hotels nach erfolgreichem Abschluss deiner Probezeit.
* Ein gutes Arbeitsklima mit netten Kollegen.
* Verschiedene Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.
* Das Gehalt richtet sich nach Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrem Einsatz und dem Hotel, in dem Sie tätig sind.
* Hinweis: Anfragen von Personalvermittlern im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenanzeige sind nicht erwünscht.

Hinweis: Anfragen von Personalvermittlern im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenanzeige sind nicht erwünscht.

**Wird dies Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz sein?**
------------------------------------------


Wirst du unser neuer Kollege im Fletcher Parkhotel Olsberg\-Winterberg? Wir suchen engagierte Kollegen, die unser Team an einem einzigartigen Standort mitten in Olsberg im Kneipp\-Erlebnispark verstärken möchten. Das Hotel bietet ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld für alle, die Abwechslung und Zusammenarbeit schätzen. Es sind verschiedene Stellen zu besetzen, von der Küche und dem Service bis hin zum Housekeeping, der Rezeption und der technischen Unterstützung. Bei uns bekommst du den Freiraum, deine Talente in einem eingespielten Team zu entfalten, in dem kein Tag wie der andere ist. Gemeinsam sorgen wir für ein angenehmes Erlebnis für unsere Gäste. Klingt das nach deiner neuen Herausforderung? Schau dir unsere Stellenangebote an und bewirb dich noch heute!

-------------------------------


Een baan bij Fletcher in 4 stappen  

Lijkt dit je wat? Dan kun jij een baan bij Fletcher krijgen. Solliciteer nu!* Online solliciteren op onze website  

Je eerste stap naar jouw baan bij Fletcher is een online sollicitatie. Vul je gegevens in en upload je cv.
* Beoordeling door de recruiter  

en recruiter beoordeelt je cv en motivatie en neemt contact op om je uit te nodigen voor een gesprek.
* Gesprek met jouw nieuwe collega  

Wij willen jou uiteraard graag leren kennen. Maar het is net zo belangrijk dat jij ons beter leert kennen.

Jij bent de geschikte persoon om Fletcher te versterken dus je kan starten in 1 van onze hotels.

jobs.title: Forward deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als **Forward Deployed Engineer** sitzt du mitten im Fachbereich, direkt neben den Anwendern, deren Arbeit du optimierst.


Du beobachtest Prozesse vor Ort, erkennst Potenziale, baust Lösungen mit KI\-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und begleitest sie bis in den produktiven Betrieb.
  

Nach ein paar Wochen oder Monaten zieht du weiter zum nächsten Fachbereich, an dem nächsten Standort.


Die Rolle ist neu und bewusst hybrid angelegt: ein Teil Engineering, ein Teil Prozessverständnis, ein Teil Befähigung. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Plattformteams sowie mit bestehenden Programmen wie CodeGB und dem KI\-Botschafter\-Netzwerk zusammen.


**Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Identifikation und Priorisierung von Digitalisierungspotenzialen durch Prozessbeobachtung vor Ort im Fachbereich

* Iterative Validierung und Anpassung der Lösungen im laufenden Einsatz bis zur Produktionsreife
* Überführung in den Regelbetrieb einschließlich Dokumentation, Monitoring, Datenschutz und Betriebskostenbetrachtung sowie Übergabe an die Plattformteams
* Wahrnehmung zeitlich befristeter Einsätze in wechselnden Fachbereichen und an wechselnden Standorten

==========

* Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, eines ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Fachs oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit Fullstack\-Anteil (z. B. Python, TypeScript, .NET) sowie im Umgang mit Cloud\- und Container\-Umgebungen (Azure, Kubernetes)
* Sicherer und reflektierter Umgang mit KI\-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen
* Fähigkeit, Fachprozesse schnell zu erfassen, die richtigen Fragen zu stellen und aus unscharfen Anforderungen einen tragfähigen ersten Entwurf zu machen

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

A Trust Officer is responsible for the effective administration and oversight of a portfolio of sophisticated private client fiduciary structures across multiple jurisdictions. Structures may include trusts, companies and other wealth\-holding vehicles governed by a range of applicable laws. As Trust Officer you will act as a key point of contact for clients, beneficiaries, bankers, wealth advisers, investment managers, lawyers, tax advisers and other professional intermediaries and will support senior fiduciaries and management in the delivery of a high\-quality fiduciary service.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management**

* As a Trust Officer you will be responsible for the management and administration of a portfolio of complex trust and corporate structures for multinational ultra\-high net worth client base of individuals, corporates and family offices.
* Develop, maintain and optimise professional relationships with clients, intermediaries and internal contacts through delivery of a consistent and seamless client experience to maximise client retention.
* Play a constructive role within our global business, assist the team and act as a principal day\-to\-day contact for designated clients and their professional advisers.
* Respond to client requests promptly and professionally while ensuring that requests are considered from the perspective of the trustee's fiduciary responsibilities.
* Coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to deliver a seamless client experience.
* Identify significant changes in client circumstances and ensure that potential fiduciary, tax, legal, regulatory or reputational implications are appropriately considered and escalated.




* Maintain the highest level of trust and company administration to minimise business risk and to adhere to a culture of compliance with policies and appropriate risk management.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Work collaboratively with wealth advisors, bankers and peers to ensure adherence to policies and procedures while delivering a seamless client experience.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Ensure structures are administered in accordance with applicable governing documents, laws and regulations and J.P. Morgan policies, procedures and controls.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written required. Confident when dealing with clients and professionals.
* Ability to work under pressure to achieve deadlines and meet client and business expectations.
* Ability to analyze trust documents for legal, tax, administrative and investment issues and coordinate delivery of services.
* Oversee investment decisions including working with investment advisors. Ensure that the Trust investment objective is appropriate for the needs of the Trust and applicable fiduciary law. Ensure the Trust is compliant with its investment guidelines / mandate.
* Ensure compliance with all local and international anti\-money laundering and Know you Customer requirements.
* Assist with the onboarding of new clients in partnership with Wealth Advisors and the New Business Team.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching and support to Trust Officers and junior team members and review work where appropriate.
* Maintain high standards of client service while ensuring that fiduciary independence, governance and control requirements are consistently maintained.




**Qualifications and Experience**

* Significant experience in private client trust and fiduciary administration, preferably involving complex and internationally connected structures. Minimum 7 years of experience in the roll.
* Strong understanding of trusts, companies and other private wealth structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Sound understanding of fiduciary principles, governance, AML/KYC and risk management requirements.
* Degree or equivalent professional qualification preferred plus STEP qualification.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with sophisticated clients, advisors and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities and identify matters requiring escalation.
* Strong commitment to J.P. Morgan's standards of integrity, risk management, controls and client service.

jobs.title: Frontend React Engineer with .NET knowledge
jobs.description:
**Build Next\-Gen Transportation Logistics Tech: Front\-End React Engineer**


Are you ready to build high\-impact production UIs from scratch using modern React, TypeScript, and AI\-augmented tools? Join a modern engineering environment where you will replace a legacy desktop application with a fast, browser\-based React experience, shipping functional software directly to energy dispatchers every single week!

**About Us:**  

Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.

  

Trimble Transportation provides the mobility, enterprise, and visibility tools that move freight across North America. Our TMW Suite TMS platform is the backbone of dispatch operations for energy carriers — managing orders, dispatch, tank readings, pricing, and delivery for bulk fuel and petroleum logistics.

  

Right now, we’re doing something our customers have been waiting for: replacing the legacy Windows desktop application (Suite Dispatch TMS) with a modern, browser\-based experience that dispatchers can access from anywhere. This is a greenfield React build, not a reskin. We’re building the next\-generation TMW Suite Dispatch UI from scratch, shipping 7 screens in 18 months, and going live with real dispatchers on June 1 2027\.

**Here’s what you’d be doing day to day:**  

You’ll be embedded in one of four pair\-squads (2 developers \+ 1 embedded generalist), building production React screens that fuel dispatchers will use to run their daily operations. Each squad owns specific screens end\-to\-end from data service integration through UI polish and Playwright testing. Every Friday, your squad demos working software to stakeholders. No spec theater, no sprint reviews six weeks from now. Weekly demos, weekly accountability, weekly progress.  

The architecture is straightforward: your React UI talks to CloudHub (a tenant\-routing gateway), which dispatches to a per\-tenant OData API, which connects through a CloudHub Connector (CHC) to the customer’s on\-prem SQL database. You’re building a fast, reliable, accessible front\-end that makes fuel dispatchers more efficient.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* Build Production React Screens: Own screens end\-to\-end: data service layer, Redux state management, UI components, and Playwright \+ axe\-core tests. Build responsive layouts (1280/1440/1920px) using MUI X DataGrid, Trimble Maps SDK, and the team’s shared design system
* Update and Enhance the Backend Services: Integrate with the CloudHub/OData/CHC API stack, wire up real data from customer SQL databases through the tenant\-routing gateway. Create new services to ensure the new React screens provide the same functionality as the existing Fuel Dispatch on premise application.
* Ship Working Software Weekly: Demo functional, tested features every Friday \- not mockups, not prototypes, not slide decks. Pair with your squad’s embedded generalist on PR reviews, accessibility checks, and test coverage. Maintain CI/CD discipline: main is always deployable, PRs are feature\-scoped, weekly tags cut for demos.
* Solve Real Dispatcher Problems: Build drag\-and\-drop planning interfaces, real\-time map synchronization, threshold\-based alerting, and inline validation engines. Optimize for dispatcher workflows: keyboard navigation, WCAG accessibility, loading skeletons, and error states that tell users what went wrong and what to do next. Performance\-tune data grids for large datasets with server\-side pagination and column virtualization.
* AI\-Augmented Development: Use Cursor and AI coding assistants to accelerate development, generate test scaffolding, and refactor code. Contribute to the team’s shared patterns and component library as the design system evolves.

**Our Tech Stack:**

* the app scaffold React \+ TypeScript \+ Vite
* sortable, filterable, server\-paginated grids MUI X DataGrid
* live truck/station pins, route visualization, bidirectional map\-grid sync Trimble Maps SDK
* shared state across screens (orders, dispatch status, planner sync) Redux Toolkit
* E2E and accessibility testing in CI Playwright \+ axe\-core

 the API layer (tenant routing per\-tenant OData on\-prem connector* SQL) CloudHub / OData / CHC
* authentication via token forwarding Trimble Identity SSO
* daily development tooling, not optional Cursor / AI assistants
* source control and CI/CD GitHub \+ GitHub Actions

**Your Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* 3\+ years building production React applications with TypeScript — not tutorials, not side projects, production apps that real users depend on
* Strong component architecture: you think in composable, testable components with clean prop contracts and proper state management
* Experience with data\-heavy UIs: grids, tables, filters, server\-side pagination, real\-time updates
* Comfort with REST/OData API integration — you’ve wired up front\-ends to real backends and debugged the full request/response chain
* CSS/styling proficiency: responsive layouts, design system integration, consistent cross\-browser rendering
* Git workflow fluency: trunk\-based development, feature branches, clean commit history, PR reviews
* Ability to work in a pair\-squad model — tight collaboration with one other developer and an embedded generalist, shipping weekly

**Bonus Points for:**

* Drag\-and\-drop implementation experience (dnd\-kit, react\-beautiful\-dnd, or similar)
* Experience with AI coding assistants Cursor in daily development workflows
* Familiarity with MUI (Material UI) component library and theming
* Previous experience modernizing legacy desktop applications into browser\-based UIs
* Background in .NET/C\# OData APIs (helpful for debugging the API layer)
* Logistics, transportation, or energy industry domain knowledge you understand what a dispatcher does and why their screen matters

  

Location: UK, Remote

**Why You'll Enjoy Working With Us:**

* At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact.
* We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data\-driven insights that reduce waste.
* Collaborate with like\-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

  

React, TypeScript, Front\-End Engineer, Software Developer, Redux, Material UI, Playwright, Greenfield, Transportation, Logistics

 **How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**


At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.


Candidate Privacy Notices by Country

jobs.title: Staff .Net Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Reapit – Who are we?**


Reapit is the original end\-to\-end business technology provider for estate agencies of all sizes. We’ve been helping sales and lettings agents build relationships and grow their businesses for more than 25 years.


Our technology empowers property professionals across Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand to work with buyers, sellers, tenants, and landlords to deliver a dream home experience.


Worldwide, over 100,000 agents across more than 15,000 branches use Reapit to run their businesses, manage properties, collect rent, engage clients, and provide outstanding customer service every time.

**What you’ll be doing**


Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you’ll operate as a highly senior, technically hands\-on backend engineer, embedded into a squad and owning delivery of substantive, cloud\-native services end\-to\-end. Ad\-hoc client interaction, supporting requirements discovery and technical solutioning where needed.

* Architecting, building and shipping complex, high\-performance distributed services in C\# and .NET Core 8/9 – primarily serverless on AWS Lambda – setting the technical bar for the squad and owning delivery of substantive feature sets end\-to\-end.
* Designing data models and persistence patterns across Aurora RDS MySQL and DynamoDB – picking the right tool for the workload, tuning for performance at scale, and modelling for both transactional and high\-throughput access patterns.
* Building resilient, event\-driven systems with SQS and related AWS messaging primitives – idempotency, retries, dead\-letter handling, and clean separation of concerns across services.
* Owning each feature’s solution end\-to\-end – partnering with Business Analysts who capture high\-level problems and workflows, then driving product thinking, scoping, trade\-offs and delivery yourself.
* Leveraging Claude Code and advanced agentic workflows at pace – orchestrating sub\-agents, managing context, running parallel workstreams and embedding AI\-native engineering patterns into everyday delivery.
* Designing clean, well\-versioned, well\-documented APIs that other engineers enjoy consuming – treating developer experience and contract stability as first\-class concerns.
* Inputting into architecture and technical direction in collaboration with Principal Engineers – making considered, well\-reasoned decisions on service boundaries, data design, messaging patterns, consistency guarantees and performance.
* Championing a high\-quality engineering culture – test coverage, peer review, CI/CD discipline via GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code, secure coding, observability and performance – aligned to the Reapit Global Technology Strategy, Reapit Connect and agentic tooling.
* Mentoring and up\-levelling engineers around you through pairing, PR review, architectural guidance and practical coaching on AI\-assisted development.

**Who we’re looking for**


At Reapit, we prioritise hiring individuals who share our values and possess the right attitudes and behaviours for success.


Whilst all the listed qualities are desirable, don’t worry if you don’t meet all of them, we’d still like to hear from you.

* A proven senior\-to\-staff\-level backend engineer with deep, current expertise in C\# and .NET Core 8/9 – you can architect and lead design of distributed REST API microservices at scale.
* Authority in AWS serverless architecture – Lambda\-first, with strong working knowledge of API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge and IAM, and a track record of shipping production workloads on this stack.
* Deep data expertise across Aurora RDS MySQL and DynamoDB – complex schema and access\-pattern design, query tuning, indexing, single\-table vs multi\-table trade\-offs, and a pragmatic view on consistency, scaling and cost.
* Proven track record designing event\-driven systems with SQS (and adjacent AWS messaging) – idempotency, ordering, retries, dead\-letter handling and operational robustness.
* Strong API design sensibility – versioning, documentation, throttling, backwards compatibility and an obsession with the developer experience of the services you own.
* A strong product brain. You’re comfortable operating without a traditional Product Owner – partnering with BAs on high\-level problems, then making sensible product trade\-offs, prioritising ruthlessly and owning the solution through to delivery.
* Strong communication skills and comfortable with ad\-hoc client interaction – able to join a requirement or technical solutioning session, ask the right questions, and translate outcomes into shippable work.
* A proven track record with Claude Code and advanced agentic workflows – you can evidence shipping real work via multi\-agent patterns, orchestrating sub\-agents, managing context, defining custom commands/skills and scaling AI\-assisted delivery across a team.
* Rigorous engineering standards – fluency with Git\-based workflows, trunk\-based development, CI/CD (ideally GitHub Actions), Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK or Terraform), comprehensive testing (unit, integration and contract), and a genuine commitment to observability, performance and secure\-by\-default coding.
* Technical leadership without the title – a track record of lifting teams through pairing, mentoring, PR review and example, rather than through line\-management.
* A pragmatic, outcome\-oriented mindset – biased to shipping, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to make sensible calls on scope, technical debt and sequencing under time pressure.
* Nice to have: hands\-on experience with OpenSearch and/or AWS AppSync – both feature in our stack and would accelerate time\-to\-value, but neither is essential.

**What your impact and success looks like**


As a Backend Engineer we expect your success and impact over the stages of your contract with us to look something like this:

**Within 1 month:**

* Fully onboarded onto the Reapit stack – Reapit Connect, the relevant .NET services and AWS environments – shipped first production endpoints and / or services.
* Established trusted working relationships with the Director of Engineering, Principal Engineers, Business Analysts and the relevant squad.
* Configured Claude Code and our approved agentic tooling to our internal standards, and started running meaningful work through multi\-agent patterns.
* Built a clear, independent view of the target services, data model, database schemas, messaging topology and immediate delivery priorities – and surfaced any early risks or recommendations.

**Within 3 months:**

* Owning end\-to\-end delivery of substantive services – taking from BA\-level problem statement through to production on Lambda, Aurora and DynamoDB, with you driving the product trade\-offs as well as the engineering.
* Recognised as a go\-to technical voice within the squad – inputting into architectural decisions alongside Principal Engineers, raising the quality bar on PRs, and unblocking complex backend, data and messaging problems.
* Meaningfully influenced our wider engineering practice – patterns you’ve introduced for agentic delivery, Claude Code usage, serverless design or data modelling.
* Shipped APIs and services that are visibly well\-designed, well\-documented and performant – other engineers find them pleasant to consume, and they hold up under production load.
* Left a well\-documented, well\-tested, maintainable footprint – so that whether the contract is extended or handed over, the work continues to deliver value without you in the room.

**What’s in it for you?**


We operate a Flexible Working Policy and there is no expectation around in\-person attendance, beyond occasional ad\-hoc project meetings in our Solihull or London offices.


You can expect an industry competitive day rate, available on request.

**Don’t tick all the boxes? Neither do we**


We care about our industry and want it to become a more inclusive and diverse place to work. So, we’re driven by hiring not only by experience and relevance for the role but by sharing our values and the right attitudes and behaviours for success.


We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.


We feel we have an empowering environment where everyone is supported and respected, and we want you to feel this too. We welcome new ideas, thinking and approaches, whilst listening to all our employees.

To undertake decontamination science duties in providing a specialized decontamination of medical devices service contributing to the clinical care of the patient \- to carry out the receipt, disassembly, cleaning, reassembly, packing and sterilization of reusable medical devices and record all tasks in the tracking and tracing database.
  
  

To ensure that all products manufactured in the Decontamination Services department within the Trust are fit for purpose and produced in a timely and efficient manner in accordance with the Quality Manager System (QMS) relevant to the area and to work as part of a team and undertake duties as directed by the management team of the Trusts decontamination facilities.
  
  

To work in all areas of the decontamination facilities at both hospitals (Chelsea and Westminster Hospital) and weekend as and when required
  
  

1\. To reprocess reusable medical devices, disassemble, clean, disinfect, check, assemble, sterilize, dispatch and track in a controlled environment.
  
  

2\. To work in accordance with Departmental Policy, Standard Operating Procedures and Quality Management System.
  
  

3\. Report any discrepancies to the team leader immediately.
  
  

4\. Complete the relevant documents for any non\-conformances.
  
  

5\. To contribute to ensuring that quality assurance and production controls systems are maintained in accordance with standard work instructions.
  
  

6\. To provide a collection and delivery service to the Decontamination Departments' customers
  
  

7\. To inform the Decontamination Technician Supervisors of any raw material shortages and ensure stock is rotated.

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

1\. To undertake initial investigation into non\-conformances reports as instructed
  
  

2\. To use manual dexterity and concentration for the disassembly and reassembly of the reusable medical devices in accordance with Manufacturer’s instructions
  
  

3\. To operate decontamination equipment and carry out routine tests in accordance with the Planned Preventative Maintenance Schedules, Quality Standards and Guidance
  
  

4\. Attend regular departmental team meetings.
  
  

5\. To attend any training as required.
  
  

6\. To undertake duties consistent with the responsibility of the grade and needs of the service

jobs.title: ACA Graduate Programme - Starting March 2027
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**Overview**  

We are Dixon Wilson is a specialist firm of accomplished accountancy and tax advisors, offering a bespoke and personal service to private clients – their families, trusts and businesses. Determined problem solvers since 1888, we are proud to be an independent firm. Proactive, curious, and nimble – this is Dixon Wilson through and through. Our heritage is important to us. What we’ve learnt from our past we bring with us to create our future.  

  

**Who we are**
As a ﬁrm, we depend on having great people. People who are able to solve the complex challenges of our clients, and keep up with the pace of how we operate. People who guide our purpose by demonstrating three important values that sit at our core, Seek the solution, Solve together, Be curious.

As people are at the heart of what we do, we place a strong emphasis on ensuring our staff enjoy the work they do to remain happy, engaged and motivated.

The variety and range of clients we deal with results in plenty of interesting and varied work across accounts, audit and tax. There is ample opportunity to be exposed to new challenges.

We have 15 Partners and approximately 180 employees in total. The technical expertise of our partners and staff is outstanding. This is supported by the number of industry and professional prizes awarded to the firm and staff.

With over 60 trainees at varying stages of a training programme the firm recognises the importance of life beyond learning. Our active social committee, with the support from our partners, delivers a wide range of social and charitable activities such as our annual charity poker night, chess evenings, monthly drinks, netball, cricket and tennis to name a few! These events are a great way to get to know colleagues at all levels.  

Our office in London, occupying the ground, upper floors and roof terrace of a modern development on Chancery Lane, is an impressive and enjoyable location to work with views across the city.### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **ACA Training Contract**
A three\-year ACA training contract with Dixon Wilson offers the following:* **All\-round experience:** Our provision of tax, accountancy and advisory services to high net worth private clients, including their families, trusts and businesses means that your work will be challenging and varied. Be it micro accounts, very large accounts, trusts, partnerships, personal and company tax returns, as well as audits, you will learn from, and collaborate with, experienced colleagues to grow your skills and knowledge.
* **Clear progression pathway and a supportive environment:** Our ACA graduate programme is well structured and you’ll have a clear progression pathway throughout and beyond. It has been designed to ensure you grow your technical abilities, learn from experiences and build the personal and professional skills you need to progress. Many of our senior staff and partners trained at Dixon Wilson and will be there to guide you through.

**What we look for:**  

Aside from our online assessment results, we look for:  

* Candidates with an **achieved 2\.1 or higher and 120 UCAS points minimum** (300 points under the old UCAS system)
* Good **numeracy skills**
* Strong listening, written and oral **communication skills**
* A **collaborative, team player** attitude
* **Adaptability** when exposed to new situations and scenarios
* A genuine **interest in pursuing a career in accountancy**
* An **aptitude to deliver** a first\-class professional service to our clients
* The **ability to balance the demands** of work and succeed in professional examinations
* **A curious mind** and an **eagerness to learn**
* **Solution oriented** and enjoys problem solving

  

Our three\-year graduate programme will recognise, reward and nurture your talent. Within an inclusive culture that values collaboration, learning, and a commitment to problem solving.  

  

If you believe that you have the required qualities and commitment, please apply now to start with us in March 2027 \- we welcome and look forward to your application.  

  

If successful, applicants must be available to start on 22 March 2027; if you are unable to commit to that start date, please wait and apply for the next intake which begins in August 2027\.  

  

When submitting your application please also upload copies of your degree and A Level (or equivalent) certificate(s) or transcript. Alternatively, email copies to careers@dixonwilson.co.uk  

  

Please note closing date: 31 October 2026, however this role may close earlier than 31 October 2026 if all positions are filled.### **About Dixon Wilson**


**Founded in 1888, Dixon Wilson is one of the leading firms of Chartered Accountants. Our office is based on Chancery Lane in the City of London.**  

  

We specialise in the provision of tax, accountancy and advisory services to high net worth private clients, including their families, trusts and businesses. We are proud of our longstanding independence and have avoided any change that would compromise the service we provide to our clients. As a result we are highly regarded both within and without the profession. A significant part of our business spans the corporate world, and increasingly has an international dimension.

**Date:** 11 Sept 2026


**Location:** London, TfL Corporate


**Company:** TfL, GLA or OPDC



**Job title:** SHE Environment Manager

**Grade:** Band 3
  

**Contract type:** TfL
  

**Reference:** 5670
  

**Team:** Corporate Environment
  

**Contract details:** 12 month FTC (possibility of becoming permanent subject to business requirements and approval)
  

**Location:** Palestra /hybrid

  

**Application closing date:** 23rdSeptember @23\.59

  

Please Note: We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a high volume of applications; therefore, we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

  

*All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.*

*Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a 4\-week period.**Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements****.***

  

**About the Role**


Transport for London is seeking an experienced Energy and Carbon professional to join the Sustainability, Energy and Carbon team on a 12\-month fixed\-term contract or secondment.


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering TfL's Net Zero ambitions and supporting the decarbonisation of one of the UK's largest and most complex organisations.


As TfL continues its journey towards net zero operations, this role will help shape the strategic direction of energy and carbon initiatives across the business. Working with a wide range of stakeholders, you will lead and support programmes focused on reducing energy consumption, lowering carbon emissions, improving energy efficiency, and driving sustainable outcomes across TfL's operational estate.

  

**What You'll Be Doing**


* Leading the development and delivery of energy and carbon reduction initiatives across TfL.
* Supporting decarbonisation programmes for buildings and operational assets.
* Identifying opportunities to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.
* Analysing energy and carbon data to inform decision\-making and drive performance improvements.
* Providing expert advice on energy management, sustainability and carbon reduction.
* Working closely with procurement teams to embed environmental requirements into contracts and supplier relationships.
* Building strong relationships across the business to influence positive environmental change.
* Supporting the delivery of TfL's wider environmental and sustainability objectives.
  

**About You**


We're looking for a motivated and knowledgeable energy and carbon specialist with a proven track record of delivering sustainability initiatives within a large and complex organisation.

  

**Essential Experience**


* Experience developing and delivering energy efficiency and decarbonisation programmes.
* Experience in energy and carbon reporting, monitoring and target setting.
* Experience providing technical advice on energy and carbon matters to a range of stakeholders.
* Experience working on projects that reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions.
* Experience supporting organisational change and influencing stakeholders.
  

**Essential Knowledge**


* Strong understanding of energy management and energy efficiency best practice.
* Knowledge of carbon management and decarbonisation strategies.
* Understanding of climate change, UK energy policy, and the challenges associated with achieving net zero.
  

**Essential Skills**


* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong project management and organisational capabilities.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
  

**Why Join Us?**


This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to London's environmental future. You'll work on high\-profile decarbonisation initiatives, influence strategic decisions, and play a key role in helping TfL achieve its ambitious net zero targets.

  

**Application Process**


* Please apply using your CV only
* Think carefully about the skills, knowledge and experience in the advert and cover this in your CV
* PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images
  

**Equality, diversity and inclusion**


We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve. We believe that a diverse workforce enables us to deliver better services and outcomes. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. As a Disability Confident Leader, we actively encourage applications from disabled people. As part of the Disability Confident scheme, we aim to offer an assessment or interview to candidates who apply via the scheme where the minimum essential criteria for skills, knowledge and experience has been met. In some circumstances, it may not be practical to offer an interview or assessment to every candidate who applies through the scheme and meet the minimum essential criteria; in these situations, we select candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job rather than interviewing all who meet them.


Across all recruitment activity, we recognise that selection methods may vary depending on the nature and scale of the campaign and will be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately in line with our Disability Confident commitments.
  

  

**Benefits**


In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:  

  



* Final salary pension scheme
* Free travel for you on the TfL network
* Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home
* 30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays
* TfL is committed to work\-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow
* Private healthcare discounted scheme Tax\-efficient cycle\-to\-work programme
  

Retail, health, leisure and travel offers
* Discounted Eurostar travel

We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

  

**Vetting Process**


At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our\-vetting\-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

As a Housekeeper, you will be a valued member of the ward team, helping to ensure a positive experience for patients, families and staff through the delivery of high\-quality non\-clinical support services. You will take responsibility for coordinating ward supplies and maintaining stock levels, ensuring clinical and non\-clinical areas remain organised, safe and operationally ready.
  
  

You will work closely with colleagues across nursing, midwifery and support services to help maintain a clean, welcoming and well\-maintained environment, supporting infection prevention standards and the efficient running of the ward.
  
  

The role requires excellent organisational and communication skills, attention to detail, the ability to prioritise workload and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. You will also support meal service provision, monitor environmental standards, escalate maintenance concerns and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  
  

This is an important role for someone who is approachable, reliable and committed to delivering an excellent experience for women, babies and their families while supporting the safe and effective delivery of care.

**Why Riverside?**  

At Riverside, we’re a housing association with a difference – enhancing the everyday for all our customers. For 90 years, we’ve been revitalising neighbourhoods and supporting communities by providing the homes they need to live full, fulfilling and rewarding lives.
  

We have a portfolio of over 75,000 affordable residential and retirement homes across the UK. Our work ranges from homelessness services to social care, employment support to retirement living, and we need the best people on board to help us.
  

  

Working with us, you’ll enjoy:
  

* Competitive pay \& generous pension
* 28 days holidays plus bank holidays
* Flexible working options available
* Investment in your learning, personal development and technology
* A wide range of benefits

  

**Diversity and Inclusion at Riverside:**  

We are inclusive. At Riverside, we value diversity in all its forms. We foster a workplace where all individuals are respected, empowered, and heard. Our commitment to inclusivity drives our success and enriches the lives of our customers and colleagues.
  

  

Riverside is a Disability Confident Employer and operates a Guaranteed Interview Scheme for any applicant who declares they have a disability. If the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the role (as set out in the role profile and/or person specification) they will be guaranteed an interview.
  

  

**Applications may close before the deadline, so please apply early to be considered.**  

  

**Role Profile**  

* Support the delivery of the Group’s Climate Responsibility Strategy and Healthy Homes Plan.
* Coordinate the management of Riverside’s externally owned solar photovoltaic (PV) portfolio and act as the primary point of contact for managing agents. Liaise with customers, colleagues, contractors and managing agents to support enquiries, secure timely access arrangements, and facilitate maintenance activities. Maintain accurate records, correspondence and activity logs, ensuring that actions, access arrangements and outcomes are appropriately documented and evidenced in accordance with organisational procedures.
* Coordinate and promote continuing professional development (CPD) opportunities on sustainability\-related topics across the organisation, supporting colleagues to develop the knowledge and skills required to contribute to Riverside's sustainability objectives.
* Answer energy\-related enquiries and requests effectively, providing clear, supportive and accurate advice, action or signposting, and escalating complex queries through the appropriate channels to ensure effective resolution.
* Maintain accurate records using appropriate systems and databases, ensuring data integrity and quality so that regular analysis and reporting can be completed as required.
* Assist with the management and reporting of budgets, including processing payments and ensuring Asset Management expenditure is managed in line with the Group’s financial controls.
* Assist in the management and resolution of customer complaints.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and procedures.
* Ensure requirements and proposed solutions are captured effectively during meetings, and follow up with attendees to confirm that they are clearly understood and align with business processes, standards and service quality.
* Monitor implementation progress, report on risks and keep relevant reporting lines updated.
* Support sustainability colleagues in the development, delivery and monitoring of projects, including undertaking research.

**Areas may include:**  

* Retrofit, including energy efficiency measures, funding streams and data analytics
* Energy efficiency advice and affordability
* Climate resilience, Biodiversity and nature\-based recovery solutions
* Electric vehicle charging and fleet decarbonization
* Sustainability reporting and metrics, including SECR, and ESG reporting
* Sustainable procurement and supply chain sustainability measures and carbon emissions
* Net zero carbon in new and existing homes
* Renewable energy and low carbon heating systems
* Healthy and Modern Homes
* Indoor air quality, including damp and mould issues and ventilation measures and strategies
* Hazard prevention in homes
* Liaise effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers,colleauges and third party suppliers providing advice ,support and building constructive working relationships.
* Ensure effective communication and engagement activities are delivered to key stakeholders, with progress updates and key messages communicated regularly.
* Carry out research to support self\-development and increase understanding across the business of innovative products and procedures, the impact of new and upcoming policy, and changes in the operating environment.
* Use this insight to contribute to the development, review and effective application of sustainability policies and procedures, identifying where changes are required in response to legislation, policy updates, or customer and stakeholder needs.
* Contribute to the production of accurate and timely reports for key stakeholders.
* Respond flexibly to changes in work priorities and undertake other duties as required to support the effective operation of the service.
* Ensure data protection requirements are met in accordance with Group policy, procedures and statutory requirements.
* Ensure health and safety requirements are met in accordance with Group policy, procedures and statutory requirements.

**Person specification**  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**  

**Essential**  

* Knowledge of, or an interest in, sustainability, construction, renewable energy, housing or a related sector.
* A relevant qualification, or working towards a qualification, in sustainability, environmental management, housing, construction or a related discipline.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to understand customer needs, resolve issues and identify practical solutions that deliver positive outcomes.
* A personal commitment to diversity, treating others with dignity and respect, with a genuine desire to understand and meet diverse customer needs and aspirations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Able to build positive working relationships with colleagues and customers, including the ability to persuade and influence others.
* An excellent team player who can work flexibly to meet business requirements.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Academic or practical working knowledge of at least one of the sustainability areas listed above or a willingness to learn

**Desirable**  

* Experience of supporting the delivery of a corporate sustainability strategy across a large and varied portfolio of assets.
* Understanding of building physics.Experience of using a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems
* Proficient in analysing and evaluating complex information, measuring the impact of initiatives, developing appropriate strategies and action plans, and presenting findings clearly to a range of audiences.
* Knowledge of EPCs, retrofit, renewable energy or net zero programmes
