JOB DETAILS
  
  

**JOB BAND:** D
  
**CONTRACT TYPE:** Permanent, Full\-time
  
**DEPARTMENT:** BBC Studios Creative Services
  
**LOCATION:** London Television Centre – Hybrid
  
**PROPOSED SALARY RANGE:** Up to £55,000 plus £5,441 London Weighting depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights.
  
  

WE ARE BBC STUDIOS
  
  

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute the world’s most sought\-after TV, audio and digital content.
  
  

Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining, and inspiring stories for people all around the world.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
Join BBC.com as a Senior Designer and play a key role in shaping the creative direction of its growing international subscription business. You'll lead the development of impactful brand and campaign creative across digital channels, combining strategic thinking with hands\-on design execution. Working closely with editorial, marketing, product and UX teams, you'll create audience\-focused campaigns, champion brand excellence and help drive subscription growth on a global scale.
  
  

WHY JOIN THE TEAM
  
This is a unique opportunity to influence how millions of people discover and engage with BBC content around the world. You'll work at the intersection of creativity, storytelling and digital product growth, collaborating with talented multidisciplinary teams on high\-profile campaigns. With exposure to strategic decision\-making, stakeholder leadership and brand development, it's an ideal role for a Senior Designer’s next step.
  
  

**YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT:**  

Lead the creation of high\-quality design and campaign assets across web, social, CRM, paid media and subscription marketing channels.
  
Develop compelling creative concepts and visual storytelling that drive audience acquisition, engagement, retention and subscription growth.
  
Champion and evolve BBC brand standards, ensuring consistency and excellence across all customer touchpoints.
  
Partner with editorial, marketing, product, UX and growth teams to translate insights and objectives into effective creative solutions.
  
Manage multiple creative projects from concept through to delivery, ensuring quality, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  
Build strong stakeholder relationships, presenting creative work confidently and influencing decision\-making through expert design guidance.
  
Provide day\-to\-day leadership, mentoring and direction to the Motion Designer, helping to maintain high creative standards across the team.
  
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
  
  

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**  

Significant experience in a Senior Designer, Graphic Designer or Brand Design role, ideally within media, publishing, digital products, subscription businesses or content\-led brands.
  
A strong portfolio showcasing branding, campaign development, digital marketing and visual storytelling.
  
Expert knowledge of design principles, including typography, layout, visual hierarchy, photography and brand systems.
  
Proven experience creating high\-performing creative assets across digital channels, including web, social, CRM and paid media.
  
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with experience working within digital\-first environments.
  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, present ideas and build effective working relationships across multiple teams.
  
Experience leading projects and supporting, mentoring or coaching junior creatives.
  
  

**DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:**  

Experience working within subscription, membership or audience growth\-focused businesses.
  
Basic motion graphics knowledge and an understanding of animation\-led creative.
  
Experience using AI\-powered creative tools and emerging technologies to enhance workflows and output.
  
Understanding of digital products, UX principles and performance marketing.
  
Experience contributing to the evolution of brand systems and creative frameworks.
  
Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance brand, audience and business objectives.
  
Passion for storytelling, journalism and creating work that reaches global audiences.
  
  

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
  
  

Please include a link to your portfolio as part of your application.
  
  

We appreciate your interest in this position and understand how important this opportunity is to you. Due to the high volume of interest we may need to close the application period earlier than anticipated. This step is necessary to ensure we can provide a high level of attention and service to all applicants. Thank you for your understanding.
  
  

\#BBCSTUDIOS

**Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages**

**Location: Buxton, Derbyshire**

**Permanent, Full Time**

**Salary:** **£34,231 per annum (Inclusive of shift allowance)**

**Shift pattern: 4 on 4 off (2 days, 2 nights)**

 **Some of our fantastic benefits**

  

* Comprehensive pension scheme – up to 12% employer contribution
* Potential, discretionary annual bonus
* Generous holiday entitlement
* A focus on professional development and growth

  

Are you ready to kick\-start your career in the world of logistics? We have the perfect entry\-level position for aspiring logistics professional.

  

We are looking for Logistics Operators to join our dedicated logistics department at our Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages site in Buxton, Derbyshire.

  

At Nestlé Waters \& Premium Beverages, we believe water is the natural choice for healthy hydration: good for our bodies and good for the planet. So, we make it easy for consumers to enjoy natural source waters and our range of water products enhanced with other natural ingredients. In everything we do, we work hard to protect the purity nature brings; from taking care of the environment that our waters are sourced from, to accelerating our pathway to net zero carbon and managing our business sustainably into the future.

  

We take pride in championing inclusion and diversity. We proudly signed the Business in the Community Race at Work Charter, are committed to Disability Confidence, and have been recognised as a Times Top 50 Employer for gender equality for three consecutive years. Additionally, we are a headline partner of Diversity and Inclusion in grocery.

 **Your Impact**

  

As a Logistics Operator, you will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient and accurate handling of goods within our logistics operations. Your primary responsibility will be to support the flow of materials and products through various processes, contributing to the overall success of our supply chain. You will be expected to uphold safety and quality standards while demonstrating a commitment to continuous improvement.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Safety Compliance:** Ensure high safety standards are adhered to maintain a safe working environment.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Follow inbound and outbound schedules by retrieving, marshalling, and loading pallets according to defined procedures.
* **Material Handling:** Load or unload trailers by operating suitable material handling equipment through loading docks or bays.
* **Support for Production:** Assist with factory activities to achieve key performance indicators, such as delivering packaging materials to the production line in a timely manner.
* **Quality Assurance**: Ensure high quality and good manufacturing practices are met by effectively carrying out the daily cleaning plan as per defined procedures.

 **Your ingredients for success**

  

We welcome individuals with a passion for logistics and a willingness to learn and grow in an automated warehouse. No prior experience is required, making this role ideal for those eager to develop their skills within warehousing and logistics.

 **Key Skills and Experience:**

* **Teamwork and Communication:** Excellent teamwork and communication skills are necessary to collaborate effectively with colleagues and support overall operational goals.
* **Safety Standards Experience:** Experience working towards safety standards is important to ensure a safe working environment for all team members.
* **Performance Target Achievement:** The ability to work towards performance targets and contribute to the efficiency of logistics operations is essential for success in this role.
* **Attention to Detail:** Strong attention to detail and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment are crucial for maintaining high standards in logistics operations.
* **Qualifications \& Training:** Ability to operate all required material handling equipment, including Forklift Trucks (e.g., Reach Truck, Counterbalance, T20\). If no license is held, in\-house training will be provided. A relevant qualification in logistics, supply chain, or a similar subject is desirable but not essential.

 **What you need to know**

  

Advert closing date: Friday 25/09/2026\.

  

We will be considering candidates as they apply and we will occasionally close job advertisements early in the event we receive sufficient applicants, so please don’t delay in submitting your application.

  

At Nestlé, our values are rooted in respect, and we believe that embracing diversity and fostering an inclusive environment allows everyone to reach their full potential and drives innovative thinking. We strongly encourage applications from individuals of all gender identities, ethnic backgrounds, those with disabilities, parents, carers and members of the LGBT\+ community. Please let us know if we can provide accommodations to ensure your full participation in the application process.

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

ScottishPower’s RIIO\-T3 Business Plan is a £12 billion investment to upgrade and expand the electricity transmission network across Central and Southern Scotland from 2026 to 2031\. This exciting investment plan aims to connect up to 19GW of clean energy, support over 11,000 jobs, and accelerate the UK’s journey to Net Zero by 2035\.


**Role**

Support the Project Managers, Project Development Managers and Project Teams, responsible for providing support for the development of SP Energy Networks Transmission projects portfolio.


The role holder will work alongside project managers and project development managers to assist with key project management responsibilities including financial administration as well as supporting the onboarding and training of new staff in key systems. The role holder will become a recognised super user of Financial/Contract Management System.


**What you’ll be doing**

Raising purchase requisitions/orders and calling off framework contracts


Lead financial training for SPT Project staff as required.

jobs.description:
**Wellbeing Ambassador – Clinical Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist**  

We are looking for a Clinical Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist to join the Wellbeing Team at Riverstone, working across our retirement community residences in Kensington, Fulham, and Hampstead. At Riverstone we are creating exceptionally designed developments exclusively for people over 65\. It’s not just about a place to live, but a new way of living that enables them to live the life they want to live. We want this to be a lifestyle full of choice, with wellbeing at its heart, that enables people to be active and social, and continue learning until any age. These are choices and that’s why we purposefully call the role ‘Wellbeing Ambassador’ – you champion these choices, based on understanding our residents needs and how best to engage and encourage them in realising the benefits. Riverstone are leading the way on what it means to age well, and you will be at the forefront of best practice in preventing physical and mental frailty. Our wellbeing programme is evidence based and led by our wellbeing director who is an experienced geriatrician. From carrying out comprehensive assessments with personalised goal\-plans, delivering bespoke programmes improving physical and mental health, through to being a trusted confidante of our residents, every day is different.
  

And all of this takes place in our beautifully designed, state of the art wellbeing spaces.
  

You will also develop relationships and work closely with our trusted CQC registered partners including care agencies, nursing agencies and private doctors.
  

**This role is right for you if…**  

You are a registered Exercise Physiologist or Physiotherapist who wants to take your professional healthcare experience and knowledge and step out of the conventional sectors to be part of creating a new lifestyle choice for older adults.
  

You have a genuine and deep\-rooted interest in the wellbeing of others and enjoy building long\-term relationships.
  

You enjoy working as part of a team, and thinking outside of a traditional ‘health’ mindset, to explore what is truly possible.
  

You believe that movement is medicine and are passionate about helping older adults live stronger, healthier, and more independent lives.
  

You are a creator, not a follower.
  

Retirement living is a new and rapidly expanding sector of which we are setting the standard in central London. In this role, you’re part of a team developing an approach to health and wellbeing that is genuinely ground\-breaking.
  

**Key responsibilities of this role include \-**  

Be part of the team who carry out regular CGA (comprehensive geriatric assessments) with our residents, work with them to develop bespoke wellbeing packages, and support them to achieve goals that they may set.
  

Get to know the people who live at Riverstone. Lead the relationship with care providers who work with our residents; co\-ordinate with other health providers to access expertise as required to help them to meet their health needs.
  

Oversee the delivery of evidence\-based exercise programmes, support and develop the Fitness Instructors, and use resident data to measure outcomes, drive continuous improvement, and enhance resident wellbeing.
  

Work hand in hand with our sales team, meeting potential residents when they are making the decision about whether Riverstone is right for them, and helping them to understand the safety net that we offer.
  

Co\-ordinate and deliver health and wellbeing learning to residents and Riverstone Team
  

Adhere to clinical governance and quality processes within the residences, including safeguarding, Infection Control and Health and Safety. A rewarding role.  

  

Starting salary from £52,000, plus performance\-related bonus
  

40\-hour week, Monday to Friday
  

Some of the benefits that you will have access to include:
  

Pension and life assurance
  

Annual health check
  

Free daily main meal at work
  

Access a range of discounts and cashback from hundreds of retailers on every day (and special day) items.
  

**About Riverstone**
  

Riverstone’s ambition is to create exceptional London living for people over 65\. Riverstone is addressing the needs of a new generation of older Londoners with a best \-in\-class product that will extend and enhance the independent lifestyles they enjoy. It will allow them to stay in the neighbourhoods they love and enable them to live the life they want to live. With high specification apartments in central locations, Riverstone's residents will benefit from first \-class facilities, a like\-minded community, hotel\-like hospitality and \- when needed \- highly personalised, discreet care. Our two exceptionally designed developments in Fulham and Kensington opened in 2022\. Our third site, on the Bishops Avenue in Hamstead is opening late 2026\. Riverstone is backed by Goldman Sachs, which is supporting the business’ ambition to build a portfolio of residences in prime central London locations.
  

If you are our future Wellbeing Ambassador, please apply! INDHEADOFFICE

**Details**

* Apply and further information
**Location**
------------


10 South Colonnade, Canary Wharf, London E14 4PU / Edinburgh Government Hub Queen Elizabeth House, Edinburgh EH8 8FT**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


Do you want a career with a difference? Where you can have a real impact working with government departments and the wider public sector. If yes, then a career at the Government Actuary's Department (GAD) could be for you.


At GAD our mission is to support effective decision\-making and robust reporting within the public sector as the first\-choice provider of actuarial and specialist analysis, advice and assurance. The departments work covers valuation work and policy support in relation to investment, credit risk, insurance and contingent liabilities, pension schemes, financial risk, and social security. We also provide financial modelling and quality assurance.


We offer great working benefits including a world\-class pension, flexible working options and a career where your learning and development is taken seriously.


You will be a key consultant advising on investment and/or credit risk. The purpose of the role is to support our engagement and delivery of advice to help the public sector make more effective and informed decisions. The work is significantly more varied than in a typical actuarial consultancy, with opportunities to work on high\-profile public sector priorities and develop innovative solutions.


Further information on GAD is provided in the attached pack.

**N.B. GAD may work with recruiters on this campaign provided prior agreement is reached for this specific campaign**

### **Job description**


The role is in our Policy and Assurance unit. You will be based in one of the teams in that unit although we would expect you to support other teams and undertake a wider variety of work as required (see Key responsibilities 5\). Below sets out the range of work that GAD undertakes with respect to Investment and Credit Risk. There is scope for consultants at GAD to specialise in one area, or to work across multiple areas.


Investment


GAD provides advice in relation to invested funds held or sponsored by public sector bodies, and on government policy relating to investments held in the private sector, often in the context of pension arrangements. We are looking to hire an investment specialist to work alongside actuaries, trainee actuaries and analysts to enhance the support we can provide to our clients on investment issues.


GAD consultants regularly work in a much more diverse range of areas than a typical actuarial consultancy, working closely with both policy makers and operational staff to deliver effective public policy. The work is varied, interesting and has purpose, working in the best interests of the UK public. Recent projects have included:

* DB and DC pensions  advice in relation to funded public sector Defined Benefit (DB) pension scheme investments, public sector bodies Defined Contribution (DC) and Additional Voluntary Contribution (AVC) arrangements and wider pensions policy.
* Sizewell C  working with the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero and stakeholders to develop the funding and investment framework for a fund that will eventually be used to decommission the Sizewell C infrastructure.
* Pensions Investment Review  advising the Department for Work and Pensions on its productive finance agenda and how defined contribution pensions can contribute.
* Climate scenario analysis  setting assumptions and carrying out analysis of investment portfolios for funded public sector pension schemes to comply with Taskforce for Climate Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) reporting.
* Personal Injury Discount Rate  supporting government bodies as they review the rate of return that a personal injury claimant is assumed to earn if investing their damages award.


Credit Risk


GAD provides advice and support to a range of departments and wider public sector bodies on credit risk arrangements and modelling. These arrangements can arise from situations where government addresses gaps in private sector coverage, is trying to stimulate investment or is otherwise subject to credit risk.


The type of credit risk modelling is varied, and could relate to:

* expected credit loss calculations for financial guarantees and loans
* economic capital modelling
* stress testing
* other insolvency modelling for events which could impact government.


GADs role may involve:

* Quantifying and communicating risk
* Policy development  how credit risk arrangements can help meet policy objectives and be structured to reduce risk to government
* Quality Assurance  reviewing credit risk related models produced by other areas of the public sector


The work may involve consideration of niche, novel or remote risks, working with clients and third parties to incorporate specialist knowledge from subject matter experts to determine appropriate advice.


Current and previous areas of advice include:

* Assessment of implicit liabilities related to insolvency of key entities in line with Guidance for managing governments implicit liabilities
* Modelling of the credit losses arising from guarantees given to support multi\-lateral development banks
* Quality assurance of economic capital models subject to the Financial transaction control framework \- GOV.UK


General


The exact area a successful candidate will work in will be discussed prior to an offer being made and will be informed by the expertise and interests of the individual.


Regardless of the area of work, you will be expected to work closely with clients, scope out advice needs and deliver high value advice. The ability to apply investment and/or credit risk principles to novel policy areas and develop innovative solutions is essential.


Business development is an essential component of the role: you will help to build GADs reputation within the public sector, increasing awareness of your area of expertise and supporting the development of new client opportunities through networking, profile raising and building relationships with stakeholders across the public sector.


As part of your role, we expect you to help grow and develop both your own skills, and those of junior colleagues to help meet the evolving nature of our work. You will also help develop the investment and/or credit risk capabilities within GAD, sharing your knowledge and experience with others.

### **Person specification**

To provide consultancy support and advice to government departments and other organisations in the public sector. This will involve working with colleagues and clients to deliver high\-quality advice, often within demanding timescales.


To maintain and build on existing client relationships and to develop new relationships.


To work with colleagues to ensure all work is appropriately scoped and delivered in an efficient and timely manner with a focus on providing value for money for our clients. This includes:

* Specifying work, monitoring output and providing feedback
* Effective project management
* Motivating and team building
* Partnering with clients
* Operational duties  scheduling work, leave management, exercising financial control as required
* Business development and client engagement activities


The role requires a consistently high level of service to be provided and for work to be undertaken within professional requirements. This includes:

* Providing/supporting appropriate quality advice (oral or written) to agreed timescales and within budget
* Complying with peer review procedures
* Adapting to changing client needs and balancing conflicting priorities
* Complying with all professional actuarial (where relevant), civil service and GAD guidance.


 Agile working within other GAD teams from time to time during key periods.


 To maintain an up\-to\-date knowledge of role\-relevant developments and other matters (including meeting all CPD requirements).

*This job description is a broad reflection of the current duties. It is not an exhaustive list, and changes may be required, based on GADs immediate operational needs which are at the discretion of the relevant Unit Director and in conjunction with the post holder.*

### **Behaviours**


We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:


* Managing a Quality Service
* Seeing the Big Picture
* Working Together
* Communicating and Influencing
### **Technical skills**


We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* For Actuary Band 1 or 2 (investment / credit risk consultant): Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) or international equivalent (Essential for AB1 and AB2\)
* For Grade 7 (investment / credit risk consultant): A member of the Chartered Financial Analyst Institute, holding the CFA charter and designation or equivalent professional qualification (Desirable for Grade 7\)
* Detailed knowledge of Investment and/or Credit risk concepts and techniques (Essential)
**Benefits**
------------


Alongside your salary of £66,361, Government Actuary's Department contributes £19,224 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .
As well as competitive salaries, we offer a substantial package of benefits:

* Exceptional learning and development opportunities that you can explore alongside your day\-to\-day work.
* 25 days annual leave per year, increasing to 30 days after 5 years service. In addition, we offer 9 days public and privilege days leave per year (pro rata for part time staff)
* A Civil Service pension with an employer contribution of 28\.97%
* 5 days of paid volunteering leave
* Up to 9 months maternity leave on full pay \+ generous paternity and adoption leave
* Staff reward and recognition bonuses that operate throughout the year.
* Occupational sick pay
* Family\-friendly policies such as help with caring responsibilities, special leave, generous paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave.
* Access to employee assistance programme which offers staff 24/7 confidential support and resources such as counselling, debt guidance and management advice.
* The opportunity to join a trade union.
* A working culture which encourages inclusion and diversity.
* Salary advances for travel costs, including annual season tickets and cycle\-to\-work schemes.
* Access to the Edenred employee benefits system which offers discounts to popular retailers and access to various useful resources such as financial and savings advice.
* Complimentary BUPA health check.
**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**

**Title:** Production Shift Manager
  
  

**Function:** Manufacturing
  
**Contract:** Full Time, Permanent – 37\.5 hours per week
  
**Hours:** 4 on / 4 off rotation, days \& nights
  
**Location:** Bristol
  
  

Ready to lead from the front in a fast\-paced FMCG environment?
  
  

If you’re a people\-focused leader with manufacturing experience and a passion for continuous improvement, this could be the next big step in your career.
  
  

Our Bristol Bakery is looking for a Production Shift Manager to take ownership of shift performance, inspire teams, and help us deliver great products safely, efficiently and on time — every time.
  
  

Essential Ingredients
  
  

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring a mix of operational know\-how and strong leadership capability, including:
  
  

Experience working with or knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement methodologies
  
Familiarity with SAP (or the confidence to pick it up quickly)
  
Proven experience monitoring equipment performance, ensuring compliance, and resolving issues at pace
  
An understanding of site\-level planning and production flow
  
A strong willingness to lead, coach and develop teams to hit KPIs, achieve targets, and grow future talent
  
  

It’s simple really — we deliver fresh products on time, while keeping quality, safety and customer service at the heart of every decision we make.
  
  

Who We Are
  
  

As ‘the UK’s No. 1 Bakery Brand’ we have been baking bread since 1876\. Today, we are proudly a sixth\-generation family business, supplying over 18,000 retail customers from 11 bakeries and 16 depots, producing a range of over 70 products, including gluten and wheat free.
  
  

We are striving to be a net zero business by 2050 and believe that we must minimise our impact on the environment, whilst making a positive impact on the society we are a part of.
  
  

The Recipe
  
  

Whether you’re an experienced shift manager or a developing leader ready for your next move, this is your opportunity to own your area and make a real impact.
  
  

As a Production Shift Manager at Warburtons, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving performance across your shift. You’ll lead from the front, oversee day\-to\-day production activity, and champion our uncompromising standards in quality, safety and efficiency.
  
  

What you’ll be responsible for
  
  

Leadership, not just management

jobs.title: Imaging Nursing Assistant
jobs.description:
The post holder will primarily help provide a seamless service for patients attending imaging for an interventional procedure under Ultrasound, CT or fluoroscopic guidance.
  
  

The purpose of this role is to support the interventional diagnostic and treatment services. The role will be cross sites, allocated based on procedure list requirements The post holder will be required to work both autonomously using their own initiative and within the team in the development and delivery of the minimal invasive procedure services.
  
  

This role also entails providing support to the clinical nurse specialist team. The post holder will be predominantly responsible for ensuring the prompt and complete preparation of the patient prior to entering the scanning rooms as well as assisting the operators intra\-procedure. It is expected that the post holder is highly computer literate, experienced within the hospital setting with knowledge and evidence of medical terminology, educated to a level required to perform the role or equivalent experience.
  
  

The post holder will be responsible for the provision of a professional, proficient and comprehensive support service alongside the nursing team, modality lead radiographer, rotational radiographers, medical and non\-medical staff.
  
  

**Shift pattern:** Monday to Friday 37\.5 hrs per week.
  
  

To assist the Operator and other qualified healthcare professionals in checking patient details as per trust identification policy.
  
  

To assist the nursing team in preparation for the patients. This will include completion of relevant safety checklists, changing them into suitable patient gowns and any other reasonable steps.
  
  

To undertake intravenous cannulation according to trust and imaging policy.
  
  

To answer any queries which the patient or their carer may ask and know when to ask for assistance from a radiographer
  
  

To assist with any manual handling responsibilities at any point during the examination
  
  

To assist in the preparation of and maintenance of the clinical environment in keeping with trust infection control policy and procedure.

jobs.title: .Net Software Engineer
jobs.description:

**Role overview**


We’re looking for a .Net Software Engineer to help design, build, and support our core platform.


In this role, you’ll contribute to backend services, APIs, data access, integrations, and some UI components in a cloud\-based, event\-driven architecture. Our technology stack includes C\#, .NET, PostgreSQL, AWS, Blazor, and MudBlazor, with services running across Lambda, ECS, and EC2\.


We build distributed systems that communicate through APIs and events, and we continue to improve our engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities.


We take an AI\-first approach to software development, using approved AI tools to support design, coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and problem\-solving. You’ll be encouraged to use these tools thoughtfully and responsibly as part of your day\-to\-day work.


This role suits someone who enjoys hands\-on development, collaborative problem\-solving, and delivering reliable software in a practical, iterative environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain secure, reliable, and maintainable software
* Develop and support .NET services and APIs within an event\-driven microservices architecture
* Contribute to integrations between systems using APIs and events
* Work with PostgreSQL and data access patterns to deliver scalable, supportable solutions

**Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer building production application in **C\# and .NET**
* Experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs
* Experience working with **event\-driven systems**, asynchronous messaging patterns, or service\-based architectures
* Understanding of **RESTful APIs** and service\-to\-service communication
* Experience with **relational databases**, preferably **PostgreSQL**
* Understanding of automated tests and good software quality practices
* Experience using source control and collaborating through code review practices
* Ability to work from technical documentation and break development work into clear technical tasks
* Practical experience using **AI\-assisted development tools** as part of day\-to\-day engineering work

* Comfortable working in a pragmatic delivery environment that draws from agile principles without following a strict framework

*Nice to have:*

It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*

  

  

*B**uilt cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. jobs.title: Business Development Manager (Sponsorship)
jobs.description:
**Boost by Banter**



We are not looking for a relationship manager who waits for inbound, files tidy decks, and calls it a quarter. We are not looking for someone who needs a sales playbook handed to them or who thinks "following up" means a single email chase. If your idea of pipeline management is a CRM full of hopeful conversations that never close, this is not your role.



What we are building at Boost by Banter is a commercial engine with real teeth. You will be responsible for the full sponsorship and partnerships pipeline: identifying crypto projects and advertisers with live marketing budgets, pitching them into Banter's media channels, managing KOL deal flows concurrently, and making sure every campaign actually delivers.



You will be joining a small, growing team at a media brand that millions of crypto\-native people already follow and trust. That brand equity is real, and it is yours to leverage from day one.


**What You'll Do**


* **Own the full sales pipeline:** Source, qualify, pitch, negotiate, and close new crypto project sponsors, KOLs, and affiliates from first contact through to signed deal \- no handoffs, no safety net.
* **Build and work a live prospect list:** Drive outreach proactively via Telegram BD communities, Crypto Twitter, conference flors, and your personal book of contacts \- not by waiting for marketing to generate leads.
* **Manage concurrent KOL deal flows:** Execute multiple KOL partnerships simultaneously, maintaining clear timelines, deliverables, and communication standards without dropping the ball on any active campaign.
* **Ensure campaign execution lands:** Coordinate with Banter's content and operations teams to make certain every sponsor integration is fulfilled to brief, on time, and in line with the advertiser's campaign objectives.
* **Report performance with precision:** Deliver detailed post\-campaign reports to sponsors that demonstrate ROI, build trust, and create grounds for renewal \-turning closed deals into long\-term commercial relationships.
* **Hit a hard number:** Work toward a consistent **$150k\+ monthly revenue** **target**, with clear milestones in the first 90 days — a live pipeline, first closed deals, and demonstrable early revenue momentum.

  


**Your Skills and Experience**


* **Native crypto market knowledge:** You understand the difference between a vanity integration and a high converting campaign, know how KOL deal structures work in practice, and can speak credibly to a crypto project's CMO about what actually moves their audience**.**
* **Hunter sales mentality:** You self source leads through conferences, Telegram groups, and a warm Rolodex rather than relying on inbound \- commission upside and full ownership of your pipeline motivate you more than a comfortable base.
* **KOL and affiliate management experience**: You have managed multiple KOL relationships concurrently, handling deal negotiation, briefing, fulfilment tracking, and performance review without needing a separate account management layer to hold it together.
* **Stable commercial tenure in Web3:** 3\+ years in BD, partnerships, or sales roles within crypto \- with a tenure history that shows you build and deliver rather than move on before results materialise, and an active warm book of crypto project contacts with marketing budgets in the $50k–$500k range.
* **Geographic and community prese**nce: Based in a genuine Web3 hub \- Singapore, Dubai, London, New York, Seoul, Hong Kong, or comparable with real access to regional conference circuits and the Telegram and Crypto Twitter communities where deals are actually sourced.
* **Operational self\-sufficiency:** Comfortable integrating into existing content and admin workflows, managing your own CRM hygiene, and delivering performance reporting to sponsors without needing a support team to do it for you.

jobs.title: Credit Analyst
jobs.description:
**Credit Analyst**  

  

**Who we’re looking for**  

We’re looking for a Credit Analyst to join the EMEA Credit Research team in London. You will be responsible for fundamental credit research into bonds and loans from European corporate issuers as directed by research management. Experience covering non\-financial industry sectors would be expected.
  

  

**Application Process: As part of the application process for this role, you will be required to include a cover letter outlining your current sector coverage experience, to be considered for this opportunity.**

**About Us**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.  



Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  

  

  

  

**The base**

We moved into our new HQ in the City of London in 2018\. We’re close to our clients, in the heart of the UK’s financial centre and we have everything we need to work flexibly.  

  

  



**The team**  

Schroders Investment Management's Credit Research team undertakes corporate credit analysis of a wide universe of non\-government bond issuers. Our aim is to provide benchmark beating performance to our portfolio managers by providing both accurate fundamental credit research and relative value recommendations to be adopted into by our team of portfolio managers.
  

  

The Credit Research team consists of around 35 research specialists, each undertaking industry and issuer analysis in three broad regions – America, EMEA (Europe, Middle East \& Africa) and Asia. The London\-based EMEA team currently consists of thirteen analysts covering investment grade, high yield and loan issuers across the full range of industry sectors.  



**What you'll do**

The basis of the role is to be able to analyse and understand the business, financial and sustainability risk profiles of the companies under coverage as well as the legal structure of their debt securities. An overall assessment of risk and valuation of these factors will then be communicated to the Schroders credit PMs using our proprietary framework. The successful candidate will be expected to work as part of a team with our entire desk to deliver alpha generating investment ideas for clients.  



  

  

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Experience in a single name investment environment
* Proven investment and/or financial analysis experience at the corporate entity level
* A strong academic record, most likely a first degree or upper\-second with post\-graduate degree and/or demonstrated progress through the CFA system
* Demonstrated research capability in educational history and/or previous work experience.

  

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications that’ll help**

* Strong analytical skills and ability to make sound judgments
* Exceptional communication skills
* Ability to work with minimal supervision in a very dynamic and timeline sensitive work environment
* Well\-developed sense of teamwork and cooperation
High level of accuracy and attention to detail  
* 

  

**We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are**

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.  



We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

* Strong oral and written communication skills;
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, experience with Looker, SQL or similar tools and languages highly preferred;
* Ability to conduct research, interpret data and translate data into insights. Ability to present data in a logical and clear manner to business stakeholders
* Comfort with ambiguity and a self\-starter with an aptitude for defining and directing new processes;
* Project management experience and confidence to drive progress and accountability;
* Natural ability to articulate, present and tell a compelling story using data and data\-driven insights.
  

  

*The following skills and experience are considered assets for success in the role:*

**Why you’ll love working here:**

Hybrid \- London

**Does this sound like you?**  

You're naturally curious, genuinely enjoy digging into organisations to understand how they tick, and take real pride in the quality of your research. You're organised, detail\-oriented, and comfortable navigating large volumes of data without losing focus. You work well alongside sales and marketing teams, communicating clearly and building relationships easily. The idea of shaping a pipeline from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's, appeals to you.

**What you’ll be doing (in a nutshell):**  

In our Revenue team, you'll be the engine behind net\-new pipeline. Working alongside our Sales Development Representatives and Marketing team, you'll identify and research the organisations and people that align with our Ideal Client Profile, giving the wider commercial team the intelligence they need to open meaningful conversations.

**Day\-to\-day you can expect to:**

* Research and map target accounts in the Mid\-Market and Enterprise space (organisations with 500\+ employees), identifying the right stakeholders across HR, Reward, and C\-suite
* Understand the business challenges of target organisations and align these to the relevant Perkbox and Vivup product solutions
* Build and maintain a well\-organised, accurate contact database using a range of sales prospecting tools and platforms
* Collaborate directly with the SDR team to develop and grow pipeline in the 500\+ employee space
* Work with the Marketing team on business\-as\-usual projects that support new business generation
* Stay across relevant HR industry trends to ensure our outreach is informed and well\-targeted

 **To be successful, you'll have:**

* A high degree of curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding organisations and people
* Excellent written communication skills, including strong copywriting ability
* Great interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong internal relationships
* Solid organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Meticulous attention to detail, particularly when working with large data sets
* Confidence using multiple software platforms and handling high volumes of information

**Bonus points if you bring:**

* Experience working in or alongside the employee benefits industry

 **Why Perkbox?**


Perkbox is the employee experience platform built to care for, connect with, and celebrate employees in all areas of life.


With more than 20 years of experience across public, private, SME and corporate sectors, we support nearly 4 million employees across 7,500 organisations in the UK and Australia. From the NHS to leading private sector businesses, our platform brings together benefits, wellbeing, and recognition in one place people actually use.


From access to expert mental health services to help with the cost of everyday essentials, our range of benefits and wellbeing tools meets people where they are, at work and beyond.


We're redefining what employee benefits can be. And we're just getting started.

**The Interview Process**


Our interview process involves 4 main stages:

* Application
* Short call with a member of the TA team
* 30\-minute video call with Hiring Manager and one other team member
* Final Interview and task with two members of the team

  

Our average process takes around 2\-3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process. If you have any specific questions ahead of this, please contact us on talent@perkbox.com

  

We’re committed to being an inclusive employer and creating a fair workplace for all. We encourage applications from candidates across all backgrounds, circumstances, ages, disabilities, ethnicities, religions or beliefs, gender identities, or sexual orientations


We're happy to offer reasonable adjustments during our hiring process. Just let us know, and we'll make it work for you. Your comfort and success matter to us!

About the University
We have one simple promise – to make a positive impact. Through our ground\-breaking research, teaching excellence and commitment to sustainable living, we are changing lives for the better.


The University of Derby is a modern university with a modern outlook. Everything we do is driven by delivering excellence and opportunities for our students, our staff and our region.


We have some of the best university facilities in the UK and achieve outstanding results for our teaching and research and have been awarded Gold in the prestigious Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2023 – making it one of the top universities in the country recognised for its outstanding student experience and student outcomes.


Financially strong and seriously ambitious we offer our employees an inclusive culture that centres itself around staff wellbeing, where you can be confident you will receive all the help and encouragement you need to build a rewarding career with lots of opportunities to enhance your skills.


About the College/Department
The Executive Services team provide professional, executive level assistance and support to members of the University’s Executive Board (“UEB”), the senior leaders of the University. This is a busy yet exciting and diverse team to be a part of, working with colleagues within both the University and externally.


Executive Services is a high\-performing and collaborative team committed to delivering an outstanding service, embracing digital innovation and continuously improving how we support executive decision\-making and organisational success.


About the role
This role is an exciting opportunity to work at the heart of the University's strategic leadership
  

  

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Executive Services Officer to provide professional, confidential support to a member of the University Executive Board (UEB). This is a varied and fast\-paced role at the heart of the University's strategic leadership, requiring excellent judgement, discretion and the ability to manage competing priorities in a complex environment.


The role also provides opportunities to lead on improvements to processes and ways of working, contribute to cross\-University projects and work collaboratively with colleagues across professional services and academic departments.


Please note that this position is full\-time, on a 12 month fixed term contract; based on\-site at our Kedleston Road Campus.


**The anticipated interview date is 8th October 2026\.**


About You
We are looking for a skilled professional with experience of supporting senior leaders in a complex organisation. You will be highly organised, able to anticipate needs, manage competing demands and maintain exceptional attention to detail.


You will be comfortable building relationships with colleagues and external stakeholders at all levels, handling sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and professionalism, and responding positively to changing priorities.


Experience of supporting executive\-level meetings, producing high\-quality materials, drafting Executive papers, providing briefings and coordinating multiple workstreams would be advantageous. Experience within the higher education sector is desirable but not essential.


Principal accountabilities
* Provide a full confidential support service to members of UEB, as well as to the wider Executive Services team, demonstrating discretion and integrity in dealing with reputationally sensitive information.


* Proactive and creative diary management for UEB to ensure optimum use of time to focus on strategic priorities and upcoming deadlines.
* Work closely with team members to provide an occasional on\-call support provision out of office hours to ensure that UEB members can focus on matters of strategic importance.
* Ensure continuous and proactive forethought into University activities and strategic aims to support all portfolios within the UEB.
* Lead and provide comprehensive support to strategic level meetings, through excellent organisational skills, high\-quality minutes and actions, and make connections across the business to ensure high quality, insightful decision making is carried out.
* Promote Executive Services as a highly professional and competent support service to UEB, to support an excellent reputation of the Vice Chancellor, UEB and Executive Services, whilst acting as a positive ambassador for the University.


* Research and provide relevant comprehensive briefing material, prepare draft documents such as presentations, meeting papers and correspondence (letters and emails) on behalf of UEB members, ensuring all completed to a consistently high standard.
* Demonstrate a future focused approach to personal development and embracing the digital direction of the University to provide a continually evolving suite of services and support to the UEB.
* Initiate and lead mentoring of peers in the University in similar positions, to establish Executive Services as a beacon of best practice. Show continuous improvement in practices, raise aspirations and influence peers to meet the high\-performance standards of the University.


* Develop strong working relationships across the University, as well as with members of Executive Services, to deliver a seamless, efficient, and effective approach to support.
* Provide a highly comprehensive and professional deputising support role for the Executive Services Lead Coordinator to ensure a seamless and efficient running of the Executive Services.


Person specification
### **Essential Criteria**


#### **Qualifications**


* HND qualification or proven track record of equivalent professional experience
* GCSE Maths and English at grade C or above or equivalent qualification

#### **Experience**


* Proven experience of supporting at an executive level preferably in a large and complex organisation.
* Experience of handling sensitive situations, recognising confidential issues and dealing with them appropriately and with full discretion.
* Experience of proactively managing a diverse workload with the ability to meet deadlines, effectively manage own time, prioritise and react swiftly to changes.
* Experience of working within a high performing team.
* Experience of producing professional standard minutes and reports.
* Experience of supervision, the ability to give constructive feedback to promote best practice and create high performance in others.

#### **Skills, knowledge and abilities**


* Ability to react positively to frequently changing priorities and deadlines, and deal with unforeseen circumstances.
* Ability to be able to make operational decisions in line with UEB/ College expectations.
* Digital literacy and excellent computing skills including Microsoft Office and use of administrative business systems.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to continuously develop effective relationships with individuals and organisations both internally and externally.
* Excellent attention to detail, including proof reading skills and the ability of maintain a high level of accuracy.
* Understanding the importance of having up to date sector knowledge and the impact this may have on the day\-to\-day priorities of both UEB members and the wider University.
* Ability to foster and be part of a team spirit which engages others to innovate and perform to a high standard.

#### **Business Requirements**


* Ability to occasionally undertake late/evening/weekend working when required.

### **Desirable Criteria**


#### **Qualifications**


* Educated to degree level or equivalent qualification
* Management/business/customer care qualification.

#### **Experience**


* Higher Education sector experience.
Benefits
* Generous annual leave entitlement of 38 days inclusive of bank holidays and concessionary days (pro rata)
* Local Government Pension Scheme
* Suite of holistic wellbeing benefits and support including family\-friendly policies, generous sick pay provision and comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme
* Access to a variety of staff discounts at high street retailers
* Discounted onsite gym
* Cycle to Work scheme
* A flexible working environment
* A commitment to personal and professional development
  


Key contact
For further information and informal enquiries regarding the role, please contact Hannah Hallam, Chief of Staff via h.hallam@derby.ac.uk


For enquiries regarding your application and for sponsorship eligibility, please contact the recruitment team via recruitment@derby.ac.uk.


Important information
#### **Visa Sponsorship Eligibility**


The University is unable to sponsor the employment of international workers under the Skilled Worker route for this role; however, applications are welcome from candidates who are able to demonstrate an alternative right to work in the UK.

  

#### **Equity, diversity and inclusion**


The University of Derby is committed to fostering an open, inclusive and diverse community where everyone is treated with dignity, fairness and respect. We are committed to advancing equity, diversity and inclusion regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief (or none), sex or sexual orientation.

However you identify, we welcome applications from people whose experiences, perspectives and talents will contribute to our inclusive, supportive and intellectually vibrant community.

  

#### **Environmental Sustainability**


At the University of Derby, we are passionate about embedding sustainability into everything that we do. We aim to bring environmental sustainability into all aspects of the University, including teaching, research and operational activities. jobs.description:

F0509
Location
London
Function
Risk

30 Nov 2026
  
### **More details**


About LPPI
  

  

One of the key priorities at LPPI is ensuring that our people work every day in an empowered, supportive, diverse and inclusive culture. Practically, this means recognising and valuing the uniqueness of every individual in terms of background, experience, beliefs and circumstances. This starts with the recruitment process, where we partner with agencies who share our common goal and advertise on a variety of job boards to access the broadest spectrum of candidates. And once successful applicants are on board, we trust our people to work in the way that works best for them which typically involves a mix of office and home working plus an engagement model to ensure frequent two\-way feedback.
  

  

We are very proud of our culture at LPPI and the benefits it brings to both our people and the business. But don’t just take our word for it! Recently, we invited our entire workforce to describe in three words what is great about us and they said – our people, flexibility and collaboration.
  

  

If you would like to join a company that is inclusive and forward\-thinking, please read on.
  

  

Role Purpose
  

  

We are seeking a practical and delivery\-focused Sustainability Reporting \& Data Analyst to ensure the continuity of climate and sustainability\-related reporting while LPPI progresses its broader sustainability data and reporting automation programme.
  

  

The role is a 12 month Fixed\-term contract and will focus on the end\-to\-end production of climate and sustainability\-related reporting outputs, including TCFD/SDR reports, product\-level TCFD disclosures, and portfolio TCFD reports for partner funds, as well as internal metrics for compliance with net zero targets. A significant component of the role involves data extraction, aggregation, and validation from multiple internal and external sources, alongside the preparation of reporting\-ready outputs using structured templates and spreadsheets.
  

  

The role will also contribute to the LPPI projects for sustainability data and reporting automation.
  

  

Key deliverables:
  

* Continuity of all TCFD/SDR and climate\-related reporting outputs during transition period
* Successful scaling of reporting volumes (e.g. TCFD and partner fund reports)
* Reduction in manual processing risk through improved structure and documentation
* Support input into sustainability data and reporting transformation projects

  

Key Responsibilities
  

  

1\. Data extraction and aggregation:
  

* Extract sustainability and climate\-related data from systems and reporting tools
* Collaborate and coordinate data inputs from:

o Responsible Investment / Stewardship teams
  

o Delegate managers
  

* Consolidate and reconcile data across multiple sources
* Perform data quality checks, validation, and issue resolution

  

2\. Data preparation and analysis:
  

* Transform raw datasets into report\-ready formats using Excel and other tools
* Maintain and enhance data models, calculation sheets, and reporting templates
* Support the production of:

o Climate metrics (e.g. emissions, temperature alignment where applicable)
  

o Portfolio\-level analytics and summaries
  

* Ensure consistency of data, assumptions and methodologies across reports

  

3\. Report delivery:
  

* Prepare and deliver:

o Entity\-level TCFD report
  

o Multiple TCFD product reports
  

o Climate Risk Analytics Reports (CRARs) for investment teams
  

* Contribute to:

o Partner Fund TCFD portfolio reports
  

o Responsible Investment reports to Partner Funds
  

* Ensure outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned to agreed templates and regulatory expectations

  

4\. Process efficiency and improvement:
  

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, repeatability, and control of reporting processes
* Support transition to automated reporting solutions, including:

o Attendance of project meetings
  

o Mapping data flows
  

o Testing new systems or outputs
  

  

5\. Assist with the following:
  

* Conduct assessments of climate and wider sustainability\-related risks and opportunities in the investment portfolio.
* Stay abreast of regulatory developments, industry best practices, and emerging trends related to climate risk.

  

Requirements for the role
  

  

* Demonstrable experience in data management and reporting, ideally in asset management or financial services.
* Advanced Excel skills.
* Familiarity with TCFD or climate\-related reporting frameworks.
* Experience working with sustainability / climate data or non\-financial datasets.
* Proven ability to manage large and imperfect datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality focus.
* Work collaboratively whilst also being able to work independently and deliver to tight timelines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders
* Good conduct that is consistent with the LPPI values\- aligned behaviours

  

Desirable
  

  

* Experience with reporting tools, in particular Opus Nebula
* Experience supporting regulatory or client reporting processes.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Marketing Manager**
---------------------


Offer ID: 90334
Job: Support Functions / Communication
Contract type: Permanent
Schedule: Full\-Time
Country: United Kingdom
**Equans is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our team in London on a permanent basis. This is a full\-time role working 37\.5 hours per week. On offer is a competitive salary, bonus and benefits package.**


The Marketing Manager will play a key role in strengthening the UK and Ireland Marketing and External Communications function's ability to support business growth.


This is a hands\-on marketing role focused on proactive growth marketing, campaign development and delivery. The post\-holder will work closely with the Head of Marketing and External Communications, business development teams, divisional stakeholders and colleagues across the wider marketing and communications function to translate growth priorities into clear, targeted marketing activity.


The post\-holder will manage campaigns, while supporting priority sectors, services, clients and growth opportunities through clear briefs, compelling messaging, coordinated specialist input and effective business development follow\-up.


The Marketing Manager will work as part of a peer team, collaborating with colleagues across PR, content, events, employer brand, digital, social media and creative delivery to ensure campaigns are planned, joined up, measurable and aligned to business priorities.


**What will you deliver?**


* Develop and deliver proactive marketing campaigns, alongside the Head of Marketing \& Communications that support Equans growth priorities across selected sectors, services, propositions and client groups.
* Translate business objectives into clear campaign briefs, audience plans, propositions, messages, channel plans and measurable activity.
* Manage planned growth marketing activity where the requirement includes longer\-term audience development, targeted email activity, digital engagement, in\-person and online engagement, account\-based activity or nurture campaigns.
* Work with business development and operational stakeholders to understand target markets, client challenges, commercial priorities and upcoming opportunities.
* Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, buying groups, customer challenges and sector\-specific drivers.
* Work with SMEs, BD teams and operational leads to shape clear narratives and campaign messages.
* Plan and manage integrated marketing campaigns across selected channels, including email, LinkedIn, website, landing pages, paid digital, content, events, roundtables, webinars and agency\-supported activity.
* Coordinate campaign activity with colleagues across external communications, brand and digital, creative design, events and content to ensure work is joined up and delivered to a high standard.
* Ensure event activity supports wider campaign objectives and business priorities.
* Measure event participation, engagement and outcomes and use insight to improve future activity.

**What can we offer you?**


On offer is a competitive salary, bonus and benefits package, which includes;


* 25 days annual leave (\+ public holidays)
* Life Cover equivalent to 2x times annual salary
* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
* Gym membership discounts
* Cycle to work scheme
* Holiday purchase scheme
* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year
* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes
* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme
* Access to our growing employee networks including AccessAbility (representing those with physical and mental disabilities), Encompass (representing the LGBTQ\+ community), RISE (representing people from ethnic backgrounds), WOMEN TOGETHER (representing women in Equans), Working Parents, and Young Professionals.
* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

**Who are we looking for?**


* An ability to build effective working relationships with business development, commercial, operational, strategy and divisional stakeholders.
* Proven stakeholder management experience
* Influence without relying on formal authority, working collaboratively across a peer team and wider matrix organisation.
* Strong B2B marketing experience, ideally in a complex environment.
* Experience developing and delivering integrated marketing campaigns linked to business growth, client engagement, lead generation or pipeline development.
* Strong understanding of audience planning, proposition development, messaging, segmentation and campaign journeys.
* Experience working with BD or sales teams to support commercial priorities, opportunity development or account\-based activity.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, audience\-led marketing content.
* Good understanding of digital marketing channels, including LinkedIn, website content, landing pages, paid social, email and campaign reporting.
* A practical understanding of how marketing supports growth, including awareness, engagement, lead nurturing, meetings, pipeline influence and relationship development.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, priorities and deadlines.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to move work from idea to delivery.

**Who are we?**


Equans is a world leader in energy services with nearly 100,000 employees working in more than 50 countries, with an annual turnover of over 17 billion euros.


In the UK \& Ireland, Equans is a provider of technical, FM, regeneration and energy services – with specialist capabilities in smart buildings, green mobility, district \& embedded energy and decentralised renewables.


Equans’ 13,500 UK \& Ireland employees combine these activities to help businesses, public sector organisations and government to embrace the energy transition towards net zero, and also the digital \& industrial transitions that are redesigning the way we move, work and live.


Equans is a Bouygues group company.


**What's next?**


If this role is of interest to you, please click below to register, apply, and track your progress! A member of our Resourcing Team will review your application and be in touch.


*As part our commitment to better reflect the markets within which we operate, we encourage applications from women, ethnically diverse individuals and people with disabilities, along with all candidates who identify with protected characteristic groups under the Equality Act 2010\.*


*At Equans we’re committed to delivering a culture where everyone’s voice is heard and supported. We know the value a diverse workforce creates, delivering better results for our people, customers, and stakeholders. Diversity and inclusion is at the core of what we do, should you join Equans you'll find a welcoming and open workplace where you're supported and encouraged to be your true self at work.*


*You'll also have access to our growing employee networks including AccessAbility (representing those with physical and mental disabilities), Encompass (representing the LGBTQ\+ community), RISE (representing people from ethnic backgrounds), WOMEN TOGETHER (representing women in Equans), Working Parents, Young Professionals, Veterans and Reservists Network (VaR).*

  

*For this role, you must have evidence of the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer a re\-location package with this job role. Certain roles may require applicants to undergo a Disclosure check, as noted in the role requirements.*


The Equans Resourcing Team supports this job advert. Agency involvement is not required. All related enquiries must come to the resourcing team not direct to Equans Managers.
