jobs.title: Principal Financial Reporting Accountant
jobs.description:
About the Role  

Ready to be the person who turns numbers into decisions?


At EDF, we're looking for an experienced finance professional who loves seeing the bigger picture behind the data. You'll be at the heart of our Customers Finance team, helping senior leaders understand performance, shape strategy, and make decisions that support both our business and Britain's journey to net zero.


This is a role where your expertise will be valued, your insights will be heard, and your work will influence decisions at the highest levels. Because at EDF, Success is Personal.

**The Opportunity**


As a Principal Financial Reporting Accountant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our financial reporting is accurate, insightful, and supports effective decision\-making across the business. Working within our Financial Control \& Reporting team, you'll lead the production of performance reporting, forecasting, budgeting and regulatory submissions, while partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance and the wider business.


You'll be the trusted expert helping leaders understand what the numbers are saying today, and what they could mean tomorrow. Whether you're consolidating financial results, leading planning cycles, supporting regulatory reporting, or driving improvements in reporting processes, you'll have a genuine impact on how the business operates.


You'll join us on a salary starting from **£60,000 per annum**, with the potential for an annual bonus. This is a hybrid role ideally based in **\#London**, working from our Nova North office up to one day per week.


Beyond the day job, you'll gain exposure to senior leaders from the outset, work in a team that genuinely supports development, and can shape improvements across a fast\-moving, evolving business. If you're looking for a role where you can make your mark rather than simply produce reports, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

**Who You Are**


We're looking for a Principal Financial Reporting Accountant who combines technical excellence with strong commercial awareness. You'll be a naturally curious finance professional who enjoys understanding what drives business performance and turning complex information into clear insights.


To be shortlisted, you need to offer:

* A full accounting qualification or working towards completion (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)
* Strong industry experience in financial accounting and reporting
* Experience producing and analysing Income Statements, Balance Sheets and Cash Flow Statements
* Proven experience of budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities
* Advanced Excel skills and experience working with financial systems
* Experience presenting financial information and recommendations to senior stakeholders

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading monthly financial reporting and consolidation activities
* Producing performance packs and financial insights for senior leadership teams
* Managing forecasting, budgeting and planning cycles across the business
* Supporting regulatory reporting, audit requirements and corporate submissions
* Identifying and implementing improvements to reporting processes, controls and systems

**Pay, Benefits and Culture**


Alongside a starting salary from **£60,000 per annum**, potential for an annual bonus, and a market\-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.


At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That's why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that's unique to you. Here, Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us.


Everyone is welcome at EDF. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where people can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we'll support applicants who need adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

**Join us and find your success at EDF.**

**\#SuccessIsPersonal \#EDFCareers \#LI\-Hybrid \#London**

  

  

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Flipdish**
------------------



At Flipdish, we're turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple\-to\-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that's anything but.


**About the role**
------------------



You'll join Flipdish's Success organisation, owning and growing a focused portfolio of restaurant clients while acting as a proactive technical problem solver for the wider team. You'll partner closely with Strategic Account Management, Customer Support, Product, Sales, and Activations to improve customer satisfaction, retention, product adoption, and commercial growth.



This role blends commercial account ownership with technical curiosity. You'll be as comfortable discussing business goals, negotiating growth opportunities, and preventing churn as you are investigating customer issues, clarifying root causes, and translating technical context into clear commercial impact.



Success in this role looks like a healthy and growing account portfolio, earlier identification of churn risks, faster and clearer escalation management, and a stronger feedback loop between customers, Success, Support, and Product.


**What you'll own**
-------------------


* Own a focused portfolio of restaurant clients; build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and take responsibility for account health, satisfaction, retention, and commercial growth.
* Grow account value through consultative conversations; identify opportunities to increase subscription revenue, net fees, product adoption, and use of relevant Flipdish products and features.
* Monitor customer health, usage, order performance, adoption, and engagement signals; act early on churn risks and optimise each customer's online ordering, app/web, loyalty, and retention setup.
* Own the Success escalation pipeline into Support and Product; investigate issues, provide clear customer and commercial context, and ensure urgent or complex cases are triaged, prioritised, tracked, and followed through to resolution.
* Act as the technical bridge for the wider Strategic Account Management team; support issues beyond your own portfolio and turn recurring customer pain points into structured feedback, trend reporting, and actionable Product or Support themes.
* Use Salesforce, Looker, Flipdish Portal dashboards, customer health scores, QBRs, and account\-performance data to diagnose problems, develop account plans, identify growth opportunities, and report on churn risk, escalation volume, themes, and resolution times.
* Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility—prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

  


**What success looks like**
---------------------------



Within your first three months, you will have:


* Built a strong working knowledge of Flipdish products, tools, customer challenges, and Success processes.
* Taken ownership of a defined account portfolio, established regular contact with key customers, and created clear plans for account health, retention, and growth.
* Identified and acted on meaningful churn risks, product issues, optimisation opportunities, and commercial growth opportunities using customer and performance data.
* Earned the trust of Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Support, and Product as a reliable technical liaison with strong organisation, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Reduced friction between Success, Support, and Product by improving escalation quality, visibility, prioritisation, and communication through to resolution.

**About you**
-------------



You'll thrive in this role if you:


* Have experience in technical account management, Strategic Account Management, Customer Success, Support, implementation, or a similar customer\-facing role.
* Can combine commercial account ownership with strong technical troubleshooting instincts, investigating likely root causes before escalating.
* Understand the commercial drivers of retention, churn prevention, upsell, product adoption, and account growth.
* Can manage a portfolio of accounts while also helping the wider team resolve urgent or complex technical customer issues.
* Communicate clearly and can translate technical detail into practical customer impact, commercial risk, and useful context for internal teams.
* Are highly organised, with strong documentation habits and consistent follow\-through across account actions and escalations.
* Use data confidently to understand customer health, diagnose problems, prioritise action, and make evidence\-based recommendations.
* Work effectively across Support, Product, Sales, Activations, and Success, taking initiative without needing constant direction.
* Stay calm under pressure and take a consultative, solution\-focused approach with frustrated customers or urgent issues.
* Bring low ego, curiosity, and a willingness to learn while constructively challenging unclear thinking or ineffective processes.


The following would help you stand out:


* Experience in restaurant, hospitality, e\-commerce, payments, or hospitality technology.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Salesforce, Looker, customer\-health tooling, or similar analytics and CRM platforms.
* Experience supporting SaaS implementations, integrations, product troubleshooting, or structured technical escalations.

  


**What you get**
----------------



We're a growing startup, and we understand that amazing incentives attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you're smart, ambitious, and hard\-working, we'll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!


* Hub model (hybrid): A healthy blend of hub and home working, with two days per week from our London Bridge office
* Time off: 25 days' annual leave \+ public holidays \+ company days, including seasonal Summer Fridays
* Private healthcare: UK cover, including Vitality private health insurance
* Pension: UK retirement savings support
* Equity (ESOP): Share options, so you can share in Flipdish's long\-term success
* Team connection: Regular team meet\-ups and company events
* Wellbeing extras: Bike\-to\-work and wellness benefits

**Interview process**
---------------------



Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process.



* **Recruiter screening call (15–30 minutes)**


* **Hiring manager interview (45–60 minutes)**


* **Competency / technical stage**


* **Reference checks**


**Our culture**
---------------



At Flipdish, we're on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that's powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.



Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We're an AI\-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes—faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations—so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.



Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people\-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other and create the space for people to grow, with balance rather than burnout. We're focused on impact and team energy, not "being seen". You'll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.



If you'd like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.


**Don't be shy. Apply.**
------------------------



We know imposter syndrome can be a thing—don't let it be. We want enthusiastic people from all backgrounds. If you feel like you're up for working with us, get in touch.



If you need assistance during the hiring process, reach out—we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**Circa £50,000 DOE \+ benefits**

**Warwick based, hybrid \- 3 days pw onsite/ 2 WFH**

  



***At National Gas, the work we do matters.***

  



As Britain's national gas network, we help keep the lights on, businesses running, and homes warm by maintaining the critical infrastructure that transports gas across Great Britain. While providing the energy security Britain relies on today, we're also helping transform the network for a clean energy future.

***Join us and help secure Britain's energy.***

**About the role:**
-------------------

  

This Finance \& Governance Analyst position works within our Innovation team **ensuring the National Gas Innovation portfolio is financially controlled, effectively governed and able to demonstrate measurable value**. The role manages **portfolio budgeting, forecasting and reporting; coordinates project sanction, contracting and regulatory reporting**; and maintains clear visibility of **project performance and benefits from idea through to implementation**. Working across Innovation, Finance, Legal, Procurement and project teams, the role provides **accurate analysis, robust assurance and practical improvements to the systems and processes** that enable successful innovation delivery.

**Key accountabilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Manage portfolio **budgets, forecasts, accruals and financial reporting**, working with Finance and project teams to **maintain accurate information and provide clear insight on performance, risks and variances**.

  

* Coordinate innovation **funding and regulatory reporting**, including Regulatory Reporting Pack submissions and annual Ofgem requirements.

  

* Manage the **governance and sanction process** for innovation projects, ensuring submissions are complete, evidence\-based and progressed in line with delegated authorities.

  

* Coordinate commercial and legal activities for innovation projects, including **purchase orders, contracting requirements, invoicing and milestone tracking**, acting as the key interface with Procurement, Legal, external advisers and delivery partners.

  

* Assure **cost\-benefit assessments** completed by the project leads and maintain portfolio\-level visibility of project outputs, benefits and value realisation from initial idea through to implementation and subsequent tracking in co\-ordination with the Innovation Implementation team.

  

* Support effective **project change control** by working with project leads to identify financial, delivery and governance risks, assess impacts and escalate issues where required.

  

* Own and **maintain the Innovation governance system**, ensuring portfolio information, controls and audit evidence are accurate, current and accessible.
**About you:**
--------------

 ***Essential:***

  

* Relevant experience in **financial, commercial, portfolio or project governance**, supported by a degree or equivalent professional experience in a numerical, commercial, engineering or scientific discipline.

  

* Proven experience in **budget management, forecasting, accruals, financial reporting and cost\-benefit analysis**.

  

* Strong **analytical capability** and attention to detail, with the confidence to challenge incomplete or inconsistent information and translate data into clear insight.

* **Advanced Microsoft Excel** capability and the wider MS 365 suite for managing, analysing and presenting financial and project information

  

* Strong **stakeholder management and communication** skills, with a track record of building constructive relationships across multidisciplinary teams and external partners.

  

* Good **commercial judgement, organisational skills** and the ability to manage competing priorities to agreed deadlines.

 ***Desirable:***

  

* SAP experience

  

* VBA, macros or process automation

  

* Knowledge of regulated innovation funding mechanisms, including NIA, SIF, UIOLI and Net Zero Reopeners.
**What we can offer you:**
--------------------------

  

* Salary circa £50,000 (dependant on experience)

  

* Market\-leading double\-match pension (for every £1 you add, we add £2\)

  

* Annual performance bonus (up to 6%)

  

* 26 days holiday plus 8 statutory days and option to buy 5 additional days

  

* 10x salary life assurance and income protection

  



* Flexible opt\-in salary sacrifice benefits including private healthcare, car, dental, and technology schemes

  

* Family\-friendly policies, wellbeing support, and professional development opportunities

We're building a workforce that reflects the communities we serve, championing diversity, and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is valued for their unique contribution. We support reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and beyond.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Substations
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations – Glasgow, Perth, Inverness or Aberdeen


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



At SSEN Transmission, we are building a network for Net Zero \- one that's smarter, more flexible, and equipped to support the future of energy. Our mission is to deliver clean, reliable investment in the network that provides long\-lasting benefits for generations to come.



Our Network Engineering team sits within the Asset Management and Operations Directorate. We are responsible for ensuring that engineering activities across our Transmission projects and business areas are safe, technically sound and fully supported. We carry out Design and Technical Engineering Governance for the Transmission business, ensuring our network operates safely, reliably and in compliance with the relevant legislation.



As part of our journey, we are looking for a Principal Engineer \- Substations to join our specialist team. This is a key role where you will help shape technical policy, influence industry standards, and support the delivery of innovative, future\-ready projects across our high\-voltage transmission network.


**You will**


* Own and maintain technical specifications and guidance notes for substation designs, including substation earthing systems.
* Continuously improve existing specifications based on lessons learned and emerging technologies.
* Collaborate with other engineering disciplines, including Civil, LV/MV systems, Cables and Overhead Lines, while working closely with asset management and operations teams.
* Support the Design Authority and act as part of the Technical Authority, providing expert input into substation design reviews to ensure compliance with technical specifications and suitability for the transmission network.
* Represent SSEN Transmission at industry events and working groups, share best practice, offer technical consultancy across the business and mentor peers to support team development.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, with Chartered Engineer status or active progress towards it.
* Strong experience in the design, specification and application of transmission voltage substations.
* The ability to critically assess technical challenges and evaluate a range of solutions, with a solid understanding of the design, planning, operation and development requirements of the transmission network.
* Familiarity with SSE Transmission, National Grid, British and European Standards, and experience writing technical specifications, guidance notes or work instructions.
* Relevant exposure to the design, manufacturing, testing, installation or maintenance of transmission voltage plant and equipment, plus a passion for engineering excellence and helping shape the future of the UK’s transmission network.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

**Construction Project Manager**


**About IWG**


IWG is the world’s largest provider of flexible workspace, with more than **5,000 locations** across **120 \+ countries**. We bring together leading brands such as Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, as well as digital marketplace platforms such as Instant Offices, Easy Offices and Coworker. For over 35 years, we’ve enabled organisations of every size—from start\-ups and scale\-ups to 83% of the Fortune 500—to work more productively, flexibly and sustainably.


Our purpose is simple: help everyone have a great day at work—while protecting people and the planet. We offer carbon\-neutral workplaces worldwide and are progressing toward achieving **Net Zero emissions.**


In 2025, IWG delivered record system‑wide revenue of **$4\.5B** driven by rapid expansion of our capital‑light partnership model.This will continue in 2026 where we will have a target of over 1500 new centre deals as we accelerate towards our long\-term ambition of 30,000 centres world\-wide.


Join us\- www.iwgplc.com

  

**Job Purpose**


This person will manage relationships with our external partners to deliver our New Centre Openings (NCO) and refurbishment programmes on time, on budget and in line with our design standards.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Programme manage the end\-to\-end process of delivery in conjunction with our out\-sourced partners. Ensure there is clarity on expectations, deadlines and any issues or risks are escalated and dealt with in a timely manner
* Fully accountable for scope, programme and cost
* Ensure our partners manage the fit\-out so they are in line with our global design and build standards
* Plan and manage the refurbishment and maintenance of our existing estate, ensuring minimal disruption to customers and prioritising where we will maximise Return on Investment. Ensure Design and Build partners are utilised where appropriate and other contractors are effectively engaged where Design \& Build is not appropriate
* Effectively manage internal and external stakeholders so work is prioritised in line with business needs. Robustly manage supplier’s performance in line with contractual agreement whilst maintaining a positive relationship and ensuring suppliers remain engaged and committed to delivering our NCO and refurbishment objectives
* Utilise strong network of contacts so we partner with the right suppliers.

**Key measures of success are:**


* Successfully execute assigned projects within agreed costs, timeline and IWG specifications;
* Enhance the supply chain setup to meet the local market price, practice and standards;
* Provide training to new and existing vendors to ensure they fully understand IWG Design \& Construction guidelines while delivering NCO/refurbishment works.

**Required Skills, Experience \& Qualifications**


* Significant project / programme management experience gained in a fast\-paced environment such as Retail, Retail banking, Hotels or Professional consultancy.
* Used to managing multiple openings to demanding timescales and tight budget controls
* Proactive approach to problem solving and a customer first approach
* Highly commercial and results focussed \- significant experience of reducing cost whilst improving standardisation
* High drive with strong attention to detail. Can cope with a high degree of ambiguity, uncertainty and change
* Strong resilience with the ability to keep focussed on the big picture and end goal
* Previous experience of refurbishment and maintenance management is desirable
* Ability to positively influence multiple stakeholders across countries and cultures
* Experience in selecting and managing preferred partners for large Design and Build programmes through a competitive tender process would be advantageous

**What we can do for you**


You are reading the right advert if you are looking for:


* A fun, challenging, and rewarding career.
* Award\-winning induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
* Fantastic career progression opportunities.
* Access to a comprehensive selection of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

**Recruitment process**


Our recruitment process is transparent and objective, because we care about your experience with us. We will respond to you within a few days to let you know if you are moving to the interview stage. This usually starts with a 30\-minute conversation with our Global Recruitment Team, giving you the chance to learn more about us and the job. If we both feel there’s a good fit and connection, you will progress through one or two further stages, depending on the level of the position. IWG is proud to be recognised as a **Leading Employer,** every year since 2022\.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer (Civils)
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Quality Engineer (Civils)


**Location:** Sizewell C, Suffolk


**Pay:** £285\.42 PAYE £400\.82 Umbrella


**Job ID:** 2208

  



**Vacancy Overview:**

  

Are you looking for a career which is rewarding, at the cutting edge of project development and where you can really make a difference? Come and join our expanding Sizewell C (SZC) team and work on one of the most exciting and largest megaprojects in the UK, whilst being at the forefront of the UK’s climate change agenda and energy policy. Following on from the success of Hinkley Point C (HPC), the SZC Project is a nuclear new build project in Suffolk, which has obtained planning approval and Government financing support. The project has started construction and is now seeking private investment. When completed, it will provide dependable electricity to 6 million homes for 60 years, which along with renewables, will support Britain to achieve Net Zero by 2050\.

  


Job Purpose / Overview


The purpose of the Quality Engineer (QE) is to support and ensure Sizewell C (SZC) Project quality requirements are complied with across the full project life\-cycle (Contract award, Design, Procurement, Manufacture, Test, Shipping, Construction/Installation, Test/Commission and Contract close out).


The primary purpose of the Quality Engineer role is to ensure supply\-chain adherence to the contracted quality assurance and quality control requirements. QEs sit within the PDO Quality Team and are deployed to Programmes to serve this primary purpose. Day to day reporting is to the Quality Management Lead (QML). This includes supporting the development and implementation of Project


Quality Control Plans and associated inspection and surveillance activities.


Their secondary purpose is to support their programme in achieving adherence with the Integrated Management System arrangements, putting in place additional project\-specific arrangements as required and supporting the management of quality for all activities within the scope of the programme.


For a given portfolio of work, the Quality Engineer shall support the Quality Management Lead (QML) and the Quality Delivery Manager (QDM) in all quality\-related aspects associated with the supply chain. This includes ensuring that appropriate quality arrangements are established, effectively implemented, and maintained by the supply chain, drawing on lessons learned from the Hinkley Point C (HPC) project.


The Quality Engineer will also support the QDM and their respective Multi\-Discipline Teams (MDTs) by providing quality management expertise to meet project requirements. This support ensures that products and services are delivered Right First Time (RFT), in line with SZC Project goals. In addition, the Quality Engineer will promote effective issue resolution and the implementation of corrective actions to prevent recurrence.


The Quality Engineer will also support the QML in coordinating with inspection and surveillance bodies, as well as with suppliers, to ensure that effective mechanisms and arrangements are established for managing inspection and surveillance activities throughout the supply chain. This includes ensuring that inspection and surveillance plans are appropriately developed and executed in accordance with the level of associated risk.


The Quality Engineer shall also carry out their own surveillance on select construction documentation in accordance with the Surveillance Strategy and, where applicable, perform joint inspections with contracted inspection entities, in line with their own Surveillance Plans to oversee inspection performance. As part of demonstrating their ‘Intelligent Customer’ role, the QML shall measure and report quality metrics to the project, Quality function and Supply Chain Management.


The post holder will work in close collaboration with all other project functions (particularly the SZC Commercial/Supply Chain Function, the Responsible Designer and their surveillance providers) and the suppliers and their sub\-contractors to ensure that project quality is delivered consistently (safely, efficiently and right first time) compliant with the scope of work and quality arrangements.

  



Principal Accountabilities


* Planning and Documentation


* Support the development of quality (QA/QC) arrangements for deployment across the SZC organisation;


* Support the preparation and maintenance of Project Quality Control Plans (PQCPs) for each contract/project;


* Produce and maintain quality\-related documentation (e.g. procedures, specifications) as required;


* Support the implementation of the Quality Execution Plan within the programme, including monitoring compliance and reporting on performance;


* Support the development and review of supplier quality requirements within Invitation to Tender (ITT) documentation;


* Assist in ensuring that quality management processes are correctly applied across the supply chain;


Supply Chain Assurance and Governance


* Support the review, acceptance, and monitoring of Contractor Quality Assurance Plans (CQAPs);


* Provide support and guidance to contractors on CQAPs, LTQR partitioning strategies, and Quality Related Activities;


* Assist in identifying requirements for supply chain audits, support audit delivery, and track resolution of findings;


* Support the development and maintenance of effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including contracted inspection entities;


* Assist in the early identification and escalation of potential quality issues to enable timely mitigation;


Inspection, Surveillance, and Testing


* Assist in coordinating construction surveillance activities in line with contractual requirements, applying a graded approach based on nuclear safety, lessons learnt from HPC and project importance;


* Support the review of supplier Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) to ensure they are fit for purpose and appropriately distributed for internal review and witness allocation;


* Participate in joint inspections, surveillance, and audits as required;


LTQR and Records Management


* Assist in ensuring the deployment of key contractual quality requirements (e.g. GQAS, LTQR Specification, Quality Release Certificates) in accordance with the PQCP;


* Support the coordination and implementation of LTQR reviews;


* Assist in applying and tracking strategies for progressive provision of LTQRs by contractors;


Review, Acceptance, and Close\-Out


* Coordinate and support the review and acceptance of construction documentation provided by contractors;


* Support the monitoring and resolution of non\-conformances, including tracking corrective actions;


* Assist in the review and acceptance of E), End of Construction Status Reports (ECSR), and End of Erection Status Reports (EESR);


Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications, Experience


Knowledge \& Skills


Essential


* Position requires experience in project delivery, preferably in the nuclear power sector, with significant focus on project quality,


* A solid understanding of the Quality Assurance and Quality Control in major projects across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction and commissioning.


* A clear and considerable understanding of quality management best practice for deployment by large, complex and contract\-led organisations.


* Confident and proficient in the use of IT systems and digital tools


* Knowledge of Quality Systems, ISO 9001, ISO 19443, IAEA GSR\-2 and interrelated standards


* Confident and articulate communicator, able to prepare presentation material, and comfortable addressing individuals, small groups and very large audiences.


* Able to support and implement practical solutions, whilst remaining open to the ideas of others.


* Experience of interfacing with project teams and with supply chain organisations.


* Analysis of data, preparing reports and making recommendations.


* The ability to influence and to provide constructive challenge which is accepted by others.


* The ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.


* A team player who recognises how their position impacts and influences others.


* Pro\-active and flexible, being prepared to plan and work on own initiative.


* Fluent in English language.


Desirable


* Knowledge of the nuclear sector, ideally new build.


* Knowledge \& understanding of nuclear site license conditions.


* Ability to speak French is advantageous.


* Knowledge of pressure and nuclear codes


* Knowledge of Welding, Non Destructive Testing (NDT), Non\-Destructive Evaluation (NDE)


Qualifications \& Experience


Essential


* A HNC/HND qualification or degree in a relevant science or engineering subject, or equivalent qualification.


* Experience of implementing a variety of quality related solutions.


* Proven track record of delivering results.


* Proven experience working in a quality assurance/control environment within the nuclear industry or other relevant safety critical industry.


* Proven experience of interaction and resolving issues with a wide range of stakeholders in a multi\-cultural environment.


* Experience performing supplier audits.


Desirable


* Hold a professional accreditation including IRCA certified auditor


* Corporate Member or working towards membership of the Chartered Quality Institute \& Chartered Quality Professional


* Commercial exposure, especially supplier management


* Experience of interacting with regulators e.g. the ONR.


* Knowledge of Improvement Methodologies, Tools \& Techniques eg. Lean 6 Sigma

jobs.description:
**Your New Role**

  

We have a fantastic opportunity for a **permanent Maintenance Technician** to join our **TSIC** account in **Cumbernauld.** This will be an **on\-site,** mobile role working on Highways in Central Belt.

  

The **Maintenance Technician** plays an important part in undertaking planned and reactive maintenance work on highways control technology installations throughout Scotland. This includes CCTV, traffic monitoring units, variable message signs, emergency telephones and other in\-station and out\-station equipment, mainly motorway based.

 **The standard hours of work are** 40 hours per week, Monday – Friday.,

  

Our **TSIC** account is working in partnership with Traffic Scotland on behalf of Transport for Scotland since 2004\. We are responsible for operating, maintaining, and upgrading the motorway and trunk road technology infrastructure across the whole of Scotland.

  

With over 12,000 intelligent transport system (ITS) assets across Scotland our teams operate and maintain variable messaging signs, CCTV, emergency roadside telephones (ERTs) and various power and communication cabinets.

  

In addition to this, we manage and maintain hundreds of miles of the motorway and trunk road network across Scotland, as well as providing key consultancy services such as asset management, design services and environmental management.

  

Our focus is on delivering reliable journey times and a high level of customer care for the people and businesses that use these roads every day.

 **Maintenance Technician** **will be responsible for**:

* Undertaking inspections and diagnostic checks on highways control technology and electrical assets in line with planned and reactive maintenance.
* Response to urgent faults and emergency repairs.
* Completion of planned preventative maintenance and inspections and reporting in line with defined schedules.
* Ensuring that all work is carried out to current electrical and highway communications standards.
* You will also be required to work on a standby rota.

 **What makes this role unique** is that you will form part of a multi\-disciplinary team providing frontline maintenance services to ensure availability and safety of operation of Transport Scotland roadside technology assets on Scottish motorways and trunk roads.

 **We want to hear from you if you are** competent in the use of hand/powered tools and test equipment required to maintain, test and re\-commission systems. Due to the nature of this role, you **must hold a valid driving licence.**

 **Ideally** you will have a national certificate in an electronic / electrical discipline, and vocational qualifications in the electrotechnical or telecommunications field. In **addition** to this, it would be desirable if you have field installation and servicing role to help you hit the ground running, although this is not essential as we will provide you with the required development you need to bring you up to speed.

 **Why Join Us?**


At Amey, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer opportunities to build fulfilling careers. As one of the top 1% of employers recognised by Investors in People, we are committed to your professional growth and wellbeing. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

* **Competitive Salary:** Enjoy a competitive annual salary with the potential for yearly reviews to ensure you are rewarded for your contributions.

* **Career Growth:** Propel your career with clear, dynamic advancement opportunities.
* **Training Opportunities:** Unlock your potential with comprehensive training, including fully funded, tailored to your growth.
* **Personal Development Opportunities:** Advance your personal growth through mentorship and access to our award\-winning programs like our Leadership Development, Women@Amey, and Multicultural Leadership programs.
* **Pension:** Benefit from a generous pension scheme with company contributions for your future peace of mind.
* **Holidays:** Enjoy at least 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and the opportunity to buy further 5 days! Giving you plenty of time to relax and recharge.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Customise your benefits package with options like additional leave, cycle\-to\-work schemes, charitable giving, and gym memberships.
* **Exclusive Discounts:** Access our online portal filled with discounts from leading retailers, healthcare services, and more, helping you save on the things that matter.
* **Social Impact:** Take part in our community initiatives with 2x paid volunteering days a year, plus other opportunities to support fundraising and local projects.

 **Application Guidance**


At Amey, we value a culture ff diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from individuals who are passionate about making a positive impact, no matter their background, gender, race, or personal circumstances. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to shine.

  

As a Disability Confident leader, we’re proud to offer applicants with a disability an interview if they meet the minimum requirements for the role.

**Location**

Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations  Cardiff, Glasgow, or London. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow.**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**


At the forefront of the fight to protect the integrity of Britains wholesale energy markets, Ofgem is helping combat market misconduct and ensure gas and electricity markets work effectively for consumers. Were looking for a Senior Analyst to join us and bring powerful analytical insight to some of the most complex issues affecting wholesale energy markets.  

  

Ofgem is Great Britains independent energy regulator. Were at the forefront of change across the energy sector, driving toward Net Zero whilst protecting energy consumers, especially vulnerable people.  

  

Were offering a permanent, full\-time role with the chance to work at the heart of wholesale market regulation and make a meaningful impact on how these vital markets operate. Youll join our Wholesale Market Conduct team, helping promote integrity and transparency across Britains gas and electricity markets. Working across a varied and complex landscape, youll contribute to evidence\-led regulation that ultimately delivers better outcomes for consumers.  

  

This is an exciting chance to combine your understanding of wholesale markets with advanced analytical expertise, working with unique and complex datasets covering trading activity and the physical characteristics of energy producers. Youll collaborate across Ofgem and engage with major organisations across the UK and European energy landscape, gaining significant exposure while helping strengthen our response to risks within wholesale markets.  

  

Were looking for someone with a strong understanding of wholesale energy markets or trading, combined with excellent analytical and quantitative capabilities and the ability to draw robust conclusions from complex evidence. Youll also bring experience navigating complex regulatory frameworks, excellent communication skills and the technical capabilities to work effectively with large datasets.  

  

Youll have the chance to apply your expertise to high\-profile issues that directly influence the integrity of Britains wholesale energy markets. Alongside this breadth and exposure, youll benefit from excellent Civil Service pension arrangements, generous annual leave and flexible working options designed to support a positive work\-life balance.  

  

We have a critical purpose to protect the integrity and transparency of Britains wholesale gas and electricity markets, so they work effectively for consumers. Join us and help combat market misconduct, strengthen confidence in the energy market and ensure robust evidence drives action where it matters most.  

  

Read on and find out more.### **Job description**

**Key responsibilities:**

* Leading on compliance or enforcement activity in relation to wholesale market conduct issues by producing high quality, timely, and robust analysis and reports and by engaging with market participants and market operators on conduct issues.
* Build capability in the team by improving the teams analytical tools and processes for proactive monitoring of large and complex wholesale transaction datasets for potential regulation breaches.
* Making evidence\-based recommendations: identifying and escalating key issues as well as assisting in the management of risk.
* Contributing to learning and development of colleagues, by mentoring and developing team learning materials.
* Collaborating across Ofgem teams and with external stakeholders on addressing wholesale markets risks and issues.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships \-** **Internal:**

* Wholesale Market Oversight and International portfolio, including the team providing insights on wholesale gas and electricity markets developments
* Wholesale market policy teams
* Legal teams


**External:**

* National Energy System Operator (NESO)
* Energy brokers and exchanges
* Electricity generators, gas shippers and wholesale market participants
* UK and EU institutional stakeholders such as DESNZ, the FCA, ACER and other National Regulatory Authorities (NRAs).
### **Person specification**

* **Sector knowledge: An understanding of the operation of wholesale energy markets and/or experience of trading (energy, commodities or equities etc). (LEAD CRITERIA)**
* **Excellent analytical and quantitative skills. Experience in analysing complex quantitative and qualitative data and evidence to arrive at conclusions and recommendations. (LEAD CRITERIA)**
* Experience of interpreting and applying complex legislation, regulation, rules and processes to deliver effective compliance or enforcement investigations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that effectively communicate complex issues to non\-expert audiences

Connecting every home and business to a single, secure smart meter network is a huge undertaking. So you can imagine the scale – and variety – and opportunities for the people who'll help us do it.

  


**The role**
------------


**Principal Design Architect / Hybrid Location: Manchester or London**
**Closing date: 15th September 5pm**


Smart DCC is seeking an experienced Principal Design Architect to provide technical leadership across our technology landscape. This is a strategic role responsible for defining architecture roadmaps, influencing technology direction, and ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.


Working across complex programmes and operational services, you will collaborate with senior stakeholders, architects, suppliers, and delivery teams to shape the future architecture that supports Great Britain's smart metering network.


About Smart DCC
We're powering Britain's smarter, greener future. Today. Tomorrow. Together.


Today, we're building and operating the digital infrastructure that connects millions of smart meters across Great Britain.


Tomorrow, we're supporting the transition to a more flexible, sustainable energy system and helping enable the UK's net zero ambitions.


Together, we work collaboratively, challenge convention, and deliver meaningful outcomes that make a difference for consumers, customers, and the wider energy industry.


What you'll be doing
* Defining architecture strategies, standards, principles, and roadmaps across key technology domains.
* Providing technical leadership and governance for major programmes and technology initiatives.
* Ensuring solution designs align to enterprise architecture, security, resilience, and operational requirements.
* Influencing senior stakeholders and supporting technology investment decisions.
* Leading architectural reviews and assurance activities.
* Driving innovation and identifying opportunities to improve technology capabilities.
* Working with internal teams and external partners to deliver strategic technology outcomes.
* Supporting the evolution of technology platforms and services to meet future business needs.

What we're looking forEssential experience
* Significant experience in Enterprise, Solution, or Design Architecture roles.
* Strong understanding of architecture frameworks and best practices.
* Experience developing architecture strategies and technology roadmaps.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead technical decision\-making.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies, infrastructure, integration patterns, and modern architectures.
* Experience working within complex, large\-scale technology environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable experience
* Certification in architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
* Experience within regulated industries, utilities, critical national infrastructure, or highly secure environments.
* Knowledge of security architecture, resilience, risk management, and technology governance.

Why join us?
At Smart DCC, you'll work on technology that underpins one of the UK's most significant digital transformation programmes.


In return, we offer:


* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-related bonus.
* Hybrid working.
* Generous pension scheme.
* Private healthcare.
* Annual leave entitlement with the option to buy additional days.
* Flexible benefits tailored to your lifestyle.
* Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth.

Working Pattern
Hybrid working with attendance at one of our key office locations as required.


**Benefits:**
While our mission is ambitious, we also prioritise balance, offering flexibility and support to help you thrive both personally and professionally. At DCC we reward fairly and recognise fully because our continued success depends on our people.


We also offer a competitive 8 days per month hybrid work policy for most roles as well as competitive salaries with regular benchmarking, bonuses tied to personal and company performance. Our core benefits include pension, generous leave allowance, private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to your needs.

-------------------------------


Offer ID: 88862
Job: Project Managers / Construction

**Equans is looking for a Senior Retrofit Coordinator to join our team in Wath upon Dearne due to increase with work loads. This is a full\-time role. On offer is a competitive salary, company vehicle, bonus and benefits package.**


**General Overview:**


Responsible for the day\-to\-day supervision of Retrofit Coordinators in the Yorkshire regions (OU1\) alongside the management of the retrofit assessment and coordination process, including Survey Software Tool Development, Customer Journey and Trustmark Compliance on both survey and technical solutions on individual schemes as allocated


***What will you deliver?***


* To support Retrofit Coordinators in OU1 in the day to day running of schemes
* To produce and collate management data of Scheme Trackers in line with current requirements
* To work closely with the Sustainability management team / Retrofit Coordination Manager in providing and allocating training and CPD to the Retrofit Coordinators in OU1
* To work closely with The Retrofit Coordination Manager in allocating workloads to the team
* To be responsible for the overall management and delivery of the PAS2035 process, including assessment, design, installation and handover and monitoring, as defined in PAS processes

* Provide accurate and effective energy modelling using RdSAP and full SAP, and provide guidance on solutions for meeting specific scheme criteria
* Manage the PAS2035 lodgement process on TrustMark in accordance with main contract delivery programmes to allow timely draw down of funding
* Be the main technical point of contact for Retrofit Coordination and energy modelling and manage relationship with key client stakeholders delighting and exceeding customers expectations
* Set up, implement and work with external survey partners on delivering retrofit projects/schemes
  

***What can we offer you?***

  

On offer is a competitive salary, bonus and benefit package, which includes;


* 25 days annual leave (\+ public holidays)
* Life Cover equivalent to 2 times annual salary
* Single healthcare cover
* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
* Gym membership discounts
* Cycle to work scheme
* Holiday purchase scheme
* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year
* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes
* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme
* Access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in Equans), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Persons Network) and our Disability Network

***Who are we looking for?***


* Retrofit Coordinator qualified.
* Domestic Energy Assessor qualified.
* OCDEA
* Proven ability and experience of managing survey processes around housing refurbishment schemes.
* Experience of working with surveying under SHDF/ECO/LAD
* Proven experience in energy efficiency retrofit works
* Proven ability to manage teams delivering against specific output objectives.
* Experience In managing and leading a team(s)

EQUANS is a world leader in energy services with nearly 100,000 employees working in more than 50 countries, with an annual turnover of over 17 billion euros.

jobs.title: Ecologist
jobs.description:
**Ecologist**

**Location: Flexible / UK\-wide with travel to client sites as required**

**Salary: Competitive**

**Contract Type: Permanent**

**Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday\-Friday**

### **Take ownership of projects. Deliver expert ecological advice. Shape better outcomes for nature.**


You're an ecologist who enjoys solving problems, building relationships and seeing projects through from start to finish. You combine strong technical knowledge with a practical approach, and you take pride in delivering high\-quality work that balances ecological requirements with client needs.


At Ground Control, you'll join a growing Ecology Team where you'll have the opportunity to lead your own projects, influence project decisions and contribute to meaningful environmental improvements. From Biodiversity Net Gain and habitat restoration initiatives to protected species surveys and ecological impact assessments, you'll play a key role in helping clients navigate environmental challenges while delivering positive outcomes for nature.

##### **What you'll do:**


In this role, you'll manage ecological projects from initial enquiry through to delivery, providing high\-quality technical advice and building trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders.

* Deliver UKHab and protected species surveys, providing the data and insight needed to support planning, development and biodiversity objectives.
* Produce high\-quality technical reports, including PEAs, BNG Assessments, EcIAs, Habitat Management Plans, Protected Species Reports and other ecological deliverables that help clients make informed decisions.
* Analyse ecological data and develop practical mitigation, enhancement and compensation measures that achieve positive environmental outcomes.
* Manage ecological projects from inception to completion, coordinating survey programmes, timescales, resources and project delivery.
* Prepare fee proposals, quotations and tender submissions, helping to support sustainable business growth and project success.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for clients, contractors, planners and stakeholders, providing clear and credible ecological advice throughout project lifecycles.
* Support and mentor Assistant Ecologists, sharing knowledge, reviewing work and helping develop the capability of the wider team.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by promoting best practice, maintaining high technical standards and identifying opportunities to enhance project delivery.

##### **What you'll get:**

* The opportunity to manage a varied portfolio of ecology projects across multiple sectors and habitats.
* Autonomy to take ownership of your work while being supported by experienced Senior and Principal Ecologists.
* Exposure to Biodiversity Net Gain, habitat restoration, protected species licensing and complex ecological challenges.
* A role where your technical expertise directly influences environmental outcomes and client success.
* Opportunities to broaden your experience, develop specialisms and progress your ecology career.
* A collaborative and supportive team environment where knowledge sharing and professional development are actively encouraged.

##### **What we're looking for:**

* A degree (or equivalent qualification) in Ecology, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
* A minimum of three years' ecological consultancy or relevant ecological field experience.
* Membership of CIEEM, ideally Associate Member level or above.
* At least one protected species licence and experience leading or supporting licensed survey work.
* Strong knowledge of UK wildlife legislation, planning policy and ecological best practice.
* Experience undertaking UKHab surveys, protected species surveys and technical ecological reporting.
* Excellent project management and organisational skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging clients, contractors and project teams.
* A collaborative and solutions\-focused approach, with a genuine passion for delivering high\-quality ecological outcomes.
* Experience with GIS systems, Biodiversity Net Gain assessments or infrastructure projects would be advantageous.
* A full UK driving licence.


Join Ground Control and help deliver practical ecological solutions that support biodiversity, influence sustainable development and create lasting value for clients, communities and the environment.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary – aligned with your skills and experience
* Pension scheme – helping you plan for the future
* Recognition schemes – celebrating and rewarding great work
* Private GP service – fast, convenient access to medical support
* Life insurance – providing added peace of mind
* Subsidised gym membership – supporting your health and wellbeing
* Holiday buy scheme – purchase up to 5 additional days of annual leave

**Equal Opportunities Statement**


At Ground Control, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic as defined in the Equality Act 2010\.


We actively support and promote an inclusive culture, ensuring fair and equitable treatment throughout the recruitment process and across all stages of employment, including training, development, promotion, pay, and termination. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees, and to creating a working environment free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, or victimisation.


We expect all colleagues to uphold our values of dignity, respect, and inclusion. We take a zero\-tolerance approach to any form of discriminatory behaviour and are committed to continuous improvement through training, inclusive policies, and accountability at all levels. \#Maint

jobs.description:
**Base Location:** You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations Reading, Cardiff, Glasgow or Perth


**Salary:** £44,000 \- £65,900 \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent\| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As an Engineer within the Engineering function, you will support the development and delivery of electrical distribution network designs across new\-build and existing infrastructure projects.



You will assist in the production, coordination and technical delivery of LV, HV and EHV (including 132kV) electrical network designs in compliance with relevant legislation, NERS requirements, ENA G81 standards, DNO/IDNO specifications and SSE engineering governance requirements.



You will work closely with internal engineering teams, delivery teams, clients, DNOs, IDNOs and external design partners to support the safe, compliant and efficient delivery of projects from early\-stage feasibility through to construction and final network adoption.



This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop technical capability within the growing Energy Customer Solutions and ICP market while contributing to innovative engineering solutions supporting the UK’s transition to net zero.


**You will**


* Support the development of LV, HV and EHV (including 132kV) electrical distribution network designs for contestable infrastructure projects.
* Assist in producing conceptual, outline and detailed electrical designs in line with NERS, ENA G81, BS standards and DNO/IDNO requirements.
* Support feasibility studies, route assessments and equipment selection activities.
* Assist with technical assessments including load flow, fault level, voltage drop and protection coordination studies.
* Support the integration of earthing, protection, metering and SCADA requirements where applicable.
* Ensure designs are developed in accordance with CDM, SHE requirements and industry legislation


**You have**


* Degree, HNC or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering would be highly advantageous.
* Working towards professional registration such as IEng or CEng is desirable.
* Experience or understanding of electrical distribution network design across LV and HV systems.
* Awareness of NERS, ENA G81, DNO/IDNO standards, CDM 2015 Regulations and UK engineering legislation.
* Understanding of electrical network design principles including protection, earthing and cable systems.
* Experience using engineering software and AutoCAD packages is desirable.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact Zoe.Gillespie@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II, UK & ireland
jobs.description:
### **About us**


GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start\-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real\-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn\+ processed annually across 30\+ countries, we handle recurring and one\-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end\-to\-end payment platform also features AI\-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
  

  

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific.


### **The role**


Working with customers across the UK \& Ireland, you will be responsible for the successful adoption and growth of your portfolio across a variety of customers.


Your primary responsibility will be identifying a path to increase the breadth and depth of GoCardless usage and value across the customers footprint. You will need to work closely with your account team to map the scope by customer, identify stakeholders, assess risk/opportunity and create an execution plan.


As a part of our wider success team, you will also work closely with Professional Services to drive implementation and time to value, our Customer Advocacy team to enhance the customer experience and share success stories, and Renewal Managers to work towards retention alongside a dedicated Account Executive for expansion and growth opportunities.


You will own the customer lifecycle, delivering value at each milestone and will be excited to drive the awareness and uptake of GoCardless as an account to account payments provider offering Bank Debit alongside our Open Banking capabilities.


### **As a CSM at GoCardless you will:**


* Demonstrate strategic ownership of your BOB by operating independently, proactively identifying solutions to challenges and blockers, and leveraging direction from CS leadership when required
* Manage a book of business (BOB) and ensure delivery against milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, aligned with our team’s business KPIs.
* Demonstrate strategic ownership of your BOB by operating independently, proactively identifying solutions to challenges and blockers, and leveraging direction from CS leadership when required
* Drive commercial discussions with customers by devising strategies to drive positive Net Revenue Retention.
* Own and execute Account Plans tailored to each customer's strategic goals, positioning GoCardless as a trusted partner.
* Partner with the Account Management and Sales team on Account Planning and driving total book of business growth through competitive, market and whitespace analysis.
* Share commercial ownership of the Account Commercial Success including the need to Identify, nurture and close expansion opportunities across the base.
* Identify and build a strong relationship with key stakeholders including C\-suite, champions and end\-users.
* Work Cross functionally and collaboratively involving leadership across the business to drive customer value.
* Mitigate risk including managing renewals for existing customers
* Forecasting accountability for your owned book of business

### **What excites us:**


* 4\+ years experience in complex end\-to\-end client facing work environment
* 4\+ years experience with CS/Sales and/or Account Management
* Additional languages a plus
* Be a team player and have a growth mindset
* Strong listening and verbal communication skills: you will need to quickly understand customer needs or issues and deliver a clear and concise response via video calls, emails, in person meetings
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Be a good collaborator and can motivate or maintain enthusiasm of your team members
* Finance/Payments industry experience is a plus

**Base salary range:** £37,120 \- £55,680


Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid\-point (£37,120 \- £46,400\) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.


### **(some of) The good stuff**


* **Wellbeing** \- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
* **Work away scheme** \- gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
* **Adaptive Working** \- allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
* **Parental leave** \- to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
* **Learning Budget** \- lead your own development with an annual learning budget
* **Time off** \- generous holiday allowance, \+ 3 annual volunteer days, \+ 4 annual business\-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)

### **Life at GoCardless**

We're an organisation defined by our values; We *start with why* before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We *act with integrity*, always. We *care deeply* about what we do and we know it's essential that we *be humble* whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic\- the reason we all love showing up to work.


### **Diversity \& Inclusion**


As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.


To ensure that we're representative of the world around us \- and to be able to review relevant benchmarks \- we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024\). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:


Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — **25%**


Neurodiverse — **9%**


LGBTQIA\+ — **9%**


Disabled — **1%**


Average age — **33**


Female — **45%**


Male — **55%**


We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

  

  

  

**Sustainability**
  

  

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations.


Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

jobs.description:

REF6194A

  

  

Company Description  

  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.


**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.


Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L\&G to do what they do best.


Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.

  

  

Job Description  

  

Join our centralised Transaction Reporting Team, where you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the accurate and timely reporting of trade and transaction data across a wide range of financial products. Working in a business‑critical environment, you’ll help us meet our regulatory obligations, strengthen our reporting controls, and contribute to continuous improvement across our processes. This is an excellent opportunity to build specialist expertise in a dynamic regulatory landscape while collaborating with teams across the organisation.


What you’ll be doing:


* Executing daily and periodic transaction reporting processes to support regulatory compliance
* Performing reconciliations and investigating discrepancies across reporting datasets
* Maintaining high standards of data quality through proactive oversight and robust controls
* Supporting business‑as‑usual reporting activities while identifying improvements to efficiency
* Escalating reporting issues, risks, and delays clearly and promptly
* Reviewing and enhancing procedures in line with regulatory and business changes
