jobs.title: Front End Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Convergence Group, we’ve spent the last 20 years building a business that lasts \- powered by resilience, continuous improvement, and a strong commitment to our customers. As we enter an exciting phase of growth, we’re looking for a Front End Software Engineer with strong React.js skills to help us design and build the next generation of software that powers our bespoke customer portal and internal systems.


**What it’s like here**


The pace and intensity are higher than most environments in our sector. The workload is typically around 30% greater than many people will have experienced elsewhere \- not because we are chaotic, but because we are ambitious and constantly building. We grow organically and through acquisition, continuously integrating, improving and raising the bar. The landscape evolves, priorities shift, and expectations rise. If you prefer a predictable, static environment, this probably won’t feel comfortable. If you are energised by growth, movement and high standards, it can be deeply rewarding.


Your strengths will have a bigger platform here \- and you will be stretched behaviourally more than in most environments. We value respectful honesty: anyone can challenge an idea; hierarchy doesn’t protect thinking and getting it right matters more than being right. Ego doesn’t perform well here; curiosity, learning and ownership do. We hire people who are already strong at their craft \- the stretch at Convergence Group is navigating pace, complexity and constant evolution. This environment isn’t for everyone, but for the right person it offers an exceptional opportunity for impact, growth and accelerated development.


**What you’ll be doing as our Front End Software Engineer:**


* Build and maintain high\-quality, scalable web applications using web development frameworks and libraries (e.g. React, Next.js, Blazor) JavaScript, TypeScriptand Azure services.
* Design intuitive front\-end experiences and robust back\-end logic with seamless client\-server integration.
* Implement new features using frameworks, APIs, and databases.
* Ensure software quality with unit, integration, and automated testing.
* Collaborate in Agile environments (e.g. Scrum or Kanban) \- participating in standups, sprint planning, and delivery.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.
* Engage in code reviews to maintain standards, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Drive improvements across the SDLC: tools, pipelines, architecture, and documentation.


**What we’re looking for**

* A minimum of 3 years’ experience of React.js
* Knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks such as Next.js or Blazor
* Proven front end development experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience working knowledge of Azure cloud services and SQL databases
* A solid grasp of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices
* Hands\-on experience managing and integrating 3rd party or internal API’s
* Familiarity with tools like Postman, Swagger, or similar platforms for testing and validating API requests and responses
* Comfort with Agile methodologies using Scrum or Kanban
* Good understanding of UX / UI principles, and the ability to translate complex requirements from BA’s and Stakeholders into effective solutions
* Technologies it’s useful to know include: Laravel, C\#, Knockout.js
* Bonus points forexposure to IT service management tools such as ServiceNow and experience working within a fast\-paced SME environment


**What you’ll get**


* **Salary:** £50\-60,000 for experienced A players
* **Time off:** 33 days holiday, including bank holidays (and yes, it gets better)
* **Benefits:** Private Medical, enhanced Pension, Income Protection \& Life Assurance
* **Work\-life balance:** flexible core hours \+ hybrid working with 3 days a week in the Solihull office
* **Dog friendly office** \- yes really!


**Who are Convergence Group?**

At Convergence Group, we break free from corporate red tape as a privately\-owned company, driving bold innovation without the constraints of private equity or external bankers. Experts in Wan, Lan, WiFi and Security solutions we stand out by revolutionising infrastructure management – making it seamless so our customers can focus on what matters most. With rapid growth ahead, we need exceptional talent who bring the right skills, attitude, and drive to shape the future with us.


**Where A\-Players come to make a difference**


If you’re a Front\-End Software Engineer who thrives on tackling complex systems, writing clean, maintainable code, and collaborating with a smart, high\-performing team, we want to hear from you. Join us and take ownership of solutions that shape the future of connectivity, in an environment where your skills, curiosity, and drive will be stretched \- and rewarded. Apply now to make an impact and grow your career with Convergence Group.

jobs.title: Principal Ecologist
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a **Principal Ecologist** to join our growing Nature Services team. You’ll work alongside a supportive network of technical specialists on a rich variety of projects across Scotland and Ireland. We need an enthusiastic and adaptable individual to enable project delivery with a willingness to learn and grow with our team and support the growth of others.


**Why This Role Matters**

Our portfolio of ecology projects in Scotland and beyond is extensive and rapidly evolving, and WSP is helping to lead this change working with clients, government, planners and consultees to shape better outcomes for nature, society, and the environment.


Joining our team means you’ll be at the forefront of delivery while receiving full support to grow your expertise, build your confidence, and develop into a highly skilled ecological practitioner.


We welcome applications from individuals who may not tick every box just yet but are eager to learn, develop and make a difference.


**What You’ll Be Doing**

**As a Principal Ecologist, you will:**

* Embrace our Health, Safety and Wellbeing culture and create a safe place for all to work.
* Provide motivational leadership and line management for team members at various grades including overseeing workload planning and forecasting, whilst guiding and supporting professional development.
* Support the Team Lead/Deputy Team Lead with day\-to\-day project resourcing and through proactively contributing to effective team management in areas such as health and safety, technical training, recruitment, and chairing of meetings.
* Plan and undertake ecology surveys including Phase 1/ UKHab habitat surveys and protected species surveys (badger, otter, bat, amphibians and reptiles, etc).
* Prepare and review tenders and a range of ecological deliverables including Preliminary Ecological Appraisals, Ecological Impact Assessments, Protected Species Reports, Habitats Regulations Appraisals, technical reports and mitigation licence applications.
* Undertake client liaison and project management.
* Conduct consultation and negotiation with regulators and stakeholders.
* Mentor junior team members whilst helping to nurture an enthusiastic, supportive, and productive working environment.
* Build and maintain a visible internal and external profile as a technical expert and collaborative leader.
* Participate in weekly and monthly Nature Services team meetings and national initiatives.
* Deepen your technical expertise and pursue professional development supported by colleagues and through formal training.
Harness your potential to develop specific skillsets and share technical knowledge and opportunities for learning and innovations with colleagues.  
* 

**What We’re Looking For**

* A relevant academic qualification in ecology or a related subject.
* Full membership of CIEEM (ideally working towards full chartership) or eligible to apply.
* Proven relevant experience of motivating and leading others, including supporting team development and managing project workloads.
* Advanced technical knowledge and competency in designing, planning and undertaking ecology desk\-based and field\-based surveys within the UK such as botanical survey and habitat classification and/or protected species surveys across a broad range of habitats and seasons, and use of H\&S practices including site risk assessments.
* Ability to produce and review high quality, technically and scientifically robust ecological reports and other project deliverables including Preliminary Ecological Appraisals, Ecological Impact Assessments, Protected Species Reports, Habitats Regulations Appraisals, and Environmental Statement chapters.
* Proven relevant experience gained within a professional consultancy, regulatory and/or industrial role(s) with strong communication and organisation skills.
* Proven relevant experience of project and budget management, preparing proposals and client engagement, including ability to demonstrate effective time management and delivery across multiple projects would be an advantage.
* Advanced technical knowledge and competency of relevant ecology policy and guidance (particularly within Scotland), including excellent attention to detail in analysis and interpretation of ecological data would be an advantage.
* A technical specialism or hold (or have held) protected species survey and/or mitigation licences would be an advantage.
A desire to develop your core ecological and consultancy skills and be supported by a team of ecologists and other environmental professionals.  
* 

**Who You’ll Work With**

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Edinburgh, Glasgow and Belfast and contribute to a wide range of projects, including:


* Nationally significant infrastructure projects
* Renewable energy developments
* Utility refurbishment programmes
Smaller flood defence, active travel and green spaces projects  
* 

You’ll also work alongside experts in Biodiversity Net Gain, natural capital, ornithology, freshwater and marine ecology, arboriculture, landscape architecture, hydrology, engineering and geotechnical specialisms.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?


**With us, you can. Apply today.**

\#LI\-MB1


  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.


**Flex your time**

To enhance work\-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.


We also provide part\-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.


**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.


**\#WeAreWSP**

*Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

jobs.title: Head of Participant Interests
jobs.description:
We are Allwyn UK, part of the Allwyn Entertainment Group – a multi\-national lottery operator with a market\-leading presence across Europe which includes: Czech Republic, Austria, Greece, Cyprus \& Italy.
 

While the main contribution of The National Lottery to society is through the funds to good causes, at Allwyn we put our purpose and values at the heart of everything we do. Join us as we embark on a once\-in\-a\-lifetime, largescale transformation journey by creating a National Lottery that delivers more money to good causes.


We’ll talk a bit more about us further down the page, but for now – let’s talk about the role and who we’re looking for…

  



**A bit about the role…**


Lead Allwyn's Participant Interests strategy by combining regulatory excellence, customer insight, digital innovation and external best practice to create safe, sustainable player experiences that support commercial growth and maximise returns to Good Causes


The Participant Interests team leads the business on responsible play. We are considered subject matter experts and work extensively with internal and external stakeholders to identify, address and manage PI activities that align with our world\-leading ambition and our regulatory requirements. We work closely with commercial functions to enable the business to achieve its ambitious commercial goals and unlock growth opportunities. We are outward looking, always seeking to learn about best practice from other companies and external stakeholders, and managing reputational risks associated with PI.

 **What you’ll be doing…**

* Act as the organisation's expert on emerging external trends, regulation, responsible play, digital consumer protection and player wellbeing, translating insights into strategy and action.
* Develop and embed PI strategy and plans aligned to international best practice and doing “all we can”
* Partner with Product, Digital, Marketing and Commercial teams to design responsible\-by\-design customer experiences and identify opportunities that drive customer trust, engagement and sustainable growth.
* Where necessary, provide independent challenge and strategic guidance to commercial teams, ensuring growth initiatives are balanced against participant protection obligations, customer wellbeing considerations and reputational risk
* Lead on the evaluation and improvement of the PI plan, aligned to overall strategy
* Work cross\-functionally to embed PI initiatives and requirements aligned to overall strategy, and in alignment with licence requirements
* Lead the PI team’s annual planning process and strategic development
* Line manage the two Senior PI Managers, who are responsible for day\-to\-day delivery
* Ensure cross\-functional projects are compliant with the requirements of the Responsible Gaming Framework and strategy
* Ensure key internal and external stakeholders and governance groups, e.g. PPSG, PPAG are included in decision making and kept up to date with progress (including proposing agendas, preparing materials, briefing Execs ahead of external stakeholder meetings etc.)
* Utilise data, behavioural insight and technology to measure effectiveness and develop innovative participant protection interventions. Lead on functional compliance and risk activities
* Prepare high quality materials for Exec\-level forums, Board and Gambling Commission

 **What experience we’re looking for…**

* Proven track record of leading customer protection, responsible play or consumer risk strategies, leveraging data, insight and external best practice to influence business outcomes
* An excellent understanding of consumer protection practices and the gaming industry
* Experience in developing strategies
* Experienced at presenting information and constructing clear reports and persuasive arguments
* Involvement in meetings with senior and executive management, including leading discussions
* Ability to analyse data at a high level
* Previous experience of managing and leading projects
* Knowledge and practical experience of working with external benchmarks
* Excellent stakeholder management skills

 **Key Measures of Success:**

* Overall plans delivered on time, high quality and on budget
* PI plan effective at meeting licence conditions and unlocking growth opportunities
* Risk and compliance activities completed on time
* Excellent internal stakeholder relationships and positive external stakeholder relationships as required

 **About us:
‍**

We’ve developed ground\-breaking technologies, built player protection frameworks, and have a proven track record of making lotteries better.


Innovation \- We pride ourselves on it! We’re constantly looking for new ways to excite our customers, bringing new products to enjoy which is all underpinned by our responsible play values and making them accessible to all.


Giving back – Did you know that playing the lottery generates around £30m a week for charities and good causes in the UK? Our aim is to have doubled this number by the end of the first 10 year licence


Sustainability – Our aim to be net zero by 2030 which would make us the first lottery provider globally to achieve this


Inclusion and accessibility – We are making all parts of The National Lottery inclusive – whether you play a game in a store or online.  



If you need any assistance or adjustments to this job description or in the application process, please contact a member of the talent team at careers@allwyn.co.uk and we’ll be happy to help.  



\*\*Being the custodians of the National Lottery license is a big responsibility, so all of our roles are subject to extensive background checks\*\*

  



At Allwyn, we’ve put together a range of inclusive benefits and policies to support our colleagues at every stage of their lives and careers. Here’s a list of some of the fantastic benefits we offer…


* Company bonus scheme
* Matched pension contributions up to 8\.5%
* 26 days annual leave \+ 2 Life Days (and bank holidays)
* Complimentary Private Medical
* Life Assurance
* Enhanced Maternity \& Paternity leave
* £500 wellness allowance
* Access to nutritional advisor and personal trainers
* Discounted Health Assessments
* Complimentary Financial coaching

  



Our benefits and policies reflect our commitment to wellbeing and inclusivity and are enhanced with features that benefit our colleagues (and their families). By offering a variety of benefits that support our colleagues, we continue to create a place of work where people feel rewarded and can succeed.

  



**A place of belonging…**

We want to create one of the UK’s most inclusive organisations – where people can bring the best of themselves, to do their best work, every day, for the benefit of good causes.


Allwyn is an Equal Opportunity Employer which prides itself in being diverse and inclusive. We do not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or victimisation in the workplace. All employment decisions at Allwyn are based on the business needs, the job requirements, and the individual qualifications. Allwyn encourages applications from individuals regardless of age, disability (visible or hidden), sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

jobs.title: C++ Senior Software Engineer – Manchester
jobs.description:
Location
Manchester , United Kingdom


Engineering


Experienced professionals


  
**Location(s): UK, Europe \& Africa : UK : Manchester**

  

BAE Systems Digital Intelligence is home to 4,500 digital, cyber and intelligence experts. We work collaboratively across 10 countries to collect, connect and understand complex data, so that governments, nation states, armed forces and commercial businesses can unlock digital advantage in the most demanding environments.

  

**C\+\+ Senior Software Engineer**


**Location: Manchester**
  

These roles require 5 days/ week on site. We offer a range of flexible working arrangements – please speak to your recruiter about the options for this particular role.
  

  

**Who we are**
  

Join BAE Systems and you’ll be part of something bigger. As a valued member of our global colleague network, you’ll bring your unique skills and perspectives to help pioneer progress and protect what matters most. You’ll be trusted to play your part in delivering the advanced, technology\-led defence, aerospace and security solutions of tomorrow – shaping a safer future, for all of us.
  

From the depths of the ocean, to the far reaches of space – there’s no limit to where a career at BAE Systems could take you.
  

  

**Role description**
  

We are looking for experienced C\+\+ Software Engineers who want to have a real impact, and who are keen to apply their creative thinking to the ever\-changing space of cybersecurity.

  

**Core duties**


* Technical delivery: understand and use various development methodologies to deliver solutions to our customers, factoring in operational security into system design, development, and testing.
* Mentorship, team\-leadership, and collaboration: work in teams to deliver high\-assurance code, conducting constructive peer review, and knowledge sharing with junior team\-members.
* Implementing robust solutions: design, develop, test, and document software in accordance with business \& industry best practices, to meet our customer requirements, leveraging continuous integration where appropriate.
* Adaptability: embrace emerging technology, tools, and language trends, while identifying the risks that they could present.
* Security mindset: be capable of identifying flaws during solution design and implementation, along with mitigations.
  

**What we’re looking for**:


* Familiarity with a variety of development tools (IDEs, debuggers, source control) and techniques (unit testing, mocking, continuous integration, test\-driven development).
* Knowledge of the principles of high\-assurance development, and an awareness of the importance of IT security for companies and governments.
* Intermediate to advanced understanding of computing principles (e.g. stack/heap distinction, compiled/interpreted languages).
* Proficiency with at least one solution language (e.g. C\+\+, Java, C\#) and one utility language (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Perl, PowerShell).
* Ability to use and configure more than one major operating system.
* Ability to pick up new languages and technologies easily.
* Ability to communicate regarding technical topics to a variety of audiences, including non\-technical.
* Experience of mentoring others and/or leading technical tasks.
  

**The team**
  

Operational Cyber Group is a team of industry\-leading experts in high\-assurance development, research, reverse engineering, and vulnerability research.With a focus on National Security, we work on some of the country’s toughest challenges. Our people provide mission\-changing capability for our customers across a wide variety of platforms and technologies.

  

  

**Why BAE Systems?**
  

Here you’ll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work – this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. You’ll be recognised for your contribution and enjoy rewards tailored to what’s most important to you and your family – support for your financial and personal wellbeing, as well as a balanced lifestyle. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make.
  

A place where everyone can thrive.
  

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do.
  

We welcome applications from all candidates and give full, fair and open consideration to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team to discuss any further support you may need.

  

  

**Security statement**
  

Please be aware that many roles at BAE Systems are subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. All applicants must as a minimum achieve Baseline Personnel Security Standard. Many roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting where applicants must typically have 5 to 10 years of continuous residency in the UK depending on the vetting level required for the role, to allow for meaningful security vetting checks.
  

Applicants for these particular roles will need to be able to successfully achieve an eDV UK security clearance. For more details see https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united\-kingdom\-security\-vetting\-clearance\-levels/dv\-guidance\-pack\-for\-applicants

  



**Life at BAE Systems Digital Intelligence**


We are embracing Hybrid Working. This means you and your colleagues may be working in different locations, such as from home, another BAE Systems office or client site, some or all of the time, and work might be going on at different times of the day.

We are proud to have an organisational culture where employees with varying perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds – the best and brightest minds – can work together to achieve excellence and realise individual and organisational potential.

At BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, we pride ourselves in being a leader in the cyber defence industry, and Capabilities is the engine that keeps the business moving forward. It is the largest area of Digital Intelligence, containing our Engineering, Consulting and Project Management teams that design and implement the defence solutions and digital transformation projects that make us a globally recognised brand in both the public and private sector.


As a member of the Capabilities team, you will be creating and managing the solutions that earn us our place in an ever changing digital world. We all have a role to play in defending our clients, and this is yours.


Engineering


Experienced professionals

jobs.title: Specialist Speech & Language Therapist Neurosciences
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about providing a high quality Speech and Language Therapy (SLT) service to adult inpatients with neurological impairments? Are you looking for the chance to develop your career in a prestigious London Trust with access to highly skilled clinicians and multiple learning opportunities?
  
  

We are looking for a specialist SLT to join our service in a split post across the Charing Cross Neuro\-Rehabilitation Unit (CNRU) \- a 15 bedded level\-2 neuro\-rehab unit \- and our Stroke Wards, primarily our HASU. The services have dedicated multidisciplinary teams in which SLT has a high profile. CNRU receives patients from across North\-West London and from our local stroke units, major trauma centre, and neurology and neurosurgical wards.
  
  

As a valued member of the speech \& language therapy and multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to holistic inter\-disciplinary working, further developing your clinical skills in the management of dysphagia and acquired communication disorders. You will be actively involved in service development and training of others. The post\-holder will provide support to Therapy Support Workers as well as supervise students on placement. Staff are encouraged and supported to participate in CPD activities.
  
  

The postholder will participate in a pilot of a Saturday service within Stroke, providing approximately 3 Saturdays in a 6 month period, with a day off in lieu during the week.
  
  

The post holder will be part of the multidisciplinary teams working on the Charing Cross Neuro\-Rehabilitation Unit (CNRU) \- a 15 bedded level\-2 neuro\-rehabilitation service provided to patients from North\-West London boroughs \- and rapid access to acute rehabilitation service to Stroke or Neurosciences wards.
  
  

The post holder will provide a specialist SLT service to adult inpatients with disorders of communication and/or swallowing arising from acquired neurological conditions, underpinned by current evidence based practice.
  
  

The post holder will receive regular support and supervision from a Band 7 SLT. They will continue to gain wider clinical experience and expertise through clinical support and be able to make independent clinical decisions concerning caseload management.
  
  

The post holder will also develop skills across the other pillars of practice, including facilitating learning, leadership, and service development, both within SLT and across the wider MDT.

Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.

jobs.title: Asset Optimisation Manager
jobs.description:
**Asset Optimisation Manager**
==============================

 **Stark \| Infrastructure \- Assets**

  

We're looking for an **Asset Optimisation Manager** to join our Infrastructure \- Assets team and play a key role in maximising the commercial performance of Stark's growing portfolio of infrastructure, EV charging and net\-zero assets.


Stark is continuing to grow across Stark Infra, Stark Charge and Stark Zero, with responsibility for adopting and operating assets including gas and electricity networks, EV charge points and net\-zero technologies such as solar and battery storage.


This is a varied and high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of commercial performance, data, revenue assurance, customer outcomes and regulatory compliance. You'll be responsible for identifying opportunities to increase revenue, improve asset utilisation, strengthen data quality and ensure we're getting maximum value from our growing asset portfolio.


You'll also lead and develop a team of Asset Analysts, building the capability, processes and systems needed to support the continued growth of the function.


If you're commercially minded, analytical, confident working with large datasets and enjoy turning information into actionable business decisions, this is an opportunity to have a real impact on Stark's growth.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

### **Commercial Performance \& Asset Optimisation**

* Take ownership of the commercial performance of Stark's asset portfolio, identifying opportunities to maximise revenue and asset value.
* Monitor asset profitability, utilisation, revenue recovery and performance trends, identifying areas for improvement and taking corrective action.
* Lead initiatives designed to improve asset returns, operating performance, customer outcomes and commercial arrangements.
* Identify new opportunities to increase revenue and improve the financial performance of the portfolio.
* Provide clear, commercially focused recommendations to senior stakeholders to support investment and portfolio decisions.

### **Revenue Assurance \& Data**

* Lead revenue assurance activities, ensuring all billable activity is accurately captured, validated and reported to Finance.
* Take accountability for the integrity, accuracy and completeness of asset performance data across operational systems.
* Use data and insight to identify revenue leakage, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Support accurate forecasting and performance reporting across the asset portfolio.
* Ensure high\-quality asset data is available to support regulatory reporting, audits and commercial decision\-making.

### **Compliance \& Governance**

* Ensure regulated activities remain compliant with relevant licence obligations, contractual requirements and regulatory standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems to strengthen compliance and the quality of outputs.
* Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure appropriate governance is embedded across asset management activities.
* Support audit and assurance activity by ensuring robust processes, records and reporting are in place.

### **Systems, Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**

* Create, analyse and present meaningful asset performance reporting to senior stakeholders.
* Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support better business decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes and ways of working across the function.
* Lead changes that improve efficiency, customer outcomes, revenue performance and asset data quality.
* Continuously look for ways to make the business more effective as the Stark Infra, Charge and Zero portfolios grow.

### **Leadership \& Team Development**

* Lead, motivate and develop the Asset Optimisation team, creating a high\-performing culture focused on commercial performance, compliance and customer outcomes.
* Establish the processes, structures and capabilities required to support the continued growth of the team.
* Set clear objectives and performance measures aligned to wider business goals.
* Coach and develop Asset Analysts, building expertise across asset optimisation, commercial analysis, revenue assurance and regulatory compliance.
* Identify future resource and capability requirements and contribute to workforce planning.
* Ensure the team has the skills, systems and processes required to support Stark's expanding asset portfolio.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------


We're looking for someone who combines commercial awareness, analytical capability and strong people leadership.


You'll ideally bring:

* Experience in a commercial, analytical, asset management, revenue assurance or performance management environment.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability and asset value.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with confidence working with large and complex datasets.
* Experience of revenue assurance, financial analysis, forecasting or performance management.
* The ability to turn data into clear insights and make practical, commercially focused recommendations.
* Experience managing, developing and motivating a team, with the confidence to set expectations and hold people accountable.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly to senior audiences.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, together with confidence using business systems and databases.
* A proactive approach to identifying opportunities, solving problems and improving processes.
* The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across different areas of the business.
* A strong customer focus and an understanding of how commercial decisions can impact customer outcomes.

### **It would be great if you also have:**

* Experience within energy, utilities, infrastructure, EV, renewable energy or another regulated industry.
* Knowledge of electricity or gas networks, EV charging infrastructure or net\-zero technologies.
* Experience working with asset management, billing, revenue or operational systems.
* Experience working within a regulated environment and an understanding of licence or regulatory obligations.
* Experience leading business improvement or systems\-change initiatives.
* A background in commercial performance, asset optimisation or revenue assurance.

**Why join Stark?**
-------------------


Stark is a growing technology\-based business operating at the heart of the energy and utilities sector. We're developing innovative solutions that help businesses understand and manage their energy and utility requirements while supporting the infrastructure needed for a lower\-carbon future.


Our Infra, Charge and Zero businesses are areas of significant growth, giving you the opportunity to work across a diverse and evolving portfolio of assets.

  

This is a role where you can genuinely influence business performance. You'll have the opportunity to shape how we optimise our assets, improve revenue, develop our data and systems, and build a high\-performing Asset Optimisation team.


Stark Group is an equal opportunities employer. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is valued for their skills, experience and perspective, and where our people can bring their whole selves to work.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:  

  

Integrity – Collaboration \- Relationships – Excellence – Creativity \- Results



Join Us,



Concentric \- "Your World Secured"


We are currently looking to hire a **Residential Security Officer (SO)** to join our **Embedded team (SPS)** in **Kensington, London.**  

  

* **Must live within daily commuting distance of Kensington, London (No accommodation supplied.) Parking onsite.**

  

* **This position requires working day and night shifts on a Four On then Four Off rotation (Over\-time Available) as part of a larger security team at a High Net Worth Residential property.**

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

It is paramount that the following duties and responsibilities are carried out by the Residential Security Officer (SO) in accordance with the task and client requirements. All company policies and procedures must be adhered to at all times to ensure that operational and regulatory safety requirements are met.

* Perform your daily duties to the highest professional standards

* React quickly and professionally to all emergencies and incidents
* Ensure that all client operations are managed/conducted in accordance with SOIs
* Ensure that any deviations from the SOIs are immediately documented and reported to the global response centre

* Provide an accurate and timely written report in the event of an incident

The reputation of the company rests largely on the performance and behaviour of individual employees. Therefore,  

all employees are to ensure they maintain the highest professional standards in all matters whilst deployed.

* Arrive punctually and correctly dressed at the appointed place of duty

* Make and receive all "check calls" as directed
* Send a daily report after completion of the day shift


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**


* Staff must be of a physical standard to be able to:
* Patrol premises on a regular basis
* Be able to assist the client if injured or needs evacuating
* Walk and deal with dogs
* Assist with heavy deliveries


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.
* Must live within daily commuting distance of Kensington, London (No accommodation supplied) Parking onsite

* SIA qualified
* Minimum first aid at work qualification

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Military or police experience (Not essential)

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager I, UK & ireland
jobs.description:
### **About us**


GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start\-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real\-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn\+ processed annually across 30\+ countries, we handle recurring and one\-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end\-to\-end payment platform also features AI\-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
  

  

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific.


### **The role**


Working with customers across the UK \& Ireland, you will be responsible for the successful adoption and growth of your portfolio across a variety of customers.


Your primary responsibility will be identifying a path to increase the breadth and depth of GoCardless usage and value across the customers footprint. You will need to work closely with your account team to map the scope by customer, identify stakeholders, assess risk/opportunity and create an execution plan.


As a part of our wider success team, you will also work closely with Professional Services to drive implementation and time to value, our Customer Advocacy team to enhance the customer experience and share success stories, and Renewal Managers to work towards retention alongside a dedicated Account Executive for expansion and growth opportunities.


You will own the customer lifecycle, delivering value at each milestone and will be excited to drive the awareness and uptake of GoCardless as an account to account payments provider offering Bank Debit alongside our Open Banking capabilities.


### **As a CSM at GoCardless you will:**


* Manage a book of business (BOB) and ensure delivery against milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, aligned with our team’s business KPIs.
* Demonstrate strategic ownership of your BOB by operating independently, proactively identifying solutions to challenges and blockers, and leveraging direction from CS leadership when required
* Drive commercial discussions with customers by devising strategies to drive positive Net Revenue Retention.
* Own and execute Account Plans tailored to each customer's strategic goals, positioning GoCardless as a trusted partner.
* Partner with the Account Management and Sales team on Account Planning and driving total book of business growth through competitive, market and whitespace analysis.
* Share commercial ownership of the Account Commercial Success including the need to Identify, nurture and close expansion opportunities across the base.
* Identify and build a strong relationship with key stakeholders including C\-suite, champions and end\-users.
* Work Cross functionally and collaboratively involving leadership across the business to drive customer value.
* Mitigate risk including managing renewals for existing customers
* Forecasting accountability for your owned book of business

### **What excites us:**


* 2\+ years experience in complex end\-to\-end client facing work environment
* 2\+ years experience with CS/Sales and/or Account Management
* Additional languages a plus
* Be a team player and have a growth mindset
* Strong listening and verbal communication skills: you will need to quickly understand customer needs or issues and deliver a clear and concise response via video calls, emails, in person meetings
* Ability to manage conflicting priorities and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Be a good collaborator and can motivate or maintain enthusiasm of your team members
* Finance/Payments industry experience is a plus

**Base salary range:** £27,976 \- £40,200


Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid\-point (£27,976 \- £33,680\) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.


### **(some of) The good stuff**


* **Wellbeing** \- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
* **Work away scheme** \- gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
* **Adaptive Working** \- allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
* **Parental leave** \- to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
* **Learning Budget** \- lead your own development with an annual learning budget
* **Time off** \- generous holiday allowance, \+ 3 annual volunteer days, \+ 4 annual business\-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)

### **Life at GoCardless**

We're an organisation defined by our values; We *start with why* before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We *act with integrity*, always. We *care deeply* about what we do and we know it's essential that we *be humble* whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic\- the reason we all love showing up to work.


### **Diversity \& Inclusion**


As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.


To ensure that we're representative of the world around us \- and to be able to review relevant benchmarks \- we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024\). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:


Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — **25%**


Neurodiverse — **9%**


LGBTQIA\+ — **9%**


Disabled — **1%**


Average age — **33**


Female — **45%**


Male — **55%**


We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

  

  

  

**Sustainability**
  

  

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations.


Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Pharmacist
jobs.description:
Package Description

On top of your salary, we also offer:

* Location benefits including relocation support (up to £8k) and Welcome to Well bonus (£5K net payment) – varies depending on location, please check with our Resourcing Team
* GPhC / PSNI and DBS/ PVG fees paid
* Fully supported career development
* Opportunity to become an LPC representative
* Bonus scheme
* Pension Scheme
* Generous holiday allowance
* Employee discount


We can offer consistent rotas and geographical coverage that suits you.


But there is much more we offer in terms of developing and growing your career.


You’ll be supported in your role by an Area Operations Manager and a Regional Operations Manager, with regular structured pharmacy visits


We have invested in new technologies for our pharmacies including a new PMR system and centralised dispensing to allow you to focus on providing quality care and services to our customers.


We are focussed on mental health and wellbeing which is why we’ve put all our field managers through the Mental Health Awareness course to raise awareness and enable a greater level of support when working in our pharmacies.


So you’ll have much more than just a salary package, its about you as a person and your professional career too!


Overview of the role

We are looking for an experienced Pharmacist to join the team and make a difference at our pharmacy in Calne.


This community pharmacy is commutable from surrounding cities/ towns/ villages and is located on a. high street. It has a good relationship with the local GP surgery/health centre.

**How our pharmacy makes a difference:**

* It dispenses up to 2000 items a week,
* It provides a wide range of services including blood pressure, ABPM, pharmacy first, nms, flu covid, meningitis B, travel vaccines and a range of private services.
* It provides services to 5 substance misuse patients.
* It dispenses 90 community blisters mainly dispensed from our central hub.


This pharmacy is open Monday \- Friday 8\.30am \- 6pm.


The dynamic team at this pharmacy is comprised of 5 qualified pharmacy assistants/ dispensers working a mixture of full and part time.


The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate must possess an MPharm degree or equivalent and management experience is desired but not essential. You will be required to have your GPhC registration upon your start date.

*Well are proud to be a diverse and inclusive employer. If you have any specific requirements, we'll do everything we can to support you. Whether it is to find a pharmacy that is accessible, or if it is a flexible position you are looking for, we can help find the role that is right for you. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process, we will be happy to accommodate you*.


About The Company

For over 70 years, we’ve been looking after the health and wellbeing of communities across the UK. Well Pharmacy (part of Bestway Healthcare) is the second largest pharmacy chain in the UK with c.760 pharmacies and a team of around 7,000 colleagues based across our Community Pharmacies, Online Pharmacy, Healthcare Services Centre, Community Drivers, Bestway Medhub \& Wardles team and our Support Centre team.


Our mission is to be here for the wellbeing of our patients and customers, to provide the best community pharmacy experience in the UK for everyone, for our patients, our customers, our people, and our NHS.


The pharmacy of the future will look very different from the one we know today. It will play a huge role in transforming primary healthcare and we will play a central role in bringing it to life.


We will use our clinical expertise and technological ambition to take advantage of the potential this future has to offer us. Making medicines, advice, services and care available in the places and spaces that people need and want it most.


We want to be a great business. To be recognised as delivering a community pharmacy experience that is the best there is. To do this we want our teams to feel proud about the positive impact they make, feel valued as part of a close\-knit and expert community, and feel confident in their role in a business that is stable, innovative, and caring.

**‘Together we make a difference’**

jobs.description:

Make a real difference in one of England's most beautiful counties and help shape brighter futures for those who need it most in Northumberland.  

  

At Northumberland County Council, we’re committed to delivering a high\-quality service to vulnerable adults and their loved ones across the County and we’re looking for professionals who share our vision.


This is an exciting opportunity for experienced Social Workers with post qualification experience, or social workers who have successfully completed the ASYE Programme to join Northumberland County Council Adults, Ageing \& Wellbeing Directorate. This role offers the chance to work collaboratively with health professionals from specialist services, voluntary sector partners, and community services to deliver person\-centred support. jobs.description:
Lobbs Farm Shop began in 2003 with a focus on local produce and low food miles. Our grass‑fed beef and lamb are supplied directly from the three Lobb brothers, who farm with high animal welfare and traditional faming values. Alongside our home‑produced meat, we champion Cornish suppliers and use our shop to showcase the very best of Cornwall.

We are seeking a Farm Shop Manager to oversee the full Shop, Deli, Café and Kitchen operation. This role has a strong accounting and financial‑control focus, and the successful candidate will have solid experience managing the accounting functions that underpin a busy retail business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial \& Accounting**

* Collate hours worked and prepare monthly payroll information for submission to accountants, set up net payments and PAYE tax.
* VAT submissions
* Reconciliation of creditor and debtor accounts, issuing statements and chasing supplier credits
* Bank reconciliation
* Month‑end journals including internal sales and stock adjustments
* Preparation of year‑end information for accountants
* Annual budget meeting with directors and external auditors
* Produce ad‑hoc financial reports as required
* Maintain accurate nominal coding for accounts processing

jobs.title: Engineering Team Leader - UK
jobs.description:
Role



Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Engineering Team Lead is accountable for the leadership, technical direction, and end\-to\-end delivery of an engineering team responsible for key components of the StarCompliance Enterprise SaaS platform.



This role combines strong technical leadership with people management and delivery accountability. Success is achieved through the capability and output of the team, while maintaining sufficient technical depth to guide design, challenge decisions, and support complex engineering work.



You will own the full lifecycle of the software and services within your team's domain, from design and development through deployment, operation, modernisation, and continuous improvement.



StarCompliance is moving towards an AI\-first, agentic software development model. You will lead this transition within your team, establishing ways of working where engineers and AI agents collaborate effectively across the software development lifecycle.



**How We Think About AI**



AI is a foundational part of modern software engineering at StarCompliance.



We expect Engineering Team Leads to:



* Embed AI\-assisted and agentic development into everyday engineering workflows.
* Enable appropriate engineering tasks to be safely delegated to AI agents.
* Ensure AI\-generated changes are tested, validated, secure, and auditable.
* Use AI to improve delivery speed, quality, automation, and engineering capacity.
* Continuously adopt new AI capabilities where they provide measurable value.
AI\-generated output remains engineering output, and teams remain accountable for everything they deliver.



### **Responsibilities**



Engineering Leadership \& People Development



* Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team's domain.
* Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture and engineering standards.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and resolve complex problems.
* Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt.
* Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in.

  


Technical Leadership



* Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team's domain.
* Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture standards.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and support complex problems.
* Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt.
* Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in.

  


AI\-First \& Agentic Engineering



* Lead adoption of AI\-assisted and agentic engineering practices.
* Structure work so engineers and agents can deliver effectively together.
* Increase the proportion of development activity that can be safely automated.
* Establish automated validation and guardrails for AI\-generated changes.
* Measure AI adoption through improvements in throughput, quality, and engineering capacity.

  


Delivery, Quality \& Operations



* Own end\-to\-end delivery and ongoing health of the team's products and services.
* Translate product priorities into clear and achievable engineering outcomes.
* Balance feature delivery with quality, resilience, security, and technical sustainability.
* Ensure software is tested, deployable, observable, supportable, and production\-ready.
* Drive automation across testing, CI/CD, deployment, and operational processes.
* Use engineering and production data to improve quality and delivery effectiveness.

  


Quality, CI/CD \& Operational Excellence



* Ensure engineers own the quality of the software they create.
* Embed appropriate automated testing and quality controls throughout the SDLC.
* Drive high levels of CI/CD automation and low\-risk, repeatable deployments.
* Ensure services provide effective telemetry, logging, monitoring, and alerting.
* Use production data and incidents to drive continuous engineering improvement.

  


Platform \& Collaboration



* Build solutions using modern Azure, cloud\-native, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Partner with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and Product.
* Work across team boundaries to resolve dependencies and systemic engineering issues.
* Communicate delivery, technical risks, and trade\-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Contribute to engineering\-wide standards, forums, and improvement initiatives.
### **Skills and Experience**

* Significant software engineering experience, including technical and people leadership.
* Strong experience with C\# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core.
* Strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, and modern integration patterns.
* Strong experience with microservices, containers, and distributed systems.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging.
* Experience building and operating enterprise SaaS or cloud\-hosted applications.
* Experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript.

* Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern engineering practices.
* Understanding of observability, resilience, performance, and secure software development.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools and agentic development approaches.
* Experience supporting or leading AI\-first or agentic engineering transformation.
* Proven ability to lead engineers, manage delivery, allocate resources, and influence across teams.
* Strong technical judgement, communication, coaching, and stakeholder\-management skills.
### **Minimum Qualifications**

  



 Minimum Qualifications



* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Integrity and Ethics



* All StarCompliance employees are expected to commit to a high standard of personal integrity and carry out their responsibilities in an ethical manner.

jobs.title: Communications & Marketing Director (Volunteer)
jobs.description:
**Here at Youth4Youth**, we have built a strong, tight\-knit community of individuals passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute significantly to the impact we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department they work in or the time they are able to commit.

**Our services** primarily offer a peer\-support network to young people across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor of a similar age who they feel more comfortable speaking with.


If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse but like\-minded individuals, collaborating to increase the Charity's reach and improve the support available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are **remote workers,** but that doesn't stop us from keeping in touch and maintaining a strong, positive culture amongst our whole team.


**About the role**


Lead Y4Y’s strategic communications and digital presence during a transformational growth phase. Following our 15th Anniversary and the launch of our digital Chat Portal, this role owns our brand narrative, drives user engagement for our out\-of\-hours safety net, and amplifies our commercial and advocacy initiatives.

 **Responsibilities**

* **Key Responsibilities**


	+ Strategic Brand Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated comms strategy promoting Y4Y’s digital mentoring, commercial ventures (Y4Y UniHub, Everyone Feels), and the Changemaker Programme.
	+ Campaign \& Content Management: Drive high\-converting digital marketing campaigns across web, social, and email channels to reach both young people in need and key corporate/funder audiences.
	+ PR \& Media Engagement: Collaborate with our Board Trustee (PR/Crisis Lead) to secure national and local media coverage, positioning Y4Y as a thought leader in early\-intervention mental health.
	+ Data\-Driven Insights: Monitor engagement analytics across digital touchpoints to optimise messaging, grow our subscriber base, and support fundraising efforts.

**Skills**

* Proven track record in marketing strategy, digital communications, or PR (agency or in\-house).
* Strong understanding of digital tools, social platforms, and brand storytelling.
* Ability to craft persuasive, impact\-driven messaging that avoids "begging bowl" tone.


Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you are only a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

**Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth**


We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in\-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

* Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions
* Becoming a member of a strong network of like\-minded individuals, spread across the UK, with whom you can connect and collaborate both within and outside of the Charity
* Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non\-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers
* Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

**The hiring process**


Our hiring process typically has two stages

* Video or Written Application (when applicable)
* Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator or CEO.

*Some roles may have extra stages, but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.*


Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

jobs.title: Principal Salesforce Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking a hands\-on Salesforce Engineer with a proven track record of designing, building, and delivering robust, scalable, and secure solutions on the Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate combines deep technical craftsmanship with high engineering standards, an eye for detail, and a continuous improvement mindset. A strong understanding of the financial services industry is essential. The candidate should be able to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions, uphold best\-practice engineering and DevOps disciplines, and champion innovation. They should be comfortable leading technical design and development from pre\-programme mobilisation through to production support and mentoring other engineers along the way.  



**About Schroders**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.


Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.  



**Technology at Schroders**

There's a huge amount of change happening at Schroders. Technology is shaping our business more and more, creating numerous opportunities. As a significant financial player, we can put substantial backing behind good ideas. While we have enormous responsibilities to our clients and shareholders, our tech teams are friendlier and more informal than you might expect.  



**The base**

We moved into our new HQ in the City of London in 2018\. We’re close to our clients, in the heart of the UK’s financial centre, and we have everything we need to work flexibly.  



**The team**

The Asset Management Platforms department at Schroders is a global technology change delivery function that oversees and executes all technology delivery within the organization. The Client Engagement team sits within Client Technology and is responsible for all platforms associated with the provision of client relationship management, with a strong emphasis on Salesforce. The core team is responsible for understanding business needs, solving complex problems, mobilizing and delivering large change programs, and maintaining the integrity of the Salesforce platform and associated capabilities.  



**What you’ll do**

* Lead the technical design and hands\-on development of high\-quality, scalable, and secure solutions across the Salesforce platform, spanning both our Public and Private businesses.
* Own and champion engineering standards, code quality, technical governance, and platform integrity, ensuring solutions are maintainable, performant, and aligned to architectural principles.
* Design and build robust integrations connecting Salesforce with upstream and downstream platforms to enable joined\-up client journeys and high\-quality, trusted data.
* Drive DevOps maturity—CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management—to accelerate delivery and reduce risk.
* Deliver proof\-of\-value and proof\-of\-concept builds to rapidly test ideas, de\-risk delivery, and build compelling cases for investment.
* Harness emerging AI capabilities—including Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce—to enhance productivity, decision\-making, and client engagement, taking practical use cases from concept to implementation.
* Mentor and coach engineers, lead code reviews, and raise the technical capability of the wider team.

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Extensive hands\-on Salesforce development experience within a large global financial services organisation, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and declarative configuration.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I as a minimum; Platform Developer II, Application Architect, or System/Technical Architect certifications are highly desirable.
* Strong integration experience using REST/SOAP APIs, event\-driven patterns, and middleware such as MuleSoft to connect Salesforce with the wider technology estate.
* Proven experience of DevOps and CI/CD tooling (e.g. Git, Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps), automated testing, and release management on the Salesforce platform.
* Deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modelling, security, governor limits, and platform best practices, with the ability to take a holistic view of the target state across technology, data, and operating model.
* Good eye for detail and hands\-on experience of producing technical designs, specifications, and high\-quality, well\-tested code.
* Broad engineering experience across a number of different capabilities, systems, and teams; a number of different (positive) experiences is valued higher than length of experience.
* Strong knowledge and experience of the end\-to\-end SDLC (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid etc.) and modern engineering disciplines.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences and influence at all levels.
Experience of working with global colleagues and stakeholders and sensitivity to cultural differences, time zones etc.  
* 

**What you’ll be like**

The ideal candidate for the Principal Salesforce Engineer role will be a pragmatic and collaborative technical leader who takes pride in engineering craftsmanship and delivering business value. They will be comfortable leading complex technical design and hands\-on delivery, using their initiative to break down challenges and self\-organize. A natural mentor, this individual will raise standards across the team, lead by example, and engage credibly with both technical peers and senior stakeholders. Their innovative approach will drive the exploration of cutting\-edge tools, patterns, and AI\-enabled solutions, ultimately enhancing platform quality and project outcomes.  



**We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are**

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.  



We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.title: Pensions & Insurance Administrator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Pensions \& Insurance Administrator

**Location:** Port of Grangemouth

**Hours:** 22\.5hrs per week, worked across five days. The final working pattern will be agreed with the successful candidate to meet business and operational requirements.

**Compensation:** £17,357 (£27,000 FTE)

  

At Forth Ports, we keep trade, logistics, and infrastructure moving. Every day, our teams support the flow of goods, materials, and services that businesses and communities rely on, helping to power economic growth across the UK and beyond. Our people are at the core of everything we do, and their expertise, commitment, and innovation drive our success.


With our commitment to reach carbon neutrality by 2032 and Net Zero by 2042, we're investing heavily in sustainable and digital technologies, including major growth in offshore wind and greener port operations. For you, this means joining a business that's evolving, ambitious, and making a real difference.

**About The Role**


Reporting to the Head of Risk \& Pensions, the Pensions \& Insurance Administrator plays an important role in supporting the effective administration of the Group's pension schemes and insurance arrangements. The role is responsible for delivering a professional, accurate and confidential service to employees, pension scheme members and external stakeholders, ensuring that day to day activities are completed efficiently and in line with regulatory requirements.


Working closely with internal departments and external providers, the successful candidate will support member communications, maintain accurate records, coordinate insurance administration activities and contribute to ongoing process improvements and departmental projects.

 **Key responsibilities:**

* Provide ongoing and effective administration of the Forth Ports DC Plan, ensuring all processes are completed accurately and within required timeframes
* Respond to pension scheme member queries in a professional and confidential manner, providing clear information and signposting to the appropriate provider or adviser where required
* Act as the primary point of contact with third\-party DB administrators, to ensure accurate and timely information flow for members of the Forth Ports Group Pension Scheme
* Maintain accurate pensions and insurance records, ensuring data is kept up to date, securely stored and handled in line with data protection requirements
* Handle day\-to\-day insurance matters, including regular vehicle updates, audits and Employer’s Liability claims as they arise
* Support ad hoc projects, such as Group Life renewals and annual data uploads as well as contributing to process improvements within the department
* Maintain and update procedure notes, process documents and standard communications to support consistent pensions and insurance administration

 **What we're looking for:**


We're looking for an organised and detail\-oriented administrator with experience in pensions, insurance or a similar regulated environment. You'll be comfortable managing a varied workload, handling confidential information with discretion and building positive relationships with colleagues, scheme members and external providers.


This is a part\-time opportunity and would suit someone looking for flexibility while remaining actively involved in a professional and rewarding role. We're looking for someone who can work their hours across the week to provide consistent support to the department and its stakeholders.

 **Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated pensions and insurance administration experience, ideally with a relevant recognised professional qualification
* Excellent numeracy and IT skills, including proficient Excel skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workloads effectively, both independently and as part of a team, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
* High level of accuracy in record keeping, data entry and compliance with regulatory requirements
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with colleagues, trustees, external providers and scheme members
* Full Driving Licence, valid in the UK
* Full UK Working Rights

 **What Forth Ports can offer you**


At Forth Ports, our people are our priority, and we are committed to creating a flexible, open, and supportive working culture. As part of our team, you will enjoy

* A competitive salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Generous annual leave entitlement
* Defined contribution pension scheme with up to 16\.5% joint contribution plus life assurance at 4x salary
* In‑house Occupational Health — Provides professional workplace health advice, support, and guidance for employees across all sites
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) — Delivered through *Health Assured*, offering 24/7, 365‑day confidential wellbeing support via the Wisdom app or telephone access, covering mental health, financial advice, legal guidance, and emotional wellbeing
* Physiotherapy Support — Access to physiotherapy sessions through three external providers in Scotland, plus an onsite physiotherapist once per week in Tilbury
* An annual Christmas thank you gift of a complimentary turkey or meat\-free alternative for all employees
* GymFlex health club memberships offering discounted access to gyms including Nuffield Health, PureGym, Anytime Fitness, The Gym Group, and selected local gyms
* Cycle to Work scheme to support affordable, sustainable commuting
* On\-site free parking available for all employees
* Attractive family\-friendly policies, including enhanced maternity cover
* Employee discount platform providing savings on UK\-wide restaurants, retail, car rentals, days out, and holidays

  

We value diversity and inclusivity, and we are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.


As a signatory to the Armed Forces Covenant, we are committed to ensuring that members of the Armed Forces community are treated fairly and are not disadvantaged in their civilian careers because of their service.


We welcome applications from veterans, reservists, cadet force adult volunteers, and military spouses/partners, and we actively support flexible and inclusive recruitment practices.

 **How to Apply:**


Please submit your CV and a cover letter when submitting your application via the ‘Apply Now’ link.

**Required Criteria**

* Demonstrated pensions and insurance administration experience, ideally with a relevant recognised professional qualification
* Excellent numeracy and IT skills, including proficient Excel skills and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Full Driving Licence, valid in the UK
Full UK Working Rights

**About The Company**


Over our 50 years of experience we have witnessed our ports grow to become important assets to support and deliver growth both for the UK and local economies.


The growth impact has been achieved due to the continued investments in our infrastructure, making sure that our ports are able to continually develop their services and support the growth of many industries.


Our people have played a significant role. They have delivered the highest quality of service through their expertise, loyalty and flexibility and, without them, we could not have built the strong reputation and the long term agreements with many customers that we have today.

**Company Culture**


Welcome to Forth Ports Careers. As a leading port operator, we employ over 1,100 people across our ports in Scotland and the Port of Tilbury in London.


A career in a port business is very rewarding. There is real variety within each role and significant opportunities for promotion and career development.
