jobs.description:
**.buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

Disability Practitioner
  
**Requisition ID:** 29724
  
  

**Location:**  

Newcastle, GB
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Contract Type:** Fixed Term
  
**Working Pattern:** Full Time
  
**Posted Date:** 11 Sept 2026
  
**.buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

**Salary:** £36,636 to £38,784 with progression to £46,049 per annum
  
  

Newcastle University is a great place to work, with excellent benefits. We have a generous holiday package; plus the opportunity to buy more, great pension schemes and a number of health and wellbeing initiatives to support you.
  
  

**Closing Date:** 25 September 2026
  
  

The Role
  
  

University Health and Wellbeing is seeking to appoint an exceptional candidate to the post of Disability Practitioner, in a fixed\-term post to cover a period of maternity leave.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity for a dynamic individual to join the Disability team. This role provides specialist professional advice and guidance to students, applicants and colleagues and to work creatively to remove barriers for disabled students, to raise awareness and promote a positive, respectful and inclusive culture to enable access, progress and retention for disabled students.
  
  

University Health and Wellbeing provide information, advice and guidance on a wide range of support issues, to enable students to maximise their potential whilst at University. The service is free, confidential and available to all students.
  
  

The role is campus\-based. There is opportunity for flexible hybrid working dependent on service need. The fixed working hours are Monday to Friday, 9am\-5pm.
  
  

We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Confident employer which means that we offer an interview to any applicant applying under the scheme that meets the essential criteria for a role.
  
  

Interviews to be held in October 2026\.
  
  

If, having read the job description and person specification, you require information that is not covered, please contact Sandy Alden by email sandy.alden@ncl.ac.uk. You can also find further information about the Student Wellbeing Service online.
  
  

To apply, please complete the 3 mandatory questions attached to this vacancy along with a copy of your CV and cover letter evidencing how your skills and experience align to the person specification as outlined in job description.
  
  

Successful candidates will require satisfactory disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS). People Services colleagues will support you with this during onboarding.
  
  

Key Accountabilities
  
  

To act as a central point of contact for future and current disabled students, including long\-term mental health conditions.
  
To provide advice and information to students and key stake holders, on the provision of support services and facilities within and external to the University.
  
Manage a varied, complex and sensitive caseload of future and current disabled students, including those with long\-term mental health conditions, who want to access disability support, often working with them over a long period of time.
  
Identify and respond to risk, and to refer appropriately to internal and or external services.
  
Apply knowledge and understanding of the additional mental health vulnerabilities of those from minority or marginalised backgrounds and the experience and action needed to support them effectively.
  
With equal efficacy offer a blend of individual present\-in\-person and digital meetings to identify relevant support and adjustments options, facilitate any ensuing communication with academic schools and other key stakeholders to resolve barriers to reasonable adjustment and support needs.
  
Provide advice, guidance and information, including advice on Disabled Students Allowances.
  
Undertake assessments of student needs and deliver one to one or small group interventions to help students develop effective strategies that support healthy behaviours, and positive engagement with study.
  
Proactively liaise with colleagues within the Examinations Office to implement additional examination arrangements for disabled students.
  
When directed plan, coordinate and participate in staff development activities.
  
To facilitate improvements in provision for disabled students, by holding a knowledge lead responsibility, in a wide range of settings by keeping abreast of issues affecting disabled students and participation within a variety of working groups.
  
To complete and maintain record keeping in a timely fashion, adhering to the Service policy and data protection requirements.
  
Contribute to the evaluation of the impact of support provided to students.
  
As identified by and with support of line manager undertake regular personal training and continuing professional development in order to remain updated with the knowledge of legislation and relevant research in disability related issues.
  
To keep abreast of internal and external developments that may impact upon support for disabled students. This includes, but is not exclusive to, government strategy, and sector best practice initiatives.
  
Adhere to and comply with the provisions of the Data Protection Laws along with the University’s Data Protection Policies.
  
To act as a consultant, and at times trainer, to university staff to provide support as they work with disabled students and students with long\-term mental health conditions and vulnerabilities.
  
To liaise with both external bodies and internal colleagues to assist in providing adequate support for disabled students, including long\-term mental health conditions and vulnerabilities. Refer and track referrals to other agencies as appropriate, to ensure students do not “slip through the net”.
  
To participate in promotion of the Student Health and Wellbeing activity, open days, receptions, Welcome Week which, from time to time, may require working out\-of\-hours i.e. evenings and weekends (only very occasional).
  
  

The Person (Essential)
  
  

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
  

Knowledge of and familiarity with the application of relevant legislation and the implications of this in an HE setting.
  
Understanding of the effects of a range of mental health difficulties, and disabilities on individuals, family, friends, staff and potential impact on student University experience.
  
Experience and/or training in the application of cross\-cultural mental health support.
  
Capacity to deal with a highly sensitive caseload and work collaboratively with others to create effective performance within a team.
  
Be able to evidence knowledge of the principles of inclusivity, diversity and equal opportunities.
  
Ability to interpret and apply knowledge of policies and procedures.
  
Evidenced based advice and guidance skills.
  
A highly flexible working style.
  
Strong attention to detail.
  
Excellent communications skills.
  
Ability to exercise initiative and judgement in the appropriate management of student support and the ability to work independently.
  
**Highly competent IT skills:** Word, Excel, Email, Internet, Databases.
  
Ability to manage time and resources effectively by prioritising and organising a high volume, complex and varied workload.
  
Management of own caseload.
  
Experience of working with groups.
  
Presentation and/or training skills and experience, delivering to a diverse audience.
  
  

Attributes and Behaviour
  
  

Takes the initiative to ensure future success of the University and area by presenting new ideas and approaches.
  
Accepts the reality and requirements of change as part of achieving organisational goals.
  
Is supportive of others during change.
  
Anticipates change and prepares for it. Accepts change and ‘runs’ with it.
  
Establishes effective management control systems.
  
Effective at organising and managing complex workload.
  
Uses own and others’ time effectively.
  
Plans workload and tasks in a systematic way.
  
Sets own priorities in conjunction with University, team and area objectives.
  
Considers large amounts of complex information quickly and identifies key issues.
  
Recognises urgency and takes decisive action when required.
  
Confidently deals with a broad range of information.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

A recognised degree or equivalent qualification and/or experience.
  
A relevant professional Qualification such as Advice and Guidance, Registered Nurse Mental Health/ Social Worker/ Occupational Therapist, or Autism practice etc.

jobs.title: Underwriting Team Leader - UK Regions Property
jobs.description:
**Your future team**

  

AIG’s underwriters develop insurance solutions that address the exposures of companies and


individuals, and embody AIG’s tradition of innovation, bringing to market ground\-breaking insurance solutions for our changing world. AIG’s underwriters help to find insurance solutions for risks from a range of areas including life insurance, aviation, financial lines, casualty, environmental, catastrophic events, high net worth individuals, and boardroom liabilities.

 **Your Contribution to AIG**

  

We are pleased to be recruiting for a UK Regions Property Underwriting Team Lead to join our high\-performing Commercial Property team, based in Manchester.

  

As a high performing contributor at AIG you are the one the clients turn to in times of need. You act with speed, composure, compassion and knowledge to solve problems and the work you do every day is the heart of AIG’s business.

  

You will drive growth and profitability of the UK Regions portfolio by managing the UK Regions team across our branch network (Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds and Glasgow). You will be responsible for our UK Regions Property and mid\-market package portfolio and look to achieve targets set by management. You will ensure exceptional customer service to both internal and external parties and consistently meet service levels and performance targets as set by the Head of UK Retail Property.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Executes strategic objectives for Property across our Regions portfolio. Drive a consistent approach with our offering across other AIG UK offices.
* Support and execute product growth strategy for our UK Corporate Protect offering.
* Builds and maintains strong broker and client relationships with Key identified UK Regional brokers
* Optimises Property expertise, scale and deployment within the Property UK Regions in line with market strategies
* Optimises team deployment to deliver strategic objectives in line with client and broker engagement models
* Underwrite within agreed decision making standards, limitations, and underwriting authority
* Provide guidance and consultation on underwriting issues. Act as a referral point for all accounts within authority. Ensure referrals are being handled in accordance with UK and AIG regulations.
* Support in timely reporting of financial performance (including estimates)

Day to day managerial responsibility for all local UK Regions Property underwriting staff  
* 

  

**Position Requirements**

  

* Strong commercial property insurance background
* Strong local market relationships and broker network
* Education preferred: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent. ACII is an advantage.
* Significant property underwriting experience and strong technical insurance knowledge, with a particular focus in Middle Market Sector.
* Team leadership and management experience.
* Proven ability to lead client and broker negotiations
* Strong ability to understand and construct complex policy wordings
* Multinational experience and knowledge of local markets/regulations is desirable.
* Excellent interpersonal, written communication skills including delivery of presentations to all levels of stakeholders, including claims and distribution (both broker and client engagement).
* An appreciation and understanding of legal/regulatory requirements
* Understanding of reinsurance and how to structure programmes
* Proven ability to build relationships with brokers and clients.
* Good organisational skills with proven ability to prioritise workload.
* Highly numerate and competent in IT packages.

  

At AIG, we value in\-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

**Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters**


At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

**Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world**


American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far\-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever\-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

**Welcome to a culture of** **inclusion**


We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

*AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.*


AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

jobs.title: Principal Ecologist
jobs.description:
**Principal Ecologist**

**Location: Flexible / UK\-wide**

**Salary: Competitive**

**Contract Type: Permanent**

**Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday\-Friday**

### **Lead****projects.****Develop****people.****Shape****the****future****of****a****growing****ecology****team.**


You're an experienced ecologist who enjoys helping others succeed just as much as delivering great projects. You combine technical expertise with strong leadership skills, creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged and empowered to do their best work.


At Ground Control, you'll play a key role in the growth of our Ecology Team. Alongside leading complex ecological projects and providing expert technical advice, you'll help develop the next generation of ecologists through coaching, mentoring and day\-to\-day leadership. This is an opportunity to influence project delivery, strengthen client relationships and play a significant role in building a high\-performing ecology function.


Success in this role isn't just measured by project delivery. It's also reflected in the strength, capability and development of the people around you.

##### **What you'll do:**


In this role, you'll provide technical, commercial and people leadership across a diverse portfolio of ecological projects.

* Lead the delivery of complex ecological projects and multidisciplinary programmes, ensuring high\-quality outcomes for clients while maintaining exceptional technical standards.
* Provide expert ecological advice on legislation, planning policy, Biodiversity Net Gain, protected species and habitat management, helping clients navigate complex environmental challenges.
* Review, approve and sign off technical reports and ecological assessments, ensuring consistency, quality and compliance across all project outputs.
* Manage project portfolios from inception through to completion, overseeing budgets, forecasting, resources and risk to achieve successful commercial and operational outcomes.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulators and key stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor and identifying opportunities to grow services.
* Lead major tenders, framework submissions and fee proposals, supporting the continued growth and success of the ecology team.
* Lead, mentor and develop Ecologists and Assistant Ecologists, creating a supportive environment where people can build confidence, capability and technical expertise.
* Provide coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback, helping team members progress their careers while maintaining high standards across project delivery.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and succession planning initiatives, helping attract and retain talented ecologists as the team continues to grow.
* Foster a collaborative and high\-performing culture where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and professional development are part of everyday work.
* Drive continuous improvement by developing best\-practice guidance, improving technical standards and championing innovation across the wider ecology function.

##### **What you'll get:**

* The opportunity to lead complex and nationally significant ecology projects across a range of sectors and habitats.
* A highly influential role where your expertise helps shape project delivery, team development and business growth.
* The autonomy to make decisions, drive improvements and help build a growing ecology service.
* The opportunity to shape and grow a developing ecology team while making a lasting impact on people, projects and business performance.
* A leadership role where you'll influence both technical delivery and the professional development of others.
* Exposure to senior stakeholders, strategic projects and multidisciplinary environmental programmes.
* Opportunities to further develop your technical specialisms, leadership capability and commercial expertise.
* A collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, professional development and innovation are encouraged.

##### **What we're looking for:**

* A degree or higher qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
* Full Membership of CIEEM (MCIEEM).
* Significant ecological consultancy experience at Senior Ecologist level or above, typically five years or more.
* One or more protected species licences, with demonstrable experience leading and overseeing licensed survey programmes.
* Extensive knowledge of UK wildlife legislation, planning policy and ecological best practice.
* Proven experience managing complex ecological projects, multidisciplinary teams and competing priorities.
* Strong commercial awareness, including experience managing budgets, forecasting, fee proposals and project profitability.
* Demonstrable experience leading, mentoring and developing ecologists, with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.
* The ability to inspire confidence, build capability and create a positive team culture where people can perform at their best.
* Excellent technical reporting, quality assurance and decision\-making capabilities.
* Strong client relationship management and business development skills, with the ability to build long\-term partnerships.
* Experience with Biodiversity Net Gain, habitat restoration, infrastructure projects, framework contracts or protected species licensing would be highly advantageous.
* A full UK driving licence.


Join Ground Control and help shape the future of ecological consultancy by delivering technical excellence, developing great people and creating lasting environmental value for clients, communities and nature.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary – aligned with your skills and experience
* Performance‑linked bonus: Bonus opportunities aligned to your level and contribution.
* Pension scheme – helping you plan for the future
* Recognition schemes – celebrating and rewarding great work
* Private GP service – fast, convenient access to medical support
* Life insurance – providing added peace of mind
* Subsidised gym membership – supporting your health and wellbeing
* Holiday buy scheme – purchase up to 5 additional days of annual leave

**\#INDHP**

**Equal Opportunities Statement**


At Ground Control, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic as defined in the Equality Act 2010\.


We actively support and promote an inclusive culture, ensuring fair and equitable treatment throughout the recruitment process and across all stages of employment, including training, development, promotion, pay, and termination. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees, and to creating a working environment free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, or victimisation.


We expect all colleagues to uphold our values of dignity, respect, and inclusion. We take a zero\-tolerance approach to any form of discriminatory behaviour and are committed to continuous improvement through training, inclusive policies, and accountability at all levels. \#Maint

jobs.title: Fundraising & Partnership Director (Volunteer)
jobs.description:
**Here at Youth4Youth**, we have grown a strong, tight\-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. **Our services** primarily offer a peer\-support network to young people across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor of a similar age who they feel more comfortable speaking with.


If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse but like\-minded individuals, collaborating to increase the Charity's reach and improve the support available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are **remote workers,** but that doesn't stop us from keeping in touch and maintaining a strong, positive culture amongst our whole team.


**About the role**


Drive sustainable, unrestricted, and bid\-based income generation to secure the charity's long\-term future. This strategic role focuses on high\-value corporate partnerships, institutional trusts, and engagement with high\-net\-worth individuals \& networks to scale our digital mental health services nationwide.

 **Responsibilities**

* Strategic Income Generation: Build and execute a diversified income strategy aligned with our 2025–2028 roadmap (targeting trust funds, statutory grants, and corporate sponsors).
* Corporate \& Network Partnerships: Engage mid\-market and SME corporate partners by framing Y4Y as an efficient, low\-cost solution to systemic issues (e.g., NHS waiting lists, youth unemployment).
* High\-Net\-Worth Stewardship: Work alongside our Board of Trustees to leverage high\-net\-worth networks and secure patrons and major donors.
* Bid Writing \& Alignment: Oversee major funding applications, ensuring proposals align with core funder themes (trauma\-informed care, early intervention, digital inclusion, youth employment).

**Skills**

* Background in business development, fundraising, or corporate partnership management.
* Strong commercial acumen with persuasive proposal writing and pitch skills.
* Network\-builder with a strategic approach to partnership growth.


Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you are only a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

**Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth**


We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in\-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

* Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions
* Becoming a member of a strong network of like\-minded individuals, spread across the UK, with whom you can connect and collaborate both within and outside of the Charity
* Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non\-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers
* Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

**The hiring process**


Our hiring process typically has two stages

* Video or Written Application (when applicable)
* Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

*Some roles may have extra stages, but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.*


Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

jobs.title: Private Client Compliance - Client Delivery and Technology - SM
jobs.description:
**About the role:**

Our Tax Compliance team delivers technology\-enabled compliance services to a prestigious client base. We combine technical excellence with automation and innovation, working across the UK and with overseas delivery centres to provide an outstanding client experience.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager for a hybrid role combining private client portfolio leadership with technology\-enabled process improvement. Approximately 50% of the role will focus on managing high\-net\-worth individuals, trusts and partnerships, with responsibility for high\-quality, commercially effective and well\-controlled delivery.


The remaining 50% will connect PCC’s operational needs with the wider Compliance Services Technology and AI teams. Using your understanding of private client compliance to simplify, standardise and automate delivery, and translate business challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

**What your days will look like:**

* Lead a portfolio of high\-net\-worth individuals, trusts and partnerships, building trusted relationships and anticipating client needs.
* Own end\-to\-end compliance delivery, including complex reviews, timetables, budgets, billing, quality and risk.
* Analyse PCC processes, controls and hand\-offs to identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and AI.
* Translate business challenges into clear requirements, process maps, user stories, success measures and scalable solutions.
* Partner with Technology and the Compliance Services AI Programme to design, test and progress governed solutions.
* Coach colleagues and build team capability across technical delivery, technology adoption and continuous improvement.
**This role is for you if:**

* Strong private client tax expertise and experience managing comparable portfolios; CTA, ACA or equivalent qualification.
* Proven ownership of end\-to\-end delivery across deadlines, budgets, quality and risk requirements.
* Excellent client service, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships.
* Ability to analyse processes, resolve ambiguity and translate business needs into practical improvements.
* Confidence using technology to solve problems, with knowledge of automation, AI, workflow or low\-code tools.
* Commercial judgement, attention to detail and experience coaching colleagues and supporting continuous improvement.
* Ability to rapidly assimilate the existing PCC operating model and effectively support the business in transitioning to new target models driven by technology changes.
**What you'll receive from us:**


 No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions.


We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.

jobs.title: Mobile Technical Operative - Electrical
jobs.description:
**Mobile Technical Operative \- Electrical**
--------------------------------------------


Offer ID: 90408
Job: Technicians / Electricity
Contract type: Permanent
Schedule: Full\-Time
Country: United Kingdom
**EQUANS are looking for a Mobile Technical Operative (Electrical) to work on our HMCTS contract across Redditch Magistrates and Worcester Combined Courts. This role would be a permanent full\-time role working 40 hours per week. On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package.**

  

**General Overview:**


Equans provide technical and soft services to our client HMCTS across a large portfolio of buildings across the UK. As part of the service, we provide low voltage electrical maintenance and installation services, and because of business growth, we are recruiting for additional roles to provide these services for our customer.

  

**Main Duties and Responsibilities:**


The primary purpose of the role is to carry out both planned and reactive maintenance on a wide variety of Fabric and limited Engineering Assets, ensuring all activities are completed in a safe and timely manner and in accordance with the contracted output specifications and Equans processes and procedures. Activities will include:


* Ensure that routine Planned Preventative Measures (PPM) is carried out to the electrical infrastructure and plant in accordance with Site task schedules and CAFM.


* Ensure that reactive tasks throughout the sites are completed and be proactive in highlighting areas where improvements can be made.


* Ensure that plant faults and defects are always swiftly remedied to maintain plant in serviceable order.


* Ensure that suitable spares are available to carry out both maintenance and reactive works.


* To provide parts lists and estimated timescales to carry out remedial works.


* Ensure that all relevant paperwork/CAFM is completed regarding PPM, reactive and breakdown works and that it is passed without delay to the contract administrator.


* Ensure that Method Statements and Risk Assessments are always prepared and used for all tasks undertaken to ensure safe working practices.


* To develop a good working relationship with all members of Equans staff, subcontractors and the client representatives.


* Ensure the provision of a Safe and Healthy working environment. To include the wearing of uniform and PPE at all times.


* Ensure up to date plant logs are kept at all times.


* Supervising and monitoring of sub\-contractors works whilst they are on site undertaking maintenance.


* Ensure an awareness and compliance to the contractual KPI's/SLA's.


* Ensure CAFM system, e.g. TotalMobile, is kept up to date and that PPM and reactive tickets are closed out with accurate data captured.


* To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with Equans’ Technical and SHEQ processes and client requirements (or approved client system).


* To carry out any other task as directed by the account management team.


* Participate in the 24/7 maintenance cover (including on call rota) of the Building Engineering Services during normal and emergency activities, assisting in the preparation of emergency and contingency plans. Participate in emergency plans and provide written reports as required.


* The position will require you to provide engineering support in emergency situations to ensure business and operational continuity.


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equans staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out

  

**Client / Customer**


* Respond in a timely manner to verbal and written requests


* Coordinate quotations with the contract manager


* Production of information for quotations

  

**Helpdesk \- PPM**


* Support the Helpdesk as required when reporting or updating planned and reactive maintenance


* Be available for out of hours call\-out support for the contract

  

**Compliance**


* To gain Technical Appointments as required e.g. LVCP/LVAP/HVAP and to issue PTW to Subcontractors and Equan staff


* Ensure both self\-delivered and subcontracted maintenance, testing and inspection activities are in compliance with the latest version of BS7671, ensuring that all remedials are carried out


* Produce Condition / Dilapidation Reports as required


* Ensure supervisor is informed immediately if dangerous circumstances occur

  

**SHEQ**


* Comply with requests for information from SHEQ manager


* Ensure you work to company health and safety policy


* Ensue PPE is safe to use


* Report accident and near misses in a timely manner


* Ensure your test equipment is within calibration


* Ensure you follow Method Statements \& Risk Assessments for all work

  

**Impact:**


Working to high standard of Building Maintenance, we require a fully reliable and competent Electrician who can work on own initiative, within a team or oversee subcontractor’s, producing high quality reports on their findings and work. The role will involve being the face of Equans so smart appearance and being able to discuss findings with others including customers is required.

  

**Complexity:**


The successful candidate will have the ability to fault find and diagnose and rectify complex Electrical faults and issues unaided. Have an excellent knowledge of Electrical systems, which will enable the development of switching schedules and Safety Documentation prior to shutdowns. To plan and oversee electrical shutdowns to permit maintenance or testing.

  

**Qualifications or Required Experience:**


Suitable experience working in a similar high demanding role.

  

**Essential:**


* Hold relevant Electrical Qualification including; NVQ level 3 in Electrical or equivalent such as City \& Guilds Technical Certificate in Electrical.


* 18th Edition IET Wiring regulations


* Hold and maintain valid Clean UK Driving License


* Post holders must be able to pass and maintain BPSS


* Counter Terrorism Check CTC (applicable for specific sites at: Westminster Magistrates; Woolwich Crown; Royal Courts of Justice; Snaresbrook Crown; and The ‘Rolls’ Building)

  

**Desired but not essential:**


* IPAF


* PLASMA

  

**What can we offer you?**


On offer is a competitive salary and benefits package, which includes;


* 24 days annual leave


* Life Cover equivalent to 1\.5 times annual salary


* Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers


* Gym membership discounts


* Cycle to work scheme


* Holiday purchase scheme


* 2 corporate social responsibility days per year


* Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes


* Attractive Employee Referral Rewards Scheme


* Access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in EQUANS), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Persons Network) and our Disability Network


* 24/7 Employee Assistance Program and access to mental wellbeing app

  

**Who are we?**


EQUANS is a world leader in energy services with nearly 100,000 employees working in more than 50 countries, with an annual turnover of over 17 billion euros.


In the UK \& Ireland, EQUANS is a provider of technical, FM, regeneration and energy services – with specialist capabilities in smart buildings, green mobility, district \& embedded energy and decentralised renewables.


EQUANS’ 13,500 UK \& Ireland employees combine these activities to help businesses, public sector organisations and government to embrace the energy transition towards net zero, and also the digital \& industrial transitions that are redesigning the way we move, work and live.


EQUANS is a Bouygues group company.


ENGENG

  

**What's next?**


If this role is of interest to you, please click below to register, apply, and track your progress! A member of our Resourcing Team will review your application and be in touch.


At Equans we’re committed to delivering a culture where everyone’s voice is heard and supported. We know the value a diverse workforce creates, delivering better results for our people, customers, and stakeholders. Diversity and inclusion is at the core of what we do, should you join Equans you’ll find a welcoming and open workplace where you’re supported and encouraged to be your true self at work. You’ll also have access to our growing employee networks including WiE (Women in Equans), RISE (BAME), LGBTQI\+, Working Parents, YPN (Young Professionals Network) and our Disability Network.


For this role, you must have evidence of the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer a re\-location package with this job role. Certain roles may require applicants to undergo a Disclosure check, as noted in the role requirements.


The EQUANS Resourcing Team supports this job advert. Agency involvement is not required. All related enquiries must come to the resourcing team not direct to EQUANS Managers

jobs.title: Head of Built Environment IPC
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional and experienced Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) leader to join Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust as our Head of Built Environment IPC.
  
  

This is a rare 24\-month fixed\-term opportunity to lead one of the most complex and high\-profile built environment IPC portfolios in the NHS.
  
  

Working closely with the Director and Deputy Director of Infection Prevention and Control, you will provide strategic leadership and expert oversight across a broad portfolio including healthcare redevelopment programmes, capital projects, water safety, ventilation, decontamination, environmental risk management and estates\-related infection prevention assurance.
  
  

As a senior member of the IPC leadership team, you will influence decision\-making at site, divisional, executive and Board level, ensuring infection prevention principles are embedded within service transformation, healthcare infrastructure and operational planning.
  
  

We are looking for a registered healthcare professional with substantial senior\-level IPC experience, strong leadership skills and a proven ability to manage complex risks, influence stakeholders and deliver improvement across organisational boundaries.
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of built environment IPC within one of the UK's leading academic health science centres while contributing to innovation, education, research and service excellence.
  
  

You will provide strategic leadership for the Trust\-wide built environment infection prevention and control portfolio, ensuring effective governance, assurance and risk management across healthcare infrastructure, redevelopment, water safety, ventilation, decontamination and environmental IPC programmes.
  
  

Working closely with senior clinical, operational, estates and facilities colleagues, you will ensure infection prevention requirements are embedded throughout capital developments, refurbishment projects, service reconfigurations and operational activities.
  
  

You will provide authoritative specialist advice, undertake complex risk assessments, oversee assurance arrangements and support the identification, mitigation and escalation of significant infection prevention risks.
  
  

The role includes leading the development of strategy, policy and assurance frameworks; contributing specialist expertise to incident and outbreak management where environmental factors are relevant; and supporting organisational improvement through audit, education, research and innovation.
  
  

You will represent the IPC service at senior internal and external forums and contribute to executive and Board\-level reporting and assurance processes.
  
  

You will provide professional leadership to staff within your portfolio, build effective partnerships across organisational boundaries and drive continuous improvement in infection prevention practice.
  
  

At Imperial College Healthcare you can achieve extraordinary things with extraordinary people, working with leading clinicians pushing boundaries in patient care.
  
  

Become part of a vibrant team living our values \- expert, kind, collaborative and aspirational. You’ll get an experience like no other and will fast forward your career. Benefits include career development, flexible working and wellbeing, staff recognition scheme. Make use of optional benefits including Cycle to Work, car lease schemes, season ticket loan or membership options for onsite leisure facilities.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and improving the working lives of our staff and will consider applications to work flexibly, part time or job share. Please talk to us at interview.
  
  

Environmental sustainability
  
Climate change and poor air quality is a health emergency that harms people’s health and wellbeing and widens health inequalities. The Trust is also committed to reducing its impact on the environment by reducing our greenhouse gas emissions to Net Zero by 2045\. All our employees have a role to play, and we have an active green network that supports staff to act in ways that ensures that our services are efficient, sustainable and reduce our impact on the environment www.imperial.nhs.uk/about\-us/our\-strategy/green\-plan .
  
  

The full job description provides an overview of the key tasks and responsibilities of the role and the person specification outlines the qualifications, skills, experience and knowledge required.
  
  

For both overviews, please view the Job Description attachment with the job advert.

jobs.title: Teacher of Computing - Ballakermeen High School
jobs.description:
**About the role**


We are seeking a dedicated**Teacher of Computing**to join the highly successful Computing Department at **Ballakermeen High School**.


Our Computing Department has an excellent track record of achievement. In 2025, students achieved 100% A to C grades at iGCSE and SQA qualifications, alongside 100% Distinction to Merit grades in A2 BTEC programmes. While we are proud of these outcomes, we remain committed to continuous improvement and delivering the highest standards of teaching and learning.


The department is well resourced and is made up of four teaching staff who work collaboratively to support student success. The ability to teach Computing at Key Stages 3 and 4 is essential. We are also looking for someone who is keen to develop their experience of teaching at Key Stage 5, with training and support provided. Experience of teaching BTEC IT and the ability to teach Computer Science at Key Stage 4 would be advantageous.


At Ballakermeen, we believe that every second of learning matters. We have high expectations of both students and staff, delivered within a warm, welcoming and supportive environment. Professional development is a priority, and all staff have access to a research\-informed Professional Development programme throughout the academic year.


Applications are welcomed from both Early Career Teachers (ECTs) and experienced teachers.

**Please note that all interviews will take place in person at Ballakermeen High School on the Isle of Man. Shortlisted candidates will be required to deliver a lesson as part of the selection process and will be given a tour of the school. As these activities cannot be conducted remotely, attendance in person is essential. Candidates must hold Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) and meet the other essential criteria outlined in the Person Specification.**

**A workplace that invests in you**

Newly qualified teachers will automatically start on a generous salary of £42,718 per annum (spine point M4\).


A competitive salary that increases each 12 months until you reach the salary maximum.


Subject to meeting eligibility criteria, you will be offered two pensions arrangements: the Teachers Superannuation scheme or the Isle of Man Government Defined Contribution (DC) arrangement.


If you are returning to the island and have participated in the Department’s Student Loan scheme for tuition fees, the loan will be repaid by the Department upon completion of your second year working as a teacher at one of the island’s schools. The repayment is subject to a maximum of £7,500 for a three\-year degree course or £10,000 for a four\-year degree course, and the requirements detailed in the Teacher Loan Cancellation Policy.


If you are an Early Career Teacher, you will receive payments of £2,000 at the beginning of your first and second school years in teaching, following the completion of the ECT induction period (2 years).


Financial support to get you, your family and your belongings, including one motor vehicle to the Isle of Man. We will pay 70% of any removal or storage costs incurred.


Help to pay your rent/mortgage while you settle in with a housing allowance up to £500 per month over 2 years.


If you are relocating to the Isle of Man, you will receive financial help towards the costs of visiting to the Island to view housing and to visit your new school. You are eligible to receive up to £325 each for you and your partner and, if applicable, £140 each for up to 2 dependent children.

For those returning to the island after graduating from university, you will receive a refund on your national insurance contributions during the first 12 months of your employment, up to £4,400\.


Access to the Isle of Man Public Service Cycle to Work scheme after your first year of employment.


Access to the Learning, Education and Development training facility, which is exclusively for Public Service employees, to keep on top of your continuous professional development.

Free access to the Isle of Man Government Staff Welfare Service which offers professional counselling, emotional support and signposting on a wide range of issues.

Discounted access to the NSC gym and island swimming pools as well as 1\-to\-1 support programmes and exercise classes with qualified instructors through the ACTIV8 scheme.

You may be eligible for a Blue Light Card, unlocking a wide range of exclusive discounts on shopping, food and leisure activities at hundreds of popular high street and online retailers.

Free on\-site car parking.


A relocation package based on receipts is available for this role.


**Making the Isle of Man your new home**


A hidden gem in the Irish Sea, the Isle of Man boasts an extensive coastline, stunning natural landscapes and unspoilt beaches. There are an abundance of opportunities and lots of places to discover!


You can visit our great cafes, bars and restaurants, and become part of the Island’s close\-knit community. The island is well connected to the UK with quick, direct flights and ferries to many destinations.


Want to find out more about Island life? Visit www.locate.im to find out why you should make your move to the Isle of Man!

**Working for the Isle of Man Public Service**


We are the largest employer on the island delivering a diverse range of services to the people of the Isle of Man. We care, nurture and value our employees’ wellbeing, development and career and place great importance on rewarding the commitment by our wonderful employees.


We support and promote flexible working, recognising the importance of working flexibly around your life and commitments and the benefits in improving work\-life balance. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements where possible and if interested you should discuss this with the Recruiting Manager.


The Isle of Man Public Service is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates equality, diversity and inclusion. We understand how a wide range of views and experiences can benefit us as we work together for the Isle of Man.


Your candidate experience is important to us. As a proud member of The Circle Back Initiative, we commit to respond to every applicant that applies for an Isle of Man Public Service role.


We are committed to net zero by 2050 and as an entire nation UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, we are transforming public services for a sustainable future and your contributions will directly benefit our community, economy, and environment.


**Things to note**


An enhanced with barring police check is required for this post, the cost of which will be covered by the Isle of Man Government.


**Ready to apply?**


We understand that you might have some questions about the role and the Recruiting Manager is on hand to support you. You can contact them at BHSrecruitment2@sch.im.


To get the best out of your application, read our article on the important essentials you need to know before applying.


Applications will be accepted up to midnight of the closing date specified. If you have difficulties applying online, please contact us on 01624 685000 or by email at helpmeapply@gov.im.

jobs.title: Security Engineer II, Traffic Quality, Traffic Quality
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Advertising at Amazon is a fast\-growing, multi\-billion dollar business that spans across desktop, mobile and connected devices; encompasses ads on Amazon and a vast network of hundreds of thousands of third party publishers; and extends worldwide. Traffic Quality, within Amazon Advertising, builds technology to detect invalid traffic (IVT) and ensure that Advertiser spend worldwide is directed towards human audiences and protected from ad fraud.  

  

As the Security engineering team within Traffic Quality, we research programmatic advertising risk landscapes to build an understanding of existing and emergent threats. We build specialized techniques to detect and mitigate these threats, contributing to a robust Traffic Quality platform that is a bedrock of advertiser trust and saves hundreds of millions of dollars in ad spend that would otherwise be lost to IVT. The Security Engineering team is responsible for: (a) Targeted threat hunting, including on the dark web, to consistently stay updated on modus operandi and risks associated with advertising fraud, (b) Building sophisticated mitigation techniques through reverse engineering known software, identifying network layer signatures, and conceiving client\-side scripting methods, and, (c) Collaborating with security teams across Amazon for sharing intelligence and devising durable detection techniques.  

  

As a Security Engineer in the team, you are passionate about unraveling ad fraud tactics utilizing a diversity of highly specialized skills in reverse\-engineering, deep packet inspection of network traffic, understanding of network security, operating systems and browser architectures. You accomplish your tasks by applying expert level knowledge to tools to understand not only what a particular piece of malware for perpetrating ad fraud can do but also how it does it. You work with internal security teams to identify and mitigate botnets, as well as leverage the ethical hacking community to obtain standard modus operandi, source code and tactics used by malware and botnets. The role requires influencing leaders across the company to improve our security bar and protect advertiser trust. A Security Engineer also works with other product and security teams to proactively identify problems and suggest approaches to solve them.  

  

Given the high level of ambiguity in the advertising fraud space, and the need to prepare for unknown unknowns, your creativity, judgement and bias for action will all be key ingredients towards delivering the right results for advertising customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP, DNS and TCP/IP
* Experience programming in Python, Ruby, Go, Swift, Java, .Net, C\+\+ or similar object oriented language
* You have passion for reverse engineering, malware analysis, threat detection and risk hunting.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS products and services
* Experience with any combination of the following: threat modeling, secure coding, identity management and authentication, software development, cryptography, system administration and network security

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, WW Operations Sustainability Finance
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


WW Operations Finance is looking for a Financial Analyst to join the Carbon Planning \& Analysis team, supporting EU and Rest of World (ROW) regions. CP\&A is the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity (CI) data integrity, reporting, and planning across WW Ops' \~45MM tCO2 annual footprint, directly supporting the WW Ops S\-team carbon intensity goal and Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment of net zero by 2040\. This role will maintain and improve the data structures underpinning EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning, partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with regional sustainability and BI teams, and deep\-dive data quality challenges as they arise. The role sits at the intersection of Sustainability, Finance, and Operations \- a rare combination that gives the analyst exposure to carbon science, financial planning rigor, and operational decarbonization levers all in one seat, and offers a strong foundation for building differentiated expertise early in their career. The analyst will operate with oversight and mentorship from a senior CP\&A team member, with growing autonomy over time as regional carbon data fluency builds.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support EU and ROW carbon month\-end close (MEC), ensuring carbon ledger (GCD) aligned data quality and timely resolution of carbonation and data quality issues.
* Maintain and continuously improve EU/ROW carbon reporting and planning data structures within data cluster and Carbon Reporting Deck.
* Partner cross\-functionally and cross\-country with EU and ROW regional sustainability, BI, and BU Finance teams to consolidate data requests, validate submissions, and resolve discrepancies.
* Support EU/ROW carbon planning cycles (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), ensuring carbon drivers (LMPP, 3P cost, WHT LoH, fleet electrification) are captured accurately and tie to the broader financial plan.
* Deep\-dive data quality and reporting challenges, identify root causes, and propose process or automation improvements.
* Contribute to CP\&A's transition toward an AI\-native reporting and planning model \- supporting GenAI\-powered variance commentary, automated data quality checks, and other tools that reduce manual reconciliation work.
* Assist in preparing variance commentary and metrics tables for leadership reporting (Kingpin, WWS reviews), under the guidance of a senior team member.
* Escalate data quality, timeline, or stakeholder risks promptly, partnering with the senior team member on resolution.
* Build subject\-matter expertise in carbon data systems and regional carbon drivers to grow scope over time.

  

A day in the life  

Your day starts with a check of data submission status and the latest carbon ledger (GCD) snapshot for EU and ROW, flagging any late, missing, or anomalous data before it becomes a downstream reporting issue. You'll join a call with an EU or ROW sustainability or BI counterpart to align on a carbon driver discrepancy or walk through a data request \- always leading with data lineage and methodology clarity, since regional teams often hold their own numbers. Back at your desk, you update Carbon Reporting Deck tabs for your regions, validate CI calculations, and dig into any variances that don't tie to plan. You sync with your senior team member to review findings, prioritize open items, and decide what needs escalation versus what you can resolve independently. Depending on the point in the month, your afternoon might involve supporting a planning cycle deliverable (OP1/3YF, OP2, Glidepath), pulling together inputs for a leadership review, or scoping a process improvement to reduce manual reconciliation work.  

  

About the team  

Carbon Planning \& Analysis sits within WW Operations Finance and was built from scratch in 2024 to bridge carbon science and financial planning across Amazon's largest and most complex emissions source. The team serves as the Finance Single Threaded Leader for carbon intensity reporting, planning, and data integrity across NA, EU, and ROW \- covering 10\+ business units and over 45MM tCO2 of annual operations\-wide emissions. CP\&A owns the monthly carbon month\-end close, the Carbon Reporting Deck (WW Ops' single source of truth for CI), and multi\-year carbon planning (OP1/3YF, OP2\), directly informing decisions at the VP and S\-team level in support of the Climate Pledge's net zero by 2040 commitment. It's a small, high\-visibility team that combines rigorous financial modeling with deep carbon domain expertise, and is actively building out AI\-native automation for data quality checks and variance commentary. This role will report to a senior CP\&A team member and work alongside peers covering NA carbon planning and reporting.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or experience in relevant finance roles
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
* Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
* Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
* Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

 **Who you are:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
* Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade\-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
* Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
* A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
* Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
* Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI\-oriented enablement measures.
* Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
* Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

**Tech Environment**


AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations


Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform


Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


  
### **About Us**

**Company Background**


Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.


Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.


With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

jobs.title: Programista / Programistka Full-stack
AI Expert (RAG, Semantic Search, bazy wektorowe)
jobs.description:
Do Euvicowego Managed Teamu poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko **AI Expert** , która będzie pełnić rolę eksperta pierwszego kontaktu w obszarze sztucznej inteligencji. Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna nowoczesne rozwiązania AI, ale potrafi również ocenić ich biznesową wartość, zaprojektować odpowiednią architekturę i skutecznie doprowadzić wdrożenie do środowiska produkcyjnego.

  

  

To wyjątkowa okazja, aby współtworzyć kierunek rozwoju kompetencji AI w organizacji oraz realizować projekty dla klientów z Polski i zagranicy. Poszukujemy praktyka, który ma za sobą udane wdrożenia produkcyjne wykorzystujące technologie takie jak **RAG, Semantic Search czy bazy wektorowe** i potrafi podejmować decyzje architektoniczne poparte doświadczeniem, a nie tylko teorią.

  

  

Pierwszym projektem, do którego dołączysz, będzie współpraca przy rozwoju platformy klasy Enterprise Document Management. Produkt obsługuje miliony dokumentów i wykorzystywany jest przez klientów działających w środowiskach objętych wysokimi wymaganiami compliance. Głównym celem projektu jest zaprojektowanie i wdrożenie semantycznego wyszukiwania, które zastąpi lub rozszerzy tradycyjne podejście oparte wyłącznie na full\-text search i OCR.

  

  

Dołączysz do międzynarodowego zespołu produktowego i będziesz odpowiadać za ocenę technologii, przygotowanie rekomendacji architektonicznych, wybór odpowiednich rozwiązań wektorowych oraz przekazanie wiedzy zespołowi klienta.

  

  

**Technologie:**

RAG, Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, SQL Server 2025 VECTOR, pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Dense Vectors, LLM, Embeddings, Hybrid Search, Reranking, .NET, MS SQL Server, Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, MCP, AI Agents

  

  

**Dlaczego warto?**

* Dołączysz jako jeden z pierwszych ekspertów odpowiedzialnych za rozwój kompetencji AI w organizacji liczącej około 120 specjalistów
* Będziesz mieć realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju usług i rozwiązań AI oferowanych klientom
* Weźmiesz udział w projektach dla klientów z USA, Wielkiej Brytanii, krajów DACH oraz Skandynawii
* Będziesz pracować nad rzeczywistymi decyzjami architektonicznymi i wdrożeniami produkcyjnymi, a nie wyłącznie nad Proof of Concept
* Otrzymasz możliwość współpracy z zespołami deweloperskimi, QA, DevOps, UX i architektami
* Zyskasz dużą autonomię działania oraz wpływ na wybór technologii i kierunek realizowanych projektów
* Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązania wykorzystujące najnowsze technologie związane z GenAI, LLM i wyszukiwaniem semantycznym
  

  

**Zadania:**

* Prowadzenie najbardziej wymagających technicznie projektów AI realizowanych dla klientów firmy
* Projektowanie architektury rozwiązań opartych o LLM, RAG oraz Semantic Search
* Ocena wykonalności technologicznej nowych inicjatyw AI oraz rekomendowanie optymalnych rozwiązań
* Analiza wydajności i skalowalności rozwiązań wykorzystujących bazy i wyszukiwarki wektorowe
* Projektowanie pipeline’ów indeksowania, strategii chunkingu i procesu generowania embeddingów
* Tworzenie benchmarków wydajnościowych oraz analiza jakości wyszukiwania semantycznego
* Podejmowanie decyzji dotyczących wykorzystania baz wektorowych oraz usług AI w środowiskach SaaS, private cloud i on\-premise
* Udział w warsztatach discovery, spotkaniach presalesowych i konsultacjach technicznych z klientami
* Przedstawianie i obrona rekomendacji architektonicznych przed technicznymi decydentami po stronie klienta
* Mentoring zespołów projektowych oraz rozwijanie kompetencji AI w organizacji
* Prowadzenie wewnętrznych szkoleń oraz definiowanie standardów i dobrych praktyk w obszarze sztucznej inteligencji
  

  

**Nasze oczekiwania:**

* Udokumentowane wdrożenie produkcyjne rozwiązania wykorzystującego Semantic Search, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) lub technologie wektorowe
* Praktyczne doświadczenie z co najmniej jedną bazą lub usługą wektorową, taką jak Azure AI Search, pgvector, SQL Server VECTOR, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant lub Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Dense Vectors
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu strategii chunkingu dokumentów oraz budowie procesów retrieval opartych o embeddingi
* Znajomość technik oceny jakości wyszukiwania, takich jak recall, precision, hybrid search czy reranking
* Umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania architektury rozwiązań AI i podejmowania decyzji technologicznych
* Doświadczenie w analizie wydajności i skalowalności systemów produkcyjnych
* Umiejętność przygotowywania benchmarków technologicznych i przedstawiania wyników klientom
* Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego umożliwiająca codzienną współpracę w środowisku międzynarodowym
* Gotowość do pracy na styku ról inżynierskich, architektonicznych, konsultingowych oraz presalesowych
* Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne i prezentacyjne
  

  

**Mile widziane:**

* Znajomość ekosystemu Microsoft Azure, w szczególności Azure OpenAI oraz Azure AI Search
* Doświadczenie w pracy z technologiami .NET oraz Microsoft SQL Server
* Praktyczna znajomość self\-hostowanych modeli embeddingowych i inferencyjnych (Ollama, vLLM, ONNX Runtime)
* Doświadczenie z systemami dostarczanymi jednocześnie w modelu SaaS i on\-premise
* Znajomość zagadnień związanych z MCP, agentami AI oraz orkiestracją LLM
* Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu szkoleń, warsztatów lub mentoringu technicznego
* Doświadczenie w pracy z klientami enterprise działającymi w środowiskach regulowanych
  

  

**Model pracy:** zdalnie (Polska) / hybrydowo / on\-site


**Preferowana lokalizacja:** województwo śląskie (okazjonalne spotkania zespołowe)


**Forma współpracy:** B2B


**Start projektu:** połowa października


**Czas trwania projektu:** długoterminowa współpraca


**Wymiar:** full time

  

  

**Przebieg procesu rekrutacyjnego:**

* Rozmowa techniczna z zespołem (ok. 60 minut) obejmująca architekturę oraz doświadczenia z rzeczywistych wdrożeń AI


* Opcjonalna rozmowa z technicznym przedstawicielem klienta

  

  

**WAŻNE INFORMACJE:**

* W trakcie procesu rekrutacji na kolejnych jej etapach wymagana będzie weryfikacja tożsamości kandydata.
