jobs.title: IT Support Consultant, Technical Enablement
jobs.description:
**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp !


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!  



**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

As a global leader in our space, SimCorp is on a journey to transform from a traditional enterprise software company into a technology\-enabled services business, while maintaining our double\-digit, highly profitable growth. To further support and drive this journey, we are transitioning to a horizontal delivery model, aligned to client outcomes. Within this setup, the Technical Enablement team plays a critical role in ensuring that value stream teams have the technical foundations, tooling, infrastructure, and support needed to deliver efficiently and reliably.


**We are looking for an IT Support Consultant** who enjoys solving complex technical problems, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes ownership of issues from start to finish.


The Technical Enablement team is often the last point of escalation when delivery teams encounter technical challenges. As an IT Support Consultant, you will act as a trusted technical partner, helping teams navigate infrastructure, tooling, testing, and configuration\-related issues.


You will investigate problems, coordinate with specialist teams when required , and ensure issues are followed through to resolution. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, a structured troubleshooting mindset, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


This is not a traditional helpdesk role. You will be expected to understand technical systems, read and debug code when needed, and contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of our delivery environment.


**W** **HAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Provide first\-line technical support for infrastructure, tooling, environments, and development processes.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and coordinate resolution of technical issues , collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Take ownership of problems from initial investigation through successful resolution.
* Support and maintain test environments and end\-to\-end infrastructure.
* Monitor automated test executions and analyze failures to identify root causes.
* Collaborate with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and product teams to resolve delivery blockers.
* Assist business consultants in working with configuration and DevOps\-based development practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, quality, and delivery reliability.
**WHAT WE VALUE**

Your high\-quality communication, coordination and interpersonal skills will enable you to direct all activities to planned outcomes. As our preferred candidate , you will have :


* Experience in technical support, application support, IT operations, software delivery, DevOps, or a similar technical role.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate incidents and identify root causes.
* Ability to take ownership of issues and drive them through to resolution, coordinating with multiple stakeholders when needed.
* Basic understanding of software development principles and the software delivery lifecycle.
* Experience with, or willingness to work with, technologies and tools such as:
* C\# or another object\-oriented programming language
* Git and source control systems
* Test automation frameworks
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Azure DevOps or similar platforms
* Scripting languages (PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.)
* Infrastructure, application, and environment troubleshooting
* Monitoring and logging tools
* SQL and database fundamentals
* Ability to read, understand, and debug code, even if software development is not your primary role.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in an Agile environment.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on increasing efficiency, quality, and delivery reliability.
**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp , we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. SimCorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.


There is never just only one route \- we practice a personalized approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**Compensation ranges are** **being** **disclosed** **at** **the** **initial** **stage** **of candidate engagement.**

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp : www.simcorp.com/career  



**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site.


**Please note that** only applications sent through our system will be processed.


At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


For any questions you are welcome to contact **Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, at "** hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com **"** . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Job Advertisement: Software Developer – Desktop & Diagnostics Tools (C# / .NET)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 700 employees and from part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 409,000 employees worldwide.


We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources \- the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is **"Invented for life".**

 **Job Description**  

At Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås, we are shaping the future of sustainable living. As a key  

player within the Bosch Home Comfort division, we develop and manufacture world\-class heating  

and cooling solutions.

  

We belong to the Electric Solutions (ES) business unit, dedicated to driving the global energy  

transition through state\-of\-the\-art electric heat pump technology. To keep our high\-efficiency  

systems running flawlessly, our network of over 1,000 service technicians across Europe and our  

engineering labs rely on dependable, modern desktop tools and software utilities.

  

We are now seeking a skilled Software Developer to join our team in Tranås. In this role, you will  

take ownership of key applications like our SWDL (Software Download) field tool and develop  

custom logging, data acquisition, and diagnostic utilities that empower our laboratory engineers  

during heat pump testing and verification.

**Your Contribution to Our Mission**

* **Desktop Application Development**: Design, build, and maintain modern Windowsdesktop applications using C\# and the .NET ecosystem.
* **Empower Lab Engineers:** Develop intuitive data logging, monitoring, and diagnosticutilities used by test engineers to capture and analyze system behavior in real time during laboratory testing.
* **Flashing \& Device Updates:** Maintain and improve reliable software download and firmware flashing routines to support device updates in both laboratory environments and field service operations.
* **Hardware \& Device Communication:** Implement and support robust communication interfaces connecting desktop software with embedded controllers and test equipment (such as serial and CAN\-based communication).
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Work closely with embedded firmware engineers, hardware specialists, and lab testers to align on technical requirements and validate software tool releases.
* **Usability \& Continuous Improvement**: Enhance UI/UX, automate data visualization, and streamline workflows to make complex diagnostics and testing simple and reliable.

  

**Qualifications** **Who Are You?**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Core Competence in C\#:** Strong proficiency in desktop software development using C\# and .NET (.NET Framework / modern .NET).
* **Communication \& Diagnostics Awareness:** Experience or familiarity with hardwareinterfacing software, device communication protocols (e.g., CAN bus), and diagnostic or flashing procedures (such as UDS/bootloaders).
* **Python Knowledge (Preferred)**: Familiarity with Python is a valuable advantage for scripting, test automation, data analysis, and rapid prototyping.
* **Embedded Understanding (Preferred)**: Knowledge of C or C\+\+ is a plus, helping you collaborate effectively with the firmware engineers developing the target microcontrollers.
* **Lab \& Tooling Experience:** Practical background with test tooling, data loggers, telemetry software, or test automation is a strong plus.
* **Problem\-solving Mindset:** A structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting software interactions with hardware devices and debugging communication traces.
* **Languages**: Professional working proficiency in English is required. Knowledge of Swedish is considered a strong merit for day\-to\-day collaboration across our local site.

  

**Additional Information** **What We Offer You**

* **Meaningful Impact:** Direct ownership of tools that are critical to both daily R\&D testing in our labs and service operations across Europe.
* **Flexibility**: Modern hybrid working options and flexible hours supporting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Sustainable Tech**: The opportunity to be part of an organization dedicated to cutting\-edge green technologies (electrification, propane heat pumps, intelligent climate control).
* **Growth \& Culture**: Broad opportunities for personal and professional development within the global Bosch Group.


At Bosch, we care for you, our business, and our environment. Our promise to our associates is rock\-solid. We grow together into countless roles, positions, and opportunities and we are interested in developing the “whole” you, not just the “9 to 5” you, because life is all about balance.


At Bosch, we celebrate you.Our people are what make us remarkable. Therefore we recognize your contribution with competitive salary packages, collective agreements with unions, occupational pension, and other attractive benefits, such as wellness contribution, smart work, flexible working hours, Gym at site.


At Bosch, we believe everyone is different and that is what we love. Get inspired by a cooperative, open, respectful, and trustworthy workplace where you can be yourself and be enriched by the perspectives of our community around the globe.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Operations Supervisor**


*Do you enjoy creating structure, keeping priorities moving, and connecting the dots across a complex operational environment? As Operations Supervisor at GlobalConnect, you will work closely with our Customer Operations leadership team to strengthen operational follow\-up and turn priorities into action.*



This is a broad coordination role where daily operations meet continuous improvement and transformation. You will have visibility across Customer Operations in the Nordics and work with colleagues, leaders, specialists, and customers across functions and countries.


**To succeed in this role, you likely have:**


* Experience from a coordination, cross\-functional, or business\-facing role in a larger organisation preferably from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment.


* Experience with operational follow\-up combined with improvement initiatives, transformation, or project execution.


* A good understanding of customer delivery, service management, KPI follow\-up, and management reporting, including experience preparing presentations and decision\-support material for management.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Scandinavian language.


**About the role and the team**



Customer Operations is responsible for the operational delivery of services to GlobalConnect customers across the Nordics. The department includes Customer Support, Service Desk functions across several countries, the Advanced Solutions Service Desk, and Operations Management.



Based in our Stockholm office, you will support structure, coordination, and progress across operational and strategic priorities. You will work closely with the Senior Director, Customer Operations, who is based in Fornebu, Norway, while reporting to the Head of Operations Management.



The role brings you close to both daily operations and longer\-term development. Over time, the scope may also develop to include people management responsibilities, depending on organisational development and business needs.


**What you’ll be working on**


* Coordinate and follow up operational priorities, actions, decisions, and deliverables across Customer Operations.


* Drive structured follow\-up of transformation initiatives, improvement activities, and priority deliverables.


* Monitor KPIs, trends, and risk areas and coordinate relevant follow\-up actions across the department.


* Prepare management presentations, status updates, reporting, and decision\-support material.


* Support strategic customer follow\-up, critical cases, and escalations, including participation in relevant customer meetings.


* Coordinate across Customer Support, Service Desk, Advanced Solutions Service Desk, Operations Management, and other relevant functions to support progress and execution.


**Who we are looking for**



You work in a structured way and are comfortable balancing immediate operational needs with longer\-term priorities. You can identify what matters, create clarity across several activities, and keep follow\-up moving when priorities change.



The role involves frequent interaction with leaders, customers, specialists, and colleagues across countries, so clear communication and the ability to build effective working relationships are important. You are motivated by improving how things work and by turning plans, decisions, and improvement initiatives into progress.



Relevant higher education in management, administration, technology, finance, or a related field is beneficial, but relevant experience can compensate for formal education. Experience from telecom, IT, operations, service management, or another complex delivery environment is also an advantage.


**Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.**


**Our recruitment process**


* Talent Acquisition Screening interview
* Hiring Manager interview
* Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition
* Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder
* Final alignment meeting
* References


**Practical information**


* Workplace: GlobalConnect's office in Stockholm.


* The role requires regular travel to Fornebu, Norway and the other locations where Customer Operations colleagues are based.


* GlobalConnect does not offer relocation packages or work visa sponsorship for this role.



This is an opportunity to take a central role in how Customer Operations coordinates priorities, follows up performance, and progresses operational improvements across the Nordics.



No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.



Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!


**Great Place to Work**

* Enhanced Parental Leave: Flexible return options
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible work arrangements
* Learning: Skill development

* Modern Workspaces: Inspiring environments
* Insurance Coverage: Your safety net

jobs.title: Process- och Ugnsingenjör
jobs.description:
**About the Position**
======================

För att framställa de mest hållbara och konkurrenskraftiga produkterna till våra kunder strävar vi efter att ständigt förbättra och optimera våra produktionsprocesser. Höganäs är världsledande inom metallpulverindustrin och processerna är energiintensiva. Vi står inför spännande utmaningar för att göra dessa processer klimatneutrala och cirkulära. Inom gruppen för ”Core Process Development” samlar vi vår kärnkompetensen inom smältning, atomisering, reduktionsprocesser, glödgning, pulverhantering och energiteknik.


Höganäs processer är till stor del unika och vi designar och bygger därför vår utrustning själva.


Som Process\- och Ugnsingenjör kommer du huvudsakligen jobba med våra tunnelugns\- och bandugnsprocesser. Här ingår allt från nyinvesteringar och moderniseringar till processförbättringar och effektiviseringar av befintliga. Ugnarna kan vara både el\- och gaseldade med avancerade säkerhetssystem.


Tjänsten är placerad i Höganäs och gruppen är en del av Product \& Technology inom PMT divisionen.


**Din profil**

* Vi söker dig som har en relevant civilingenjörsexamen i maskinteknik, kemiteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet/fördjupning inom strömningsteknik, värme\- och massöverföring, termodynamik, förbränningsteknik och metallurgi är starkt meriterande.
* Vi ser att du har åtminstone 5 till 10 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom liknande arbetsområde.
* Vi ser gärna att du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med naturgas och/eller vätgas. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av ugnar och högtemperaturprocesser är det ett extra plus.
* Då du kommer att arbeta i en internationell miljö men även i nära samarbete med produktionen i Sverige behöver du behärska både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

**Personlig profil**

Som person är du nyfiken och inte är rädd för att kavla upp ärmarna och hjälpa till där det behövs. Du bör ha fallenhet för kritiskt tänkande, vara noggrann och ha förmåga att både fokusera på detaljer och se helheten. Du bör även ha ett praktiskt handlag. Du behöver också kunna rapportera resultat på ett strukturerat och lättförståeligt sätt.


**Intresserad?**

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 15 oktober. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.


**Kontaktpersoner**

Stellan Bengtsson


Senior Manager Core Process Development


stellan.bengtsson@hoganas.com


Ebba Folkesson


Talent Acquisition Specialist


ebba.folkesson@hoganas.com


**Working at Höganäs**
----------------------

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world \- and we \- face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net\-zero climate emissions.


**More about Höganäs**
----------------------

  

Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials.


The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. Höganäs collaborates with customers across multiple industries to develop innovative solutions, including applications in automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com  

  



**Interested? Apply today!**

jobs.title: Automationsingenjör till industrinära IT
jobs.description:
Vi bygger nästa generations IT för industrin, lösningar som styr, mäter och förbättrar produktion hos riktiga tillverkare. Nu söker vi en driven automationsingenjör som vill ta med sig sin kunskap från golvet och koppla ihop den med modern mjukvara.
  
Det här är en roll för dig som gillar bredd framför spets. Du behöver inte vara djupast i världen på en enskild PLC\-plattform. Vi letar efter dig som ser hela kedjan, från maskin och styrsystem hela vägen upp till data, integration och beslutsstöd. Och framför allt: du gillar att jobba fram lösningar nära och tillsammans med kunden, inte i ett stängt rum utifrån en färdig spec.
  
Automationen är ett ben vi vill bygga upp och växa, och här får du en central och drivande roll. Det innebär mycket eget ansvar, men också en stor möjlighet att forma hur vi jobbar med automation, vilka lösningar vi satsar på och vart vårt erbjudande tar vägen. Du får vara med och lägga grunden, inte förvalta något som redan är satt.
  
VAD DU KOMMER ATT GÖRA
  
Förstå kundens produktion och verksamhet, och tillsammans med dem forma lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad
  
Jobba brett över hela stacken, från PLC, SCADA och OPC ute i maskinen till integration, data och moderna IT\-lösningar
  
Koppla ihop OT och IT, hjälpa industriella system att prata med varandra (till exempel UNS och MQTT)
  
Driva uppdrag hela vägen, från idé och design till driftsättning och uppföljning hos kund
  
Använda AI\-verktyg för att jobba snabbare och smartare utan att tumma på kvalitet eller säkerhet
  
Vara en trygg partner för kunden, någon de vill ha kvar och ringa igen
  
Dela din kunskap med teamet och lära dig nytt tillbaka
  
  

VEM VI SÖKER
  
Vi bryr oss mer om vem du är än exakt vilka system du jobbat i förut. Din nyfikenhet, ditt driv och din vilja att lära nytt väger minst lika tungt som raderna på ditt CV.
  
**Erfarenhet av industriell automation:** PLC, SCADA, OPC eller liknande i skarp produktionsmiljö
  
Bredd framför spets, du trivs med att röra dig mellan olika tekniker och discipliner snarare än att gräva ner dig i en enda
  
Ett genuint intresse för kunden, du lyssnar, förstår verksamheten och jobbar fram lösningen tillsammans med dem
  
Självständighet, du kan driva ett uppdrag och ta ansvar hela vägen
  
Vilja att bredda dig och koppla ihop den klassiska automationsvärlden med modern IT och AI
  
God kommunikationsförmåga och lust att jobba i team
  
  

MERITERANDE
  
Vi letar efter en bred profil, så ju fler av områdena nedan du har erfarenhet av, på ett eller annat sätt, desto bättre. Vi förväntar oss inte att någon behärskar allt. Har du djup på några och nyfikenhet på resten är det precis rätt person.
  
**Styrsystem:** PLC\-programmering, främst Siemens men gärna andra fabrikat, ABB\-styrsystem, HMI\-utveckling och idrifttagning, motordrifter, servo och frekvensomriktare, felsökning i skarp drift
  
**Robotik och maskinseende:** robotar från till exempel ABB eller Omron, vision
  
**El och hårdvara:** elritningar, bygga och koppla elskåp, sensorer och givare, pneumatik och hydraulik
  
**Industriell kommunikation:** PROFINET, PROFIBUS, IO\-Link, RS\-232, RS\-485, socket och TCP/IP, OPC UA, MQTT, UNS\-filosofi
  
**OT\-utrustning:** vågar, skannrar och annan produktionsnära utrustning, IoT\-enheter och edge\-servrar
  
**IT och mjukvara:** C\# eller Python, Docker och Linux, tidsseriedata och decentraliserade system, SCADA\- och IIoT\-plattformar som Ignition, MES och produktionsteknik, AI\-verktyg i ditt dagliga arbete
  
  

**Och framför allt:** ett generellt brett teknikintresse och genuin lust att lära nytt.
  
VAD VI ERBJUDER
  
Tekniskt ledarskap och mentorskap. De som leder teamet har själva byggt team och produkter, och lägger tid på att du ska växa
  
En bred roll där du jobbar över hela kedjan, från maskin till modern IT
  
Nära kundkontakt och stort eget ansvar
  
Ett litet, sammansvetsat team med korta beslutsvägar och utan prestige
  
Ett modernt, AI\-drivet arbetssätt genom hela leveransen
  
En chans att bygga upp vårt automationsben från grunden och forma det åt ditt håll
  
Tid och utrymme för lärande och utveckling
  
  

Du jobbar nära kunderna och deras produktion, och det du levererar går i drift och används på riktigt. Vägen från idé till färdig lösning är kort. Gillar du att lösa riktiga problem tillsammans med människor tror vi att du kommer trivas hos oss.
  
OM REALPROIT
  
**RealProIT bygger produktionsnära IT för industrin:** stödsystem, integrationer och moderna plattformar som gör tillverkning smartare. Vi är en del av RealCognit Group och ett litet, snabbfotat bolag där varje person gör verklig skillnad. Vi sitter i Örebro och Västerås.
  
Vi är ett gäng med många intressen, från sport och skapande till riktigt bra kod, och vi värdesätter balans och ett liv utanför jobbet. Hos oss får du kombinera automationens verklighet med modern mjukvaruutveckling, och vara med och bygga något från grunden.
  
ÖVRIG INFORMATION
  
Vi rekryterar löpande och intervjuar efter hand, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Målet är att rätt person ska börja så snart som möjligt.
  
I den här rekryteringsprocessen använder vi AI\-verktyg som stöd i vårt arbete. Alla beslut fattas alltid av oss människor.

På Ductus vill vi ha en öppen och prestigelös miljö där vi hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Samarbete, kommunikation och snabb feedback är viktiga delar av hur vi arbetar.


Under din LIA arbetar du nära våra utvecklare och får möjlighet att både bidra i arbetet och bygga vidare på dina kunskaper genom praktisk erfarenhet.

jobs.title: Applikationsexperter till Strömmande dataplattform
jobs.description:
Vi söker applikationsexperter inom AVEVA PI/OSIsoft PI till en myndighet inom elkraft för arbete med en strömmande dataplattform.


Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Sundbyberg.


Uppdraget omfattar en IT\-specialist nivå 2 på 100 % och två IT\-specialister nivå 3 på 50 % vardera.


Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

**Uppdraget**


Uppdraget avser arbete med en dataplattform baserad på AVEVA PI System. Konsulterna ska stödja IT\-förvaltningen med vidmakthållande och vidareutveckling av systemet i nära samarbete med systemansvarig IT, övriga medarbetare inom IT\-förvaltningen och pågående projekt.


Arbetet omfattar bland annat felrättning, användarstöd, daglig IT\-drift och underhåll samt anpassningar, förbättringar och vidareutveckling av lösningen.

 **Arbetsuppgifter**


Driva och genomföra uppgraderingar och systemförbättringar samt installera, konfigurera och iordningställa nya systemmiljöer.


Vidareutveckla systemet genom teknisk kravspecificering, framtagande av nya lösningar och skapande av integrationer mot datakällor.


Ge stöd och support till interna och externa parter samt samarbeta med andra IT\-förvaltningar, driftsorganisationer, projekt och intern personal.


Samordna tester och själv genomföra delar av testarbetet samt säkerställa att tekniska förändringar inte påverkar driftsäkerhet eller befintliga funktioner.


Hantera IT\-incidenter och genomföra felsökning i det egna systemet och tillsammans med angränsande IT\-system.


Uppdatera systemdokumentation, exempelvis drift\- och förvaltningsanvisningar samt dokumentation av systemberoenden.


Delta i IT\-säkerhetsarbete, bland annat risk\- och sårbarhetsanalyser och omvärldsbevakning inom informationssäkerhet.


Ge användarstöd för framtagande och byggande av rapporter i PI Vision.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Expert – Product Development
jobs.description:
*We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Expert to support the development of several new products with high requirements on cybersecurity, secure software development and compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).*

*In this role, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the product development lifecycle and provide hands\-on support to developers and other technical stakeholders. The assignment combines cybersecurity expertise with software development, secure architecture and implementation.*

*The products include both desktop applications and embedded systems, with technologies ranging from hardware\-near firmware to real\-time operating systems and PC\-based software.*

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse current cybersecurity maturity and support compliance with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
* Perform cybersecurity risk assessments and follow up on implementation activities with relevant stakeholders.
* Drive and coordinate cybersecurity activities within product development projects.
* Perform and coordinate security testing, including DSAC testing.
* Conduct attack surface analyses and threat modeling.
* Review security\-critical source code.
* Support system hardening, including Windows images.
* Ensure compliance with internal cybersecurity requirements and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes.
* Identify and drive improvements within secure development practices.
* Participate in the requirements process and define appropriate security requirements.
* Design and implement security solutions for desktop applications and embedded systems.
* Drive security updates, vulnerability management and remediation processes.
* Prepare cybersecurity documentation covering areas such as architecture, manuals, processes and agreements.
* Prepare development projects for cybersecurity and security reviews.
* Monitor relevant vulnerabilities, threats and security updates.
* Support assessments of suppliers' compliance with cybersecurity requirements.
* Collaborate with internal and global cybersecurity stakeholders.
* Technical Environment

**Experience within one or several of the following areas is highly relevant:**

* Embedded systems and firmware
* C / C\+\+
* VHDL / Assembler
* Real\-time operating systems (RTOS)
* C\# / Java
* Windows\-based applications and environments
* Secure software architecture and implementation
* Vulnerability management and security testing

**Your Profile**


We are looking for someone with solid experience in Cyber Security within product development, ideally combined with a background in software development, software architecture or embedded systems.


You should have practical experience working with secure development processes and be comfortable supporting development teams in areas such as security requirements, secure design, implementation, testing and vulnerability management.


Strong collaboration and communication skills are essential, as the role involves working with a wide range of technical stakeholders in both local and international environments.

**Experience with CRA compliance, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC), threat modeling, security testing and security architecture is highly meritorious.**

**This is a full\-time consultant position through Incluso, starting in Mid\-October. It is a five\-month contract.**

**We will review applications on an ongoing basis.**

**Application deadline: 25 September.**

**For more information about this role, please contact Karin Persson**

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
jobs.description:
Kumpan
  
Vi tycker att det ska vara roligt att gå till arbetet. Att ha en arbetsplats som bygger på gemensamma värderingar, där kollektivet och kompetensen står i centrum. Våra Kumpaner är vår viktigaste tillgång, och det är genom dem som många av våra beslut formas.
  
Arbete är inte allt här i livet
  
Visst är det kul att arbeta – särskilt när man får lösa spännande tekniska problem tillsammans med andra utvecklare. Men ibland kommer livet emellan.
  
Vi är en flexibel arbetsplats och litar på att våra Kumpaner tar kloka beslut som fungerar för både individen och företaget. Hos oss får du sex veckors semester, flexibilitet i vardagen och möjlighet att ibland bryta vardagen med konferenser eller gemensamma aktiviteter.
  
Det ska löna sig att arbeta
  
Bra folk ska ha bra lön.
  
Utöver en konkurrenskraftig lön erbjuder vi en generös pensionsavsättning och något vi tycker är extra viktigt: här delar vi på vinsten. När det går bra för oss ska det märkas för alla.
  
Vi maxar även friskvårdsbidraget och erbjuder en riktigt bra sjukvårdsförsäkring.
  
Kumpaner är konsulter med gemenskap
  
Vår samlingsplats är kontoret vid Mosebacke. Här träffas vi några dagar i veckan, samarbetar och löser våra kunders tekniska utmaningar tillsammans.
  
Luncher, spontana diskussioner om teknik, brädspel – framåt eftermiddagen hör till vardagen.
  
Vem tror vi att du är
  
Du är en nyfiken utvecklare som gillar att lösa problem och bygga stabila system. Du uppskattar att arbeta i team där kunskapsdelning och tekniska diskussioner är en naturlig del av vardagen.
  
Det du behöver kunna när du börjar hos oss
  
Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk bakgrund inom Microsofts utvecklingsplattform. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
  
Minst sju års erfarenhet av utveckling i .NET / C\#
  
**Erfarenhet av ASP.NET Core och utveckling av moderna API:** er
  
Erfarenhet av containerbaserade miljöer, exempelvis Docker och Kubernetes
  
Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis Scrum eller SAFe
  
Erfarenhet av moderna frontendramverk, exempelvis Angular, React eller Vue
  
Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska, både i tal och skrift
  
  

Det är meriterande om du också har
  
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
  
Erfarenhet av AI\-lösningar, exempelvis LLM\-integrationer eller AI\-baserade funktioner i system
  
  

Lite mer om oss
  
Vi är en webb\- och konsultbyrå som funnits sedan 2004\. Vi utvecklar webb och appar i open source\-miljö och arbetar med kunder inom många olika branscher och tekniska miljöer.
  
Vårt kontor ligger uppe på Mosebacke, precis bredvid Södra Teatern.
  
För fler frågor kontakta nea@kumpan.se.

jobs.title: Digital Development Specialist
jobs.description:
Digital Customer Offering (DCO) is a business function within Fortum Consumer Solutions, where business and technology come together. At DCO, we create superior digital offerings and experiences for our 2,4 million consumer and enterprise customers. We innovate and find new ways to digitalize our offerings and processes. We collaborate closely with our stakeholders and external partners. Through cross\-functional collaboration, agility and sustainability focus, we strive to make our customers’ increasingly digital lives easier with our services. We serve clients in the Nordics as well as Poland and Spain.

  

**About the role**


We are looking for talented and passionate individuals to join our Enterprise Online team. This role involves capturing user and business needs and translating these into initiatives that maximize customer value and ensure a world\-class user experience for our Nordic customer base. United by our passion for technology, curiosity about user experience, and dedication to excellence, we are looking for someone who shares our enthusiasm!

  

Your responsibilities will be:


* Bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions by gathering, analyzing, and documenting detailed business requirements, ensuring that digital offerings meet customer needs and align with Fortum's strategic objectives.
* Develop use cases, user stories, and use planning tools such as Jira and Miro to follow up and support development.
* Define, manage and communicate the Product backlog to stakeholders and team.
* Prioritize and ensure that work is being conducted according to plan and set goals and support in solving blockers.
* Manage multiple projects and adjust priorities based on changing business needs.
* Solve complex problems requiring an understanding of both business and technical aspects.
* Collaborate with team members to foster a customer\-centric approach.
* You will be part of the Enterprise Online team, focusing on developing and improving services for our enterprise customers. We work within an Agile approach, taking end\-to\-end responsibility for our area. Our team, consisting of 15 experts with diverse competencies, has a great atmosphere where we work hard and have fun. We offer a dynamic work environment where you can grow your skills and make an impact on Fortum’s business and customers.

  

This position can be located in our office in Espoo, Solna or Oslo.

  

**About you**


To succeed and thrive in this role, we see that you have:


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\-4 years of experience in digital development or a similar role.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with requirements management tools and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
* Previous experience from the energy industry is beneficial.
* Be fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.

  

**We offer you**
  

At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.


More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.

  

**Interested?**


Submit your application by **01\.10\.2026** at the latest. We will begin actively screening during the application period and hire as soon as the right candidate is found. We will not consider applications outside our recruiting system. If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact hiring manager Thale Fritzner by email thale.christina.fritzner@fortum.com.
  

For Swedish candidates: contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of **this page****.**

  

**We are Fortum**
  

Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best\-in\-class low\-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2\-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi\-validated
  

emission reduction targets on our way towards net\-zero by 2040\. For our \~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. Fortum's share is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. fortum.com

jobs.title: Mjukvaruingenjör inom testautomation
jobs.description:

Utveckla testautomation och effektiva testflöden i C\# för serieproduktion
  
Underhålla och vidareutveckla befintliga sluttestriggar
  
Felsöka testutrustning och optimera testernas prestanda
  
Ta fram nya testlösningar och ny testlogik för befintliga och framtida produkter
  
Integrera mätutrustning och testinstrument, exempelvis digitala multimetrar, oscilloskop, CAN\-/LIN\-gränssnitt och strömförsörjningsaggregat

Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Mätinstrument och annan testutrustning
  
Spårbarhetssystem eller produktionstestning
  
  

Som person är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att arbeta praktiskt med tekniska utmaningar. Du tar initiativ, känner ansvar för ditt arbete och följer gärna ett problem hela vägen från felsökning till en fungerande lösning.

* Physical security
* Personnel security
* Information security

* At least two years of experience working within one or more security disciplines
* The ability to communicate effectively in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Developer
jobs.description:
At Manta Marine Technologies, we are committed to advancing greener shipping through intelligent technologies — supporting operational efficiency, reduced carbon emissions and fuel consumption as well as simplifying emissions reporting. We provide a wide range of innovative and intelligent maritime technologies, including Vessel Optimisation solutions, Marine Electrification systems and comprehensive Lifecycle Services for all our products. Manta Marine is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Sweden, Poland, and China.
  
Do you want to help us to promote a healthy planet for future generations? We are currently seeking a Senior Embedded Developer to enhance our Vessel Optimization team.
  
  

Main responsibilities
  
As part of Manta Marine Technologies Vessel Optimization business line, you’ll work with FuelOpt, our onboard fuel optimisation system installed on more than 500 vessels worldwide. FuelOpt helps ship owners improve operational performance, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions through real\-time propulsion optimisation.
  
As a Senior Embedded Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining embedded applications running on our proprietary hardware platform. You will work closely with other developers, application engineers, and adjacent product teams to deliver reliable and high\-quality solutions for vessel operating worldwide.
  
The role combines software development, troubleshooting, product improvement, and technical collaboration across the organization.
  
  

Key responsibilities
  
Develop and maintain embedded software in C running on real\-time embedded kernel, on in\-house hardware
  
Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of our proprietary hardware platform
  
Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating system, and application layers
  
Participate in concept development and implementation of new product features
  
Develop and maintain internal tools that support system configuration and deployment
  
Integrate software with operator\-facing HMI solutions
  
Review, test, and improve code quality and development practices
  
Collaborate with adjacent engineering teams on shared solutions
  
Provide technical support and expertise to internal stakeholders and customer\-facing teams when needed
  
  

Background and skills
  
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Developer with at least six years of professional experience in embedded software development. You hold a BSc or MSc in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. You have strong programming skills in C and experience working in complex embedded environments.
  
  

**Furthermore, you have:**  

Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) or real\-time embedded kernels
  
Experience developing software on custom or non\-standard hardware platforms
  
Strong debugging skills across hardware and software boundaries (e.g., JTAG)
  
Experience with industrial and embedded communication protocols such as TCP/IP, Modbus, serial communication, or similar
  
The ability to work independently and take technical ownership of solutions
  
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  
  

Meriting experience
  
Experience in one or several of the following areas is considered an advantage:
  
Experience with HMI integration (e.g., Beijer Electronics or similar industrial HMI platforms)
  
Familiarity with C\# for scripting/configuration tooling
  
Familiarity with Python for internal tooling/automation
  
Practical understanding of digital/analog I/O and basic electronics
  
Experience in maritime and/or industrial automation
  
Exposure to cybersecurity practices, especially in embedded/connected systems
  
Experience with IoT devices and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)
  
  

Personal qualities
  
We believe you are a curious and technically driven person who enjoys solving complex problems. You are analytical, structured, and take ownership of your work. As a senior developer, you are comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different teams. You enjoy sharing knowledge, contribute to a high\-quality engineering culture, and take a pragmatic approach to solving technical challenges.
  
  

What we offer
  
We offer an opportunity to be part of a market leading innovative global company in the forefront of green technology for ships. An open and inspiring environment where your energy will make a difference. We provide great potential for personal and professional development.
  
Manta Marine is committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing to do, but also the smart thing to do. Let’s make the world a greener place!
  
  

Application
  
When submitting your application, please include "Application – Senior Embedded Developer" in the subject line of your email. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Salesforce-utvecklare
jobs.description:
*Vill du vara med och forma hur AI förändrar Salesforce och framtidens kundupplevelser?*


Vi söker dig som är en skicklig utvecklare – men framför allt dig som är nyfiken på vad som händer när Salesforce, data och AI möts.


På Stretch Customer vill vi ligga i framkant och hjälpa våra kunder att gå från att prata om AI till att faktiskt skapa värde med det. Därför söker vi fler personer som vill vara drivers inom området. Du behöver inte kunna allt om AI idag. Däremot vill vi att du experimenterar, lär dig snabbt, utmanar gamla arbetssätt och tycker att den utveckling som sker just nu är riktigt spännande.

**Så här ser din vardag ut**


Som Salesforce\-utvecklare hos oss arbetar du hands\-on med spännande projekt, olika Salesforce Clouds och kunder med höga ambitioner.


Du utvecklar och designar tekniska lösningar tillsammans med våra affärskonsulter, projektledare och andra utvecklare. Allt oftare handlar det om möjligheterna som uppstår när CRM, data, automation och AI möts – exempelvis genom Agentforce, generativ AI och nya AI\-drivna arbetssätt.


Vi vill inte bara följa utvecklingen – vi vill vara med och driva den. Därför får du utrymme att experimentera, bygga prototyper, testa ny teknik och dela det du lär dig med både kollegor och kunder.

**Vem vi letar efter**

* Erfarenhet av Salesforce – exempelvis Apex, Lightning Components och Flows – eller minst fyra års erfarenhet som utvecklare inom exempelvis Java och/eller .NET.
* Erfarenhet av API, databasutveckling och integrationer.
* Ett stort intresse för AI och en vilja att utforska hur tekniken kan skapa verkligt affärsvärde. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Agentforce, generativ AI, LLM eller AI\-agenter är ett plus.
* Möjlighet att arbeta i Stockholm eller Göteborg 2–3 dagar i veckan.
* Starka kommunikativa färdigheter i svenska och engelska.

**Vi tror att du är**

* Nyfiken – du gillar att testa nya verktyg, tekniker och idéer.
* Drivande – du ser möjligheter, tar initiativ och får med dig andra.
* Teknisk med affärsförståelse – du gillar bra kod men är lika intresserad av vilket värde lösningen skapar.
* Kommunikativ och prestigelös – du delar gärna kunskap och tror på att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans.

**Och lite om oss**


Vi på Stretch Customer är ett gäng nyfikna och engagerade Salesforce\-konsulter som älskar att göra skillnad – för våra kunder, för varandra och för våra affärer.


Vi tror på att testa, lära och dela kunskap – och på att ha kul på vägen. Tillsammans skapar vi framgång för oss själva, våra kunder och hela Stretch.


Vi växer i både Stockholm och Göteborg och ser fram emot din ansökan!


Hej från oss på Stretch Customer!

Software Engineer I

Software engineers at Mastercard build the systems that process transactions, analyze data and detect fraud to gain insight into the direction of the economy on behalf of our customers. We are focused on building simple, safe and smart solutions that instill trust in every interaction. Our industry expertise is enhanced by our commitment to being a force for good in the world and to doing well by doing good.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About us**


At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.


At Davy, you are the difference.


Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high\-net\-worth individuals, self\-directed investors, small\-to\-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic \& international institutional investors.


Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.

An exciting opportunity has opened up in Commercial Team / Davy Private Clients. In the role, the successful candidate will:

**Reporting \& Performance Analysis**

* Produce and maintain regular management reports and dashboards.
* Monitor and analyse key business metrics, trends and performance indicators.
* Identify opportunities, risks and emerging trends through data analysis.
* Support the delivery of business performance reporting to management and key stakeholders.
* Develop reporting solutions that improve visibility, consistency and decision\-making.

**Business Analysis \& Decision Support**

* Conduct forecasting, trend analysis and scenario modelling to support business planning.
* Analyse business performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations.
* Assist management in evaluating business opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and planning activities through analytical input.
* Translate data into meaningful management information and business intelligence.

**Performance Management Support**

* Support the production and ongoing development of performance scorecards and reporting frameworks.
* Assist in tracking performance against agreed objectives and key metrics.
* Provide analytical support to managers and business stakeholders.
* Ensure performance data is accurate, timely and actionable.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of performance measurement processes.

**Data Management \& Governance**

* Support data quality improvement initiatives across business systems and processes.
* Assist in maintaining data integrity, consistency and governance standards.
* Identify data issues and work with stakeholders to implement corrective actions.
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of reporting and data management processes.
* Support business readiness activities associated with system and technology initiatives.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships across business functions.
* Act as a key liaison between operational teams and support functions in relation to reporting and analysis requirements.
* Gather and document business requirements for reporting and analytical needs.
* Present findings, insights and recommendations in a clear and concise manner.
* Support projects and initiatives that require analytical expertise and business insight.

  

**Requirements** **About you**

We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills:

**Essential**

* Third\-level qualification in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related discipline.
* Previous experience in a Business Analyst, Sales Operations Analyst, Reporting Analyst or similar analytical role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
* Experience producing management information, performance reporting and business insights.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience working with stakeholders across different business areas.

**Desirable**

* Experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce.
* Experience using business intelligence and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or similar).
* Experience supporting forecasting, planning or budgeting activities.
* Knowledge of data governance and data quality management practices.
* Experience working within financial services or a regulated industry.
* Relevant professional qualifications or industry certifications would be an advantage.

  

**Benefits** **What we offer**


At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast\-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.


**Health and Wellbeing**

Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports \& Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.


**Reward and Recognition**

We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.


**Growth and Development**

Our award\-winning L\&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.


**Positive Workplace**

Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.


**Values and Culture**

Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.


**Important Information**


Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.


Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland.


Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role.

**Position description**

Facilities Management (FM) manage and maintain in excess of 90 properties in the ESB Property portfolio, to over 9000 staff. The projects are typically construction projects on existing premises and vary from internal fitout with services upgrades to fabric (roof, windows, wall cladding, thermal) upgrades to whole building upgrades. jobs.description:

Drammensveien 167, 0277 Oslo


**Om jobben**
-------------


Lagre favoritt


Stillingstittel
Senior E\-commerce Rådgiver
Type ansettelse
Fast, heltid 100%
Antall stillinger
1
Arbeidsspråk
Norsk
Vis flere detaljer

  

Er du klar til å bli en sentral role hos Norges raskest voksende Shopify byrå?


Scandicommerce er et Shopify Plus Partner\-byrå i sterk vekst. Vi har allerede tredoblet resultatene fra i fjor, og ligger an til å femdoble dem. Vi jobber med noen av Norges mest spennende og ledende varemerker, og vi er blant de mest aktive aktørene i det norske ehandelsmiljøet, både på scenen, i partnernettverkene og i konkrete leveranser hos kundene.


Nå ser vi etter en Senior E\-commerce Rådgiver som kan Shopify inn og ut, og som vil være med på å forme løsningene til ambisiøse nettbutikker sammen med oss.


Du blir vår CTOs nærmeste sparringspartner. I dag eier han løsningsarkitekturen og prosjektansvaret på flere av våre største kundeleveranser, din jobb blir å ta over stadig mer av dette, slik at vi kan fortsette å vokse og levere kvaliteten våre kunder forventer!


**Hva du skal gjøre**
* Utforme løsninger sammen med vår CTO ut mot kunder \- fra behovsavklaring og løsningsarkitektur til leveranse
* Ta kunde og prosjektansvar: eie dialogen, fremdriften og resultatet
* Jobbe hands\-on med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom Shopify og ERP/OMS
* Koordinere utviklingsteamet og sikre at leveransene treffer på scope og kvalitet
* Jobbe tett med partnerne våre for å finne den beste løsningen for hver kunde \- ikke den enkleste for oss

**Hvem vi ser etter** **Må ha:**
* Solid Shopify\-erfaring \- du kjenner plattformen inn og ut
* Erfaring med integrasjoner og arbeidsflyter mellom netthandel og ERP\-systemer \- for eksempel Microsoft (Business Central), Visma, Unimicro, Finago eller Odoo
* Erfaring med KI\-verktøy og agenter i praktisk arbeid \- hos oss er KI en naturlig del av både leveransene og hverdagen, fra agentbaserte arbeidsflyter til agentic commerce
* Forstår API\-er \- du kan lese API\-dokumentasjon, forstå datamodeller og designe integrasjonsflyter mellom systemer
* Kommersiell teft og trygghet i kundedialog \- du forstår hva som skaper verdi
* Evne til å eie ting ende\-til\-ende og levere i tempoet til et selskap i vekst

**Stort pluss:**
* Erfaring med Omnium
* God forståelse for det norske ehandelsøkosystemet (Vipps, Bring, norske ERP\-landskap)
* Erfaring med Make.com eller tilsvarende automatisering
* En stemme i bransjen, du skriver, snakker eller blir oppsøkt for råd
* Forståelse av API og UCP
* Kan lede utviklere

**Hvorfor scandicommerce**
* Du kommer inn i et selskap i kraftig vekst med reelle muligheter til å påvirke retningen
* Fastprismodell som gir tydelighet på scope, ikke timeregistrering og fakturajag
* Varierte prosjekter for ledende varemerker, ingen to prosjekter er like
* Full\-stack leveranser: Shopify Plus, ERP, OMS, POS og integrasjoner

**Senior utvikler / løsningsarkitekt (AI) Skap verdi med AI**


Å velge Capgemini betyr å velge et selskap der du former din egen karriere, med støtte fra et sterkt fellesskap av kolleger – lokalt og globalt. Bli med og bidra til å skape verdi for noen av verdens ledende organisasjoner.

Capgemini Kristiansand er et ledende teknologi\- og rådgivningsmiljø på Sørlandet. Vi kombinerer tett lokal lagånd med kraften i Capgeminis globale nettverk på over 400 000 ansatte, og leverer til kunder blant annet innen telekom, industri, energi og offentlig sektor.


Hos oss står nytenkning i fokus – kunstig intelligens er et kjerneelement i løsningene vi bygger. AI og agentisk AI er i kjernen av Capgeminis strategi, med egne AI\-laber og forskningsmiljøer i ryggen.


Vi søker en erfaren utvikler eller løsningsarkitekt som kan ta ansvar for helheten – fra forretningsbehov til arkitektur og løsninger som står seg i produksjon.
  

Vi bygger i Java og C\#/.NET på Azure, AWS og GCP, og jobber med modeller og plattformer fra blant annet OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft og Google.

* Ha ansvar for løsningsarkitektur i prosjekter der AI er sentralt – fra teknologivalg til integrasjoner og automatisering.

Erfaring fra konsulentbransjen, telekom eller industri er et pluss.

* Reell påvirkning på hvordan store norske virksomheter tar AI i bruk.
* Et sterkt fagmiljø: rundt 90 kolleger på Sørlandet og Capgeminis globale AI\-satsing i ryggen.

jobs.description:
**About the role**
We are looking for an energetic Executive Assistant and Team Lead for Technology Support and Engagement with a positive “let’s get this done” mindset. A creative and problem\-solving personality is key to providing daily, proactive support on Executive and Management team level within the Fortum IT function – could this be you?  

Key responsibilities will include but not be limited to
* Manage and develop the technology leadership support and engagement team, leading executive assistants and engagement specialists in delivering effective leadership support, coordination and engagement activities.
* Ensuring accuracy and timely delivery of Digital and Technology related KPIs and performance reporting.
* Supporting in tasks related to the SVP, IT (CIO) agenda and daily work including coordination of appointments, events, documentation and actions as needed.
* Supporting the IT Leadership Team by driving IT’s agenda by managing the meeting schedule, taking minutes, managing action points, and co\-creating meeting agendas. Participating in Leadership team meetings as required, which would include some travel.
* Coordinate leadership communications, engagement activities, events and initiatives that strengthen collaboration, culture and employee experience across the Digital and Technology area.
* Independently manage assigned administrative responsibilities, ensuring proactive follow\-up, effective coordination and timely execution of agreed actions, outcomes and next steps.
* The position is located in Espoo, Finland.

  

**About you**
We will get you started and introduce you to our ways of working – however, we do appreciate:
* Previous experience supporting senior technology leaders, preferably in an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Team Lead or similar coordination role.
* A university\-level degree, such as BBA, HSO or similar, is an advantage.
* Fluent written and spoken English and Finnish; other languages are an asset.
* Strong digital skills and experience using modern productivity, collaboration and AI tools.
* Strong information\-seeking skills and confidence working in unfamiliar contexts and rapidly changing environments.
* A proactive and independent approach to assistance and support.
* Ability to work in a multitasking environment where situational awareness, urgency and prioritization are essential.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  

**We offer you**
At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally.  

More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.  

Espoo office is a smoke\-free workplace.  

**Interested?**
Submit your application in English at latest on the 25th of September. We start contacting suitable candidates already during the application period. If you have questions and would like to hear more about the position, please contact Katri Vuorinen, Executive Assistant to SVP IT, via email at katri.vuorinen@fortum.com.  

To be selected for the position, the applicant must go through background clearance and a health examination including drug testing.  

**We are Fortum**
Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best\-in\-class low\-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2\-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi\-validated emission reduction targets on our way towards net\-zero by 2040\. For our \~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. jobs.title: Account Management Senior Specialist for a Sustainability SaaS

We have united the world’s leading sustainability solutions to accelerate the transition to a zero\-carbon future. With One Click LCA and SimaPro now under one umbrella, we bring together the most trusted, science\-based tools and expertise in the industry. Our combined platforms power environmental transparency, decarbonisation, and circularity across different industries and product value chains.


By integrating deep methodological expertise with innovative, AI\-driven technology, we enable organisations to measure, understand, and reduce environmental impacts with accuracy and efficiency. Our solutions empower companies to make better decisions for the planet at scale.


Here you will join a supportive, effective, and mission\-oriented team in a flexible, friendly work environment. You will be working with cutting\-edge tools and a team of world\-class professionals around the globe to solve one of the world’s biggest challenges.

*This full\-time, permanent position is available on a remote basis for candidates based in the Nordics / EU.*

### **What you will do:**

* You will lead our efforts to retain and grow our existing customer base, focused on mid\-tier and large customers, playing a key role in driving our Gross and Net Revenue retention
* Build strong, trusted relationships with our customers as the basis for revenue expansion and retention
* Own and manage our renewals so that this compelling event is maximised as much as possible

* There are plenty of opportunities to drive improvements in the way we retain and grow our customer base. You will be expected to seize them and be a changemaker for the better

### **What you need:**

* You have proven experience in B2B SaaS, working in Customer Success or Account Management to drive NRR across a portfolio of customers
* Experience in identifying, nurturing and closing €15,000\+ revenue expansion opportunities
* Data\-driven. You use the data at your disposal to identify insights and come up with plans to act on them
* You are proactive and creative. Each customer is different, and you love figuring out how to engage them
* You are happy picking up the phone to customers as a way to drive retention or expansion

* You are fluent in English, our working language, and also in Finnish and/or Swedish, reflecting the region you will cover

### **What we offer:**

* Fulfilling, meaningful work at a successful, stable and fast\-growing business
* Substantial freedom, with no fixed hours and remote working
* Challenges, substantial responsibility and the chance to see the results of your work directly

* A dynamic, friendly, motivated and diverse team of top\-notch professionals
* Great colleagues, social events and ability to contribute to market transformation

We are eagerly waiting for your application until **27 September 2026**. Applications are reviewed upon receipt, so please apply promptly to be considered.

I Bygma tilbyder vi faglig dybde og geografisk bredde. Derfor har du store muligheder, når du vil lægge næste lag på din karriere. I salg eller i stab. På lager eller i ledelse. Sådan hjælper vi med at bygge Danmark.
  
  

**Fastansat/tidsbegrænset:** Fastansat
  
**Timer:** 37\.0
  
  

Erfaren Fullstack\-udvikler til Bygma Gruppen
  
  

Vil du udvikle digitale løsninger og samtidig tage ansvar for at drive udviklingsopgaver fremad sammen med teamet?
  
  

Vi søger en erfaren Fullstack\-udvikler til Bygma IT \& Digitalisering. Du bliver en del af vores interne udviklingsteam, hvor vi arbejder med alt fra websites, CMS og e\-commerce til webapplikationer, API'er og integrationer.
  
  

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack\-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning \- fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.
  
  

Jobbet
  
Du bliver en del af Bygma IT \& Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.
  
  

Du arbejder selv hands\-on med udviklingen og tager samtidig en drivende teknisk rolle i større opgaver. Sammen med interessenter og resten af teamet omsætter du behov fra forretningen til gode tekniske løsninger, får opgaverne brudt ned og bidrager til at skabe fremdrift hele vejen til implementering.
  
  

Vi arbejder tæt på forretningen og de løsninger, der er i brug hver dag. Derfor består jobbet både af nye udviklingsopgaver og den løbende videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger. Det betyder også, at du sammen med teamet tager fat på bugs, mindre forbedringer og konkrete forespørgsler fra forretningen, når de opstår.
  
  

**Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:**  

udvikle og videreudvikle fullstack webapplikationer og digitale løsninger
  
  

tage ansvar for løsningsbeskrivelse og teknisk afklaring
  
  

nedbryde større udviklingsopgaver og drive dem fremad sammen med teamet
  
  

videreudvikle vores CMS\- og e\-commerce\-platforme
  
  

udvikle både frontend og backend samt API'er og integrationer
  
  

håndtere bugs, forbedringer og løbende behov fra forretningen
  
  

sikre stabile, vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger, der er effektive at drifte
  
  

sparre om arkitektur, teknologi og best practices
  
  

Din profil
  
Du har flere års erfaring med fullstack webudvikling og gerne solid erfaring med CMS og e\-commerce.
  
  

Vi leder efter en reel fullstack\-profil, som er stærk i .NET/C\#, men som også har solid erfaring med frontend\-udvikling og selv arbejder med Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript og moderne webteknologier. Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af hele løsningen \- fra brugerfladen i frontend til API'er, integrationer og data bagved.
  
  

Du trives med hele spændet i udviklingsarbejdet. Den ene opgave kan være en større ny funktion, den næste en fejl i en eksisterende løsning eller en konkret forespørgsel fra en kollega i forretningen. For dig er det naturligt at tage ansvar for begge dele.
  
  

Du har også blik for løsningen, når den er sat i produktion. Drift er en naturlig del af vores udviklingsansvar, og du tænker derfor stabilitet, performance, vedligeholdelse og effektiv drift ind i de løsninger, du er med til at bygge.
  
  

**Vi arbejder bl.a. med:**  

.NET / C\#
  
  

CMS og e\-commerce – vi anvender pt. Optimizely / Episerver
  
  

Angular
  
  

JavaScript / TypeScript
  
  

SQL og databaser
  
  

Web API'er og integrationer
  
  

Vi tilbyder
  
Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af Bygmas digitale platforme og mulighed for at præge både løsninger og tekniske valg.
  
  

Hos os er IT tæt på forretningen. Vejen fra idé til implementering er kort, og det, du udvikler, bliver hurtigt brugt i praksis. Vi følger vores løsninger efter implementering og arbejder løbende med både drift, forbedringer og videreudvikling.
  
  

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for at få tingene i mål.
  
  

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
  
Så søg jobbet via linket på denne side. Fristen er 8\. oktober 2026\. Vi holder løbende samtaler og kan derfor vælge den rette kandidat inden ansøgningsfristens udløb. Så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
  
  

Bemærk, at vi kun modtager ansøgninger via vores rekrutteringssystem.
  
  

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov på \+45 27 78 08 18\.
  
  

Om Bygma Gruppen
  
Bygma Gruppen A/S er den største danskejede leverandør af byggematerialer til det professionelle byggeri, og vi giver vores kunder rådgivning, service og kvalitet på branchens højeste niveau.
  
  

I Bygma Gruppen er vi fagfolk, som handler med fagfolk. Vi ved, at godt grej er afgørende for håndværkeren. At entreprenøren har brug for et samarbejde uden knaster. At en byggeplads kræver stram styring og varer til tiden.
  
  

Fundamentet for vores succes er vores medarbejdere. Derfor ansætter vi kun de bedste. Til lager og til lastbil. Til salg og til stab. Hos os er det ansvar, udvikling og kompetencer, der driver forretningen fremad. Og vi står sammen om at levere de gode resultater.
  
  

Bygma Gruppen beskæftiger ca. 3\.000 medarbejdere fordelt på flere end 125 forretningsenheder i både Danmark, Sverige, Island, Færøerne, Polen og Grønland og omsætter årligt for over 10 milliarder kroner.

er en erfaren bruger af IT\-værktøjer og Microsoft 365
