jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world's largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.


The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.


We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society's evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.


**ExxonMobil in Singapore**
---------------------------


ExxonMobil is one of Singapore’s largest foreign manufacturing investors with over S$25 billion in fixed asset investments.

  

  

We have manufacturing facilities that include an integrated world\-scale refining and petrochemical complex in Jurong and Jurong Island, a network of service stations under the Esso brand, operate a lubricant plant and are a supplier of cylinder cooking gas. ExxonMobil provides customers and commercial markets in the region with ground transportation, industrial, aviation and marine fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals and liquefied natural gas (LNG).

  

As Singapore serves as the AP hub for some of our businesses, we employ about 3,500 people across positions in operations, projects, commercial, corporate support functions and others.

  

  

ExxonMobil also contributes to community programs in Singapore that support the arts, education, health and the environment.  



  

For more information, visit **www.exxonmobil.com.sg** or follow ExxonMobil Singapore on LinkedIn and Instagram.


**ExxonMobil Global Trading**
-----------------------------


ExxonMobil Global Trading is where we trade oil, natural gas, and energy products safely and responsibly around the world. We leverage our expertise in analytics, logistics, origination, and knowledge of energy markets to maximize the value of our global assets and deliver industry\-leading results.

  

  

This is an exciting time to join our growing trading team and be an integral part of ExxonMobil.


**What role you will play in the team**
---------------------------------------


If successful, you will join ExxonMobil's Global Trading organization as a member of the Front Office technology team supporting commodity trading, commercial optimization, and market analytics activities across global energy markets.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Full Stack Developer with strong software engineering, data engineering, and application development capabilities to design, build, and support modern applications that enable traders, analysts, risk managers, and commercial teams to make informed decisions in fast\-moving markets.

  

In this role, you will work closely with trading desks, quantitative analysts, commercial teams, and technology professionals to develop scalable applications, data platforms, analytics tools, and workflow solutions that enhance market transparency, streamline operations, and create commercial value. You will play a key role in building production\-grade systems used directly by front\-office teams across crude oil, natural gas, LNG, refined products, power, environmental products, and related commodity markets.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Develop, enhance, and maintain front\-office applications supporting commodity trading, market analytics, risk management, and commercial optimization activities.
* Design and build scalable full\-stack solutions leveraging modern front\-end, back\-end, and cloud technologies.
* Partner directly with traders, analysts, quants, and commercial stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate requirements into technology solutions.
* Build intuitive user interfaces, dashboards, and analytical workflows that improve decision\-making and operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and application integrations supporting market data, trading systems, and analytical platforms.
* Design, develop, and support data pipelines and data platforms that provide timely access to market, risk, operational, and fundamental data.
* Build tools that support pricing, market analysis, forecasting, position management, and trading workflows.
* Contribute to application architecture, technical design, and software engineering best practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve application performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, and platform teams to deploy and support production solutions.
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD processes, version control, and development standards across applications.
* Identify opportunities to modernize legacy processes and develop innovative solutions that improve front\-office productivity.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
**About you**
-------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing commercial or enterprise software applications using modern software engineering practices.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade applications and services.
* Experience developing front\-end applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks such as React.
* Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Experience building data pipelines, data workflows, and data\-driven applications.
* Familiarity with cloud technologies including Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and development teams.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to operate in a fast\-paced commercial environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high\-quality solutions.
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Understanding of commodity markets including crude oil, natural gas, LNG, refined products, power, environmental products, or related energy markets.
* Experience working directly with front\-office users such as traders, analysts, risk managers, or quantitative researchers.

* Understanding of software engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, version control (Git), and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of market data platforms, trading systems, and real\-time data integration processes.
* Experience developing applications that support trading, risk management, forecasting, optimization, or commercial decision\-making.
  
**Your benefits**

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last and we provide job rotations throughout your career with us. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and execution\-driven AVP/VP, Fund Structurer to join our front\-office fund management desk. This unique hybrid role sits at the intersection of investment product manufacturing, multi\-asset trade execution, and legal/regulatory engineering.


Operating as a licensed representative of our fund manager, you will be responsible for translating the complex governance and aspirations of clients into robust, high\-performing investment vehicles. You will lead the legal and regulatory setup of our innovative Variable Capital Company (VCC) sub\-funds, drive best\-execution trading across global markets, and manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the portfolios.


**Key Responsibilities**  

1\. Fund Structuring \& Legal/Regulatory Engineering
  

* Architect Bespoke VCC Structures: Partner with wealth, corporate and financial institutional teams to design and implement innovative investment structures leveraging the Variable Capital Company (VCC) platform.
* End\-to\-End Fund Lifecycle Management: Support the full operational and legal lifecycle of the VCC, including the launch and legal setup of new sub\-funds, NAV validation oversight, corporate action elections, dividend distribution processing, and winding\-up procedures.
* Legal and Regulatory Compliance: Liaise closely with internal legal, risk, and compliance teams, as well as external legal counsel, to draft fund documentation (such as offering memorandums and investment management agreements) and ensure strict compliance with MAS VCC guidelines (e.g., AML/CFT under VCC\-N01\).
* To recommend, supervise and manage external lawyers to ensure that high quality and focused advice is received at reasonable cost and in a timely manner to appropriately protect bank’s and fund shareholder’s interests.
* To prepare and update standard form documentation and fund documentation (including the private product memorandum, termsheet, subscription agreement and other ancillary agreements etc.) for use by the business together with related guidance notes and other advisory materials for new and existing funds.
* To ensure the relevant legal and regulatory requirements are well understood by the business and are reflected in the relevant documentation and internal procedures.
  

2\. Portfolio Construction \& Multi\-Asset Trade Execution
  

* Front\-Office Best Execution: Operate as a licensed representative to execute trades across global markets (including Fixed Income, Equities, and Derivatives) with high accuracy and efficiency, ensuring minimal slippage and optimal fund performance.
* Portfolio Rebalancing \& Monitoring: Assist in portfolio construction, investment strategy positioning, and systematic rebalancing in line with the fund’s defined mandate and risk appetite.
* Risk \& Control Oversight: Monitor portfolio risk limits, manage market exposure, and ensure that all trading activities align with global risk management, internal compliance policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) .
* Operational Excellence \& Automation: Work with fund administrators and custodians to ensure the accuracy of Net Asset Value (NAV) reporting and build automation/digital workflows to scale fund operations.

  

**Key Requirements**  

* Experience: Relevant legal experience in the banking, asset management, or financial services industry, with direct exposure to wealth management, private banking, or capital markets execution desks .
* Education \& Professional Licensing: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline. Must be eligible to be registered as a licensed representative under the MAS capital markets services regime.
* Technical Structuring \& Legal Knowledge: Strong understanding of fund structures (both restricted and retail funds), with specific, hands\-on experience or deep exposure to Singapore Variable Capital Company (VCC) frameworks and legal documentation.
* Product \& Execution Mastery: Practical product knowledge across Fixed Income, Equities, and Derivatives, with prior experience executing trades and navigating portfolio management systems.
* Analytical \& Programming Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Strong aptitude for quantitative analysis, spreadsheet modeling, and problem\-solving; experience with programming/automation tools (e.g., Python, VBA, or SQL) is highly advantageous.
* Soft Skills \& Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, coordination, and presentation skills. Must have the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders (Risk, Legal, Finance) and articulate technical structuring and market details clearly to family office clients and business partners .
* Mindset: Self\-motivated starter who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, leading operational change, and managing tight deadlines in a fast\-paced front\-office environment.

* Shape and execute V\&A strategy: Drive Therapeutic Area access strategies across the region, align international direction with country needs, and guide markets through access challenges and opportunities.

* A strong record of developing and executing access strategies, leading cross\-functional teams, and influencing effectively in a complex matrix environment.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Process Owner- 8 months contractor role
jobs.description:
**Who we’re looking for**

We are seeking an individual to provide a comprehensive candidate concierge service that supports the Talent Acquisition Specialists and Partners throughout the end\-to\-end recruitment process, while additionally managing other operational aspects of the talent acquisition function. The ideal candidate will be passionate about enhancing the candidate, hiring manager and internal TA team member experience and will thrive in a collaborative team setting within a fast\-paced environment. This role is dynamic and varied, requiring adaptability and enthusiasm.
  

  

**About Schroders**

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.


Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.


**What you’ll do**  

  



* **Talent Acquisition Process Ownership:** Work closely with Talent Acquisition Specialists \& Partners to ensure all job details in our recruitment systems are accurate and all necessary approvals are in place.
* **Role Advertising and Candidate Management:** Release roles to relevant channels, manage candidate applications and queries, and update recruitment systems with candidate feedback. When required, this will include supporting Talent Acquisition Specialists \& Partners with operational aspects of managing requisition (i.e. screening candidates, advancing through ATS, chasing Hiring Managers for feedback etc)
* **Interview Management:** Schedule interviews, manage room bookings, and ensure all necessary candidate and interview documentation is prepared and accessible for hiring managers.
* **Offer Management:** Assist with the completion and audit of offer letters and necessary approvals, supporting the Early Careers team where required.
* **Supplier Management:** Assist with the maintenance of the recruitment PSL and other recruitment partners on a global level, including management of agency payroll temp renewals, the on and offboarding of suppliers, and raising, tracking and maintenance of Purchase Orders.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate records on recruitment systems including the ATS, including managing agency details and supporting regular system and supplier audits in partnership with your manager.
* **Data insights:** Generate hiring reports and data insights required by line manager and business stakeholders \- ensuring it provides valuable and strategic information for TA planning and decision making.
* **Cost management:** Support regional teams in providing timely reports on TA costs and spend when required.
* **Recruitment systems:** Serve as an SME for current and new recruitment technology, supporting training, rollout and maintenance of an up\-to\-date library of training materials.
* **Communication and Liaison:** Act as a key contact for hiring teams, onboarding team and wider P\&C to ensure a seamless candidate, hiring manager and TA team experience.
* **Oversee Inboxes:** Manage candidate enquiries and oversee the Schroders Careers inbox to ensure timely and effective communication.
* **Process Improvement Initiatives:** Identify improvements in recruitment administration processes and contribute to ad hoc projects as necessary.

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need**

* Minimum three years of experience within HR/ Recruitment industry.
* Fluency in Mandarin is required, with the ability to communicate confidently with candidates and stakeholders across the region (Hong Kong, Taiwan and China)
* Excellent administration skills with previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition being essential.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment processes and best practices.
* Proficient in using recruitment systems and tools, such as Taleo, Oracle Recruitment Cloud or similar ATS.
* Good understand of MS Office tools, specifically Excel, Word and Powerpoint with the ability to pick up new systems as required.
* Exceptional levels of attention to detail, demonstrating accuracy and a strong appetite to learn.
* High levels of personal integrity with experience of managing highly sensitive and confidential people data.
* Excellent organisation and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, fostering relationships with stakeholders.
* Ability to pick up ad hoc talent acquisition project work when required.
* Experience in generating reports from HR systems (Oracle HCM or similar) would be advantageous.

**The knowledge, experience and qualifications that will help**

* Experience supporting recruitment within a financial services environment is a plus.
* Previous experience as a junior recruiter, or broader recruitment experience, would be advantageous, along with a passion for delivering exceptional hiring experiences.
* Proactive and self\-motivated, with the ability to drive process improvements and self learn in a fast\-paced environment.
* A team player with a pro\-active approach to getting things done, you’ll love to learn new skills and are keen to work in an exciting, fast paced environment.

**We recognise potential, whoever you are**  

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio\-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.


We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

jobs.description:

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. The role ensures that customer insights and lifecycle triggers are translated into actionable engagement opportunities and targeted customer campaigns, leads the strategy and execution of lifecycle initiatives that increase customer engagement, cross\-sell, retention, and repurchase across the existing customer portfolio.

**In this role you will:**

* **Lifecycle Execution:**Operationalize lifecycle programs that drive customer engagement and portfolio growth across the policy lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, cross\-sell, retention, and reactivation initiatives
* **CRM Activation:**Lead lifecycle enablement within the customer engagement ecosystem, embedding lifecycle triggers, customer opportunity insights, and advisor engagement tools that supports identifying cross\-sell, coverage gap, and repurchase opportunities
* **Customer Segmentation \& Insights:**Develop and operationalize advanced customer segmentation frameworks that enable targeted lifecycle campaigns and personalized customer engagement across marketing and distribution channels
* **Lifecycle Campaign Engine:**Design and deliver lifecycle campaigns and event\-triggered journeys that increase customer engagement and product penetration within the existing customer base
* **Cross\-Functional:**Lead cross\-functional initiatives involving marketing, distribution, customer experience, analytics, to execute lifecycle programs
* **Distribution \& Advisor Enablement:**Partner with distribution teams to activate lifecycle insights through advisor engagement, ensuring distribution teams are equipped with prioritized customer opportunities
* **Group Collaboration:**Work with regional and Group teams to align lifecycle initiatives with CRM platforms, marketing technologies, and data capabilities

**To be successful you will need:**

* Proven experience in financial services with interpersonal and project management skills, able to manage multiple stakeholders, prioritize and deliver on multiple projects
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions and geographies
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
* Strong communication skills \& attention to detail.
* Self\-motivated, pro\-active and able to work under stringent timelines

### **Description \& Requirements**

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

* Contribute your talents to high\-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson and Revel
* Unite your passion for audio innovation with high\-tech product development
* Create pitch\-perfect, cutting\-edge technology that elevates the listening experience.

**About the Role**


In this role, you will be a core member of a small but effective integrated regional team that will help HARMAN build and grow APAC’s digital ecosystem.


You will be in charge of collecting, analysing, and interpreting complex data sets to provide insights that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for data mining, analysis and data visualisation. You will also be able to work independently and as part of a team to deliver high\-quality results with the goal of bringing best in class experiences to life for our consumer. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for digital business growth.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Digital \& E\-Commerce, and this is an independent contributor role managing JBL and Harman Kardon across APAC. You will also be working collaboratively with our distribution partners, digital, ecommerce leads and regional business development managers to drive strategic thinking and KPI measurements.

**What You Will Do**


Data Collation and Analysis:

* Design and implement data collection methodologies and process to collate relevant data from multiple sources and ensure sanity check.
* Conduct detailed data analysis using data techniques, mining and visualisation to extract insights and identify trends.


Reporting and Visualisation:

* Create dashboards, reports and visualisations that effectively communicate data\-driven insights to various stakeholders.
* Present findings and recommendations to internal teams, stakeholders and senior management in an accurate and concise manner.
* Continuously refine reporting processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and effectiveness of data.


Business Insights and Strategy:

* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their analytical needs.
* Analyse data, work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Develop data visualisation to communicate findings.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analytics.
* Collaborate with the wider product and marketing team to plan and create digital driven marketing plans (includes paid media), content, creatives, KPIs \& reporting.
* Work in hand with the global insights team to manage and deliver an annual brand health insights report across key APAC countries.
* This role will also require you to manage agency relationships, to ensure data and reports are delivered on time.

**What You Need to Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s Degree in eCommerce/Digital analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field.
* 2 or more years working experience in data analytics.
* Strong understanding of data mining, analysis and data visualisation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to convey complex info to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiar with eCommerce operating platforms, web analytics, UX\-UI tools (Google Analytics, Mouseflow or similar), Proficient in Excel, Power BI or similar tools.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Prior experience in Consumer Electronics or FMCG industry with APAC experience.
* Ability to juggle between the details and big picture, manage multiple and competing projects and priorities.
* Passion for and genuine curiosity for innovation in the Digital / e\-Commerce space and a passion for data analysis.
* Data/Insight\-driven, strong sense of accountability and solution\-oriented are key. Ability to draw insights from multiple data sources and formulate recommendations for improvements.
* Adaptable to ambiguity, changes and be at the forefront to lead change in both actions and behaviour.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a culturally\-diverse team environment, and understanding what it means to achieve success with others and through others.
* Excellent communicator and able to perform well in a matrixed organization.
* Proven experience in managing and influencing a network of local senior managers and managers in a cross functional team.

**What Makes You Eligible**

* Full working rights in Singapore.

**What We Offer**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

jobs.title: Sportsbook Operations Associate - 3 month Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
**About Kambi**


*Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end\-to\-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front\-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in\-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners.*


*Our vision is to create the world's leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners.*

**Sportsbook Operations Associate**



Type of Contract: Fixed\-term, 3 months initially.



Work Model: Office\-based, Bucharest.



Shifts: Varied, including evenings and weekends.


**The Role**



Love sport? Ever wondered what actually happens inside a sportsbook while a match is live? Here's an opportunity to find out from the inside.



We're looking for people to join Kambi's Trading team in Bucharest for a focused 3 month contract with the possibility for extension, working directly with live sporting events, markets and sportsbook operations.



You'll work alongside experienced colleagues and learn how decisions are made while matches are live and markets are moving.



You don't need previous sportsbook experience. If you know your sport, learn quickly, pay attention to detail and enjoy environments where things move fast, we can teach you the rest.



As a Sportsbook Operations Associate, your day\-to\-day work will look like:


* Monitor live sporting events and make sure markets are operating accurately.
* Support live trading activity, including real\-time odds adjustments within established processes.
* Spot issues quickly and help get them to the right people before they become bigger problems.
* Monitor third\-party sports data and identify anything that could affect an event or market.
* Work directly with traders, managers and operational teams during live events.
* Build knowledge across different sports and competitions as coverage needs change.


Some shifts will include evenings and weekends. Live sport doesn't only happen Monday to Friday, 9 to 5, and neither does this role.


**You'll be a great fit for the role if you:**


* Have a genuine interest in sport and understand how live sporting events work.
* Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Notice details other people sometimes miss.
* Can stay calm and focused when several things are happening at once.
* Are comfortable learning new systems and working across multiple tools.
* Can work varied shifts, including evenings and weekends.


Previous sportsbook experience is not required. Experience in operations or an international environment is useful, but it isn't essential.


**Why Join Us?**



Because in a short period of time, you can gain experience that is difficult to get from outside the industry.


* Real sportsbook experience: you'll work on live events, not simulations or training exercises for months before getting involved.
* Exposure to Trading: you'll see first\-hand how odds, sports data, market movements and operational decisions come together during live events.
* A steep learning curve: over a few months, you'll build practical knowledge across sports, systems and real\-time operations.
* Experience you can take with you: whether you're looking to enter sports betting, move towards trading or simply try something completely different, you'll leave the contract with genuine hands\-on experience in a global sportsbook environment.


And because the contract is initially for 3 months, you don't need to know today whether this is what you want to do for the next five years. Come in, learn the industry, contribute from early on and see where it takes you.



Local Benefits:


* 180 RON net monthly wellbeing allowance.
* 40 RON meal vouchers per working day.
* 35% enhanced night\-shift supplement for hours worked after 21:00\.
* Premium private medical insurance.
* Life insurance.
* Paid annual leave, pro\-rata for the contract period.


**Who We Are**



Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our technology powers sportsbooks around the world, covering everything from odds and risk management to trading, data and the user experience.



You'll be joining the team behind that operation.



Everyone belongs at Kambi



Kambi is committed to an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is.



So please come as you are – we can't wait to meet you!



Curious about how a sportsbook really works? Come and experience it from the inside.



Come and join us!



\#wearekambi

***Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace***


*If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback.*


***Creating an inclusive environment***


*We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today.*


*\#wearekambi*

jobs.description:
Job Information


Level of experience


Expert

Full\-time

Romania

What is the impact you want to make?


Unleash your biggest strengths, apply skills \& knowledge, learn new things, connect with your peers and build your career with us!


Why rinf.tech?


\#EngineerOfTheFuture, \#PeopleofManyTalents

* At rinf.tech, you’ll encounter friendly people who are eager to explore and reinvent the world of technology.
* We encourage ideas \- we like to share and learn from each other. We’re all in for curious \& ambitious people.

\#GrowOpportunities

* We continuously invest in developing core teams focused on technologies like Blockchain, AI, and IoT \- www.rinf.tech/careers/core\-blockchain\-and\-ai\-teams/
* Our Technical Management team, possesses a robust technical background. Many of our team members have advanced to strategic roles through internal promotions.
* In a state of mutual willingness to share \& grow, our RINFers commit to a minimum tenure of 2\.5 years on a project.

\#EngineeringExcellence

* Fail fast, learn fast: we experiment, we iterate, we know when to stop and we don't repeat the same mistakes.
* The right technology stack for the right problem: we don't force technology choices just because we know them; our focus is on solving problems, not on pushing predefined stacks.

\#Innovation

* Adapta Robotics is a successful spin\-off born through an R\&D project within rinf.tech www.adaptarobotics.com/

Why do we do what we do?


We inspire one another to share our tech\-works in this amazing and abundant world. So we became developers, innovators, thinkers, software builders, and hardware makers!


Our Vision!


Founded in 2006 with 650\+ engineers \& global presence (8 delivery centers in Europe \& North America) we strive to become a leading East\-European technology partner for growing organizations in need of digital transformation of their products and services!


What you’ll do

* Current\-State Architecture \& Discovery
* Lead discovery across SAP and non\-SAP source systems, archival interfaces, processing/abstraction layers, repositories, physical storage and retrieval paths.
* Treat existing diagrams as a starting hypothesis; validate the as\-built landscape through SMEs, vendors, configurations and operational evidence.
* Maintain a clear view of confirmed facts, assumptions, unknowns, legacy dependencies and transition components.
* Data, Repository \& Dependency Mapping
* Define where document binaries, metadata, indexes and business references reside and how they are linked across platforms.
* Map major archive populations by repository, technology, age/date range, country/business area, usage status, retention constraints and retrieval dependency.
* Identify critical dependencies between SAP/non\-SAP producers, ArchiveLink or custom integrations, middleware, FileNet/PBS/Centera/Dell EMC and future GCP WORM storage.
* Ownership \& Multi\-Vendor Governance
* Create the technical ownership/RACI model covering business owner, data owner, application owner, operations, infrastructure, storage, legal/compliance and vendor responsibilities.
* Expose ownership gaps, duplicated responsibilities, vendor lock\-in and key\-person dependencies across internal teams and external providers.
* Act as the end\-to\-end technical coordination point where no single vendor owns the whole archival service.
* Risk, Stabilization \& Architecture Decisions
* Identify architectural risks: unsupported technology, undocumented integrations, hidden point\-to\-point links, repository duplication, weak monitoring, unclear recovery and fragile metadata/reference chains.
* Prioritize stabilization needs by business impact, compliance impact, likelihood and remediation complexity.
* Drive architecture decision records and ensure technical recommendations are evidence\-based and feasible.
* Target \& Transitional Architecture
* Define the target archival service across SAP/non\-SAP ingestion, archival interfaces, metadata/reference management, immutable storage, retrieval, monitoring, security and resilience.
* Design a realistic transition architecture for coexistence between legacy repositories and GCP WORM, including read\-only legacy scenarios and staged migration.
* Avoid a storage\-only transformation; ensure the target covers the complete archive lifecycle and preserves retrievability and auditability.
* onsolidation, Migration \& Business Case
* Determine which components/data populations should be retained, migrated, consolidated, modernized, made read\-only or decommissioned.
* Define migration principles and sequencing based on legal retention, dependency, risk, volume, cost and business criticality.
* Provide architecture input to the business case covering cloud/storage, licensing, vendor support, dual\-running, migration effort and decommissioning opportunity.

What you need to be successful

* Senior Enterprise Architect with strong experience in complex legacy integration, data/ECM landscapes, cloud modernization and multi\-vendor transformation.
* Strong understanding of SAP integration and enterprise archival/content\-management concepts; experience with ArchiveLink, FileNet, PBS/Centera, Dell EMC or GCP is highly desirable.
* Able to work with incomplete/contradictory information, challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical findings into governance, roadmap and investment decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management across application, infrastructure, storage, legal/compliance, country teams and external providers.

What we offer you to be successful

* Flexible working environment, ability to work remotely or in a hybrid model, depending on your project requirements.
* Work with worldwide technology leaders \- We partner and deliver technology to industry giants like Intel, NXP, Panasonic, Visteon, Carrefour, Windriver, Kardex, METRO Digital, and many others.
* Priority Plus Medical Subscription @Regina Maria (fully covered by the company)
* Mental Health Online Resources through the Hilio Wellbeing Platform
* Flexible benefits worth 1300 RON gross per month \- you can choose the ones that suit your preference
* We have profit shares schemed that enable you to financially benefit from the new business you identify
* We have premium referral bonus for each successful recommendation you make \- (500\-1500 EUR NET based on seniority)
* Enjoy our vibrant offices in Romania's top IT hubs – Bucharest, Timisoara, Cluj, and Iasi, perfect for when you want to grab a coffee with your colleagues.
* Community – No man is an island, we stay connected through ongoing learning, project rotation, idea incubation, as well as through our Football Team, Townhalls, and Fun Thursday Office Day!

Next Steps for you!

* Apply
* CV screening
* HR Interview
* Technical Interview
* Offer presented by our CEO

Meet us!


Let's meet! We invite you to drop by anytime for a tour of our office, without any commitment.

##### **Join the** **\#PeopleofManyTalents****\#EngineerOfTheFuture**

jobs.title: UI-Ux Tasarım Uzmanı
jobs.description:
UI/UX Tasarımcısı (Sole Designer / Tek Tasarımcı)İş İlanı Detayları

* **Pozisyon:** UI/UX Tasarımcısı
* **Çalışma Şekli:** Tam Zamanlı / Hibrit veya Uzaktan (İhtiyaca göre güncellenebilir)
* **Departman:** Ürün, Tasarım ve Pazarlama

Şirket Hakkında

Yenilikçi dijital ürünler geliştiren ve kullanıcı deneyimini her şeyin merkezine koyan ekibimiz için, tasarıma yön verecek tutkulu bir **UI/UX Tasarımcısı** arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda, şirketimiz bünyesindeki tüm dijital ürünlerin görsel ve deneyimsel dünyasını tek sorumlu olarak sırtlayacak; ürün tasarımından dijital mecralardaki marka iletişimine kadar geniş bir yelpazede vizyonumuzu hayata geçireceksiniz.

Rolün Sorumlulukları

* **Uçtan Uca Tasarım Süreci:** Web ve mobil platformlardaki ürünlerimizin kullanıcı araştırmasından, wireframe, kullanıcı akışları ve yüksek sadakatli (high\-fidelity) arayüz tasarımlarına kadar tüm süreçlerini yönetmek.
* **Tasarım Sistemleri (Design Systems):** Şirketin tüm projelerinde tutarlılığı sağlamak amacıyla ölçeklenebilir tasarım sistemleri kurmak, geliştirmek ve yönetmek.
* **Kullanıcı Odaklı Yaklaşım:** Kullanıcı geri bildirimlerini, test sonuçlarını ve veri analitiğini analiz ederek arayüz ve deneyim iyileştirmeleri yapmak.
* **Yazılım Ekibiyle İş Birliği:** Tasarımların geliştirme (frontend) aşamasında yazılım ekibiyle yakın çalışmak, piksel mükemmeliyetinde (pixel\-perfect) çıktılar elde edilmesini sağlamak ve süreçteki tutarsızlıkları gidermek.
* **Sosyal Medya ve Dijital İçerik Üretimi:** Markamızın sosyal medya platformlarındaki (Instagram, LinkedIn, X vb.) varlığını güçlendirmek; ürün duyuruları, sektörel paylaşımlar, kampanya görselleri ve interaktif içerikler için gerekli tüm görsel/kreatif materyalleri tasarlamak ve içerik süreçlerine tasarım perspektifinden katkı sağlamak.
* **Görsel Kimlik ve Pazarlama Varlıkları:** Ürün içi arayüzlerin yanı sıra kurumsal kimlik, açılış sayfaları (landing page) ve dijital/basılı pazarlama materyallerinin görsel tasarımını üstlenmek.

Aranan Nitelikler ve Yetkinlikler

* **Deneyim:** UI/UX alanında en az 2\-3 yıl benzer deneyime sahip olmak ve daha önce hayata geçirilmiş ürün/portfolyo sunabilmek.
* **Araç Yetkinliği:** Endüstri standardı olan **Figma** programını en üst düzeyde kullanabilmek; component, auto\-layout, variant ve design token yapılarına tam hakim olmak.
* **Teknik Anlayış:** Temel düzeyde HTML/CSS/JS mantığını bilmek, tasarımın yazılıma dökülebilirliğini öngörmek ve geliştirici ekiple aynı dili konuşabilmek.
* **UX Yetkinlikleri:** Kullanıcı persona çalışmaları, bilgi mimarisi (information architecture), kullanılabilirlik testleri ve tel kafes (wireframing) konularında tecrübeli olmak.
* **Görsel İletişim ve Sosyal Medya Yetkinliği:** Sosyal medya dinamiklerine hakim, dijital pazarlama trendlerini takip eden ve markanın görsel dilini sosyal mecralarda istikrarlı şekilde uygulayabilecek tasarım becerisine sahip olmak.
* **Tek Başına Sorumluluk Alabilme (Sole Designer):** Şirketteki tek tasarımcı olarak çalışacak; inisiyatif alabilen, ürün tasarımı ile sosyal medya/pazarlama görsel ihtiyaçlarını aynı anda koordine edebilen, kendi iş planını oluşturabilen ve sorumluluk bilinci yüksek.
* **İletişim ve Sunum:** Fikirlerini ve tasarım kararlarını net bir şekilde ifade edebilen, ürün ve iş hedefleriyle tasarımı harmanlayabilen.

Biz Neler Sunuyoruz?

* Tüm tasarım ve görsel iletişim süreçlerinde tam yetki ve kendi alanınızda yaratıcı özgürlük.
* Yenilikçi projelerde doğrudan etki sahibi olma ve ürün ile marka geleceğini şekillendirme fırsatı.
* Dinamik, hızla büyüyen ve fikirlerinize değer veren bir ekip ortamı.
* Rekabetçi maaş paketi ve yan haklar.

Başvuru Süreci

Başvuru yaparken lütfen güncel **CV**'nizi ve yetkinliklerinizi, arayüz çalışmalarınızı ve dijital içerik tasarımlarınızı gösteren **Portfolyo** linkinizi (Figma, Behance, Dribbble vb.) bizimle paylaşın. Portfolyosuz başvurular değerlendirmeye alınmayacaktır.

Maaş: 30\.000,00TRY \- 40\.000,00TRY aylık

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ankara

jobs.title: Data & AI Consulting Manager / Senior Manager in Consumer & Retail
jobs.description:
You understand the Consumer \& Retail industry: its commercial dynamics, margin pressures, operational challenges, and complex decision\-making processes.


You've seen data and AI initiatives fail to deliver, whether through strategies that never reached implementation, models that were never adopted, or dashboards that answered the wrong questions. You want to bridge the gap between business needs and practical solutions, working closely with technical teams to ensure ideas become outcomes.


As a **Data \& AI Consultant** within our Consumer \& Retail practice, you will work with clients from initial discovery through to implementation. You'll help shape proposals, build business cases, lead workstreams, and act as the link between senior client stakeholders and EPAM's engineering and data science teams.


Your focus will be on advanced analytics and AI use cases, including forecasting, pricing and elasticity modeling, attribution, and scenario simulations. While you won't develop the models yourself, you'll be responsible for ensuring the right solutions are designed, aligned to business objectives, and capable of delivering measurable value.

**The remote option applies only to the Candidates who will be working from any location in Greece.**

**Responsibilities**

* Shape pursuits and proposals: contribute to presales from the start — defining the problem, scoping the approach, and building EPAM’s value narrative for Consumer \& Retail clients
* Lead client discovery: facilitate workshops with commercial, category and supply chain leadership, frame the real problem — not just the stated one — and define what a good outcome looks like
* Build the business case: identify, prioritize and size data and AI use cases; translate them into business cases with KPIs, investment rationale and delivery roadmaps that get sign\-off
* Own the workstream end\-to\-end: requirements, backlog, data readiness, governance and value tracking through to adoption
* Brief the builders: work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and Solution Architects to design scalable solutions — you define the what and why, they build the how
* Tell the story: produce clear, executive\-level materials and present recommendations to leadership throughout the engagement
* Pricing \& promotions: elasticity modeling, promotional effectiveness, trade spend optimization, net revenue management
* Merchandising \& category: assortment optimization, product performance, markdown and clearance
* Customer \& growth: segmentation, CLV, churn/retention, personalization, next\-best\-action
* Demand \& supply chain: demand forecasting and sensing, replenishment, availability and fulfillment analytics
* GenAI\-enabled use cases: commercial copilots for category managers and account managers, knowledge and insight agents, automation of analysis and reporting

**Requirements**

* Deep Consumer \& Retail expertise — whether built in\-industry or through sustained consulting work with retailers, CPG/FMCG, eCommerce or wholesale clients — with concrete examples of measurable business impact
* Consulting experience: structured problem\-solving, stakeholder management, workshop facilitation and executive\-level communication
* Data and AI literate: able to define data requirements and KPIs, hold a substantive conversation with a data scientist or architect, and translate between business and technical audiences
* End\-to\-end agile delivery experience: from problem framing and business case through to delivery and adoption into a recurring planning or commercial process, with a clear view of what worked and what didn’t
* Fluent in CPG data landscape: syndicated and panel data (NIQ/Nielsen, Circana, Kantar), retailer POS and portal feeds, distributor sell\-out, and the practical experience working with them
* Comfortable with ambiguity, takes ownership and drives to outcomes without waiting to be told what the answer is

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with major data cloud platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) and hyperscalers (Azure, GCP or AWS) and how data and AI solutions are architected and deployed on them
* Experience with advanced analytics or GenAI patterns (forecasting, recommendation engines, optimization, LLMs, RAG) in a Consumer \& Retail context
* Hands\-on exposure to the modeling families behind this work — hierarchical and time\-series forecasting, econometric and elasticity models, optimization, causal inference and incrementality testing
* Knowledge of enterprise platforms common in Consumer \& Retail environments, such as SAP, Salesforce or major ERP and CRM systems
* Change management and adoption skills: ensuring that solutions land and are actually used, not just delivered
* Experience in data governance, data quality frameworks or target operating model design is a plus
* Multi\-market experience — working across a regional or global CPG operating model, with the data and process differences that come with it

**We offer**

* For your comfortable work:
	+ Remote and hybrid work opportunities
	+ Option to work from our centrally located office in Athens
	+ Corporate laptop provided
	+ Private health insurance
	+ Meal vouchers / restaurant tickets
	+ My Benefit card (264€/year)
	+ Monthly public transportation card
* For your growth:
	+ Global and diverse client portfolio, large\-scale projects, and trendy technologies
	+ Diverse multicultural, multi\-functional, and multilingual work environment
	+ Opportunity to contribute to internal and open\-source products
	+ Outstanding career development opportunities with a transparent career path and a roadmap to accelerate your journey
	+ Possibility to create a Personal Development Plan from the first day in the company
	+ Numerous opportunities for self\-development: hard \& soft skills internal training courses, mentoring programs, and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning courses, external e\-Libraries
	+ Certification opportunities
	+ Knowledge\-sharing with colleagues from EPAM's global tech and non\-technical communities
	+ Language courses


EPAM strives to provide its global team of over 61,700 professionals in more than 55 countries with opportunities for professional growth from day one of collaboration. Our colleagues are the source of EPAM's success, so we value cooperation, strive to always understand our clients' business and aim for the highest quality standards. No matter where you are, you will join a dedicated, diverse community that will help you realize your potential to the fullest.

jobs.title: Medewerker onthaal
jobs.description:
**Bedrijf**  

AZ Sint\-Lucas is **een warm ziekenhuis** in hartje Gent waar deskundige artsen en medewerkers je met open armen ontvangen. **Ons open karakter, moderne infrastructuur en collegiale werkomgeving zorgen ervoor dat het hier aangenaam werken is. We ondersteunen jou graag in jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling én bieden als opleidend ziekenhuis tal van stageplekken. We zijn bovendien ook een duurzame onderneming,** we behaalden het VOKA Charter Duurzaam Ondernemen.


AZ Sint – Lucas is deel van het stadsleven. En het stadsleven is deel van AZ Sint – Lucas. Je voelt de urban vibe, de diversiteit van de mensen, het ritme van de stad. We staan voor**top****zorg, midden in ’t leven.**


Het ziekenhuis telt 779 bedden voor klassieke hospitalisatie en 153 posities voor dagopnames. Er werken 230 artsen en 2\.250 andere medewerkers. Het biedt zowel gespecialiseerde als hooggespecialiseerde zorg aan. Het ziekenhuis maakt deel uit van het ziekenhuisnetwerk Gent (ZNG) samen met AZ Jan Palfijn, UZ Gent en AZ Oudenaarde.


Hecht jij net als ons groot belang aan waarden zoals **mensgericht, open, professioneel, collegiaal en integer?** Dan verwelkomen wij jou graag in ons ziekenhuis als nieuwe collega.

  

**Functiebeschrijving**  

Het **team onthaalmedewerkers** zorgt dagelijks voor de **‘warme welkom’** die iedere patiënt of bezoeker verdient in ons ziekenhuis.


Correct doorschakelen aan de telefoon, duidelijk de weg wijzen aan de onthaalbalie, vragen en problemen beantwoorden en oplossen... **Als onthaalmedewerker zorg je er mee voor dat de patiënt of bezoeker zich vlot kan voort bewegen binnen onze organisatie.**


Daarnaast verzorgt dit team ook heel wat **administratieve taken**. Het totaalplaatje is dus een **gevarieerde job** waarbij multitasken een must is maar ook een uitdaging!


Iedereen vindt klantvriendelijkheid aan een onthaal belangrijk, wij ook, maar wij willen toch nog nét iets meer. **Glimlachen is goed maar een ander doen glimlachen is nog beter!**


**Wat zijn jouw taken?**


* Je staat in voor het vriendelijk onthaal aan de balie: je beluistert vragen en problemen van patiënten en bezoekers, je informeert hen, verwijst hen door en maakt hen wegwijs door het ziekenhuis
* Je lost praktische problemen op zoals tekort aan rolstoelen, doorgeven van defecten, verloren voorwerpen
* Je valideert de parkeertickets, geeft tijdelijke badges aan bezoekers, registreert uitgeleende sleutels, ...
* Je beantwoordt interne en externe telefoonoproepen
* Je staat in voor een aantal administratieve taken zoals ziekenvervoer aanvragen, kassaverslagen opmaken, printen van etiketten en labels, ...


  

**Profiel**  

* Je behaalde een diploma secundair onderwijs bij voorkeur aangevuld met een zevende jaar onthaal en PR of medico – sociale administratie
* Je kan zeer vlot overweg met de courante Officetoepassingen
* Je bent communicatief, klantgericht en empathisch
* Vriendelijkheid naar patiënten, bezoekers en personeel is voor jou een must!
* Je ben assertief genoeg om personen die de Nederlandse taal niet machtig zijn hun vraag te analyseren en hen verder op weg te helpen
* Je werkt zorgvuldig en bent in staat om snel problemen op te lossen
* Je werkt graag in een team, maar je kan ook zelfstandig functioneren


  

**Wij bieden**  

* Een contract van bepaalde duur t.e.m. 31/12/2026 met een jobtime van 90% \- 100% (bespreekbaar).
* Je werkt volgens een variabel uurrooster met shiften tussen 6u30 – 21u00 en je werkt 1 weekend op 3\.
* Startdatum zo snel mogelijk
* Inscholingstraject met meter\- of peterschap en steeds mogelijkheden om je zowel intern als extern verder bij te scholen
* Verloning volgens IFIC\-barema’s, waarbij we altijd rekening houden met jouw relevante anciënniteit
* Een hospitalisatieverzekering (en mogelijkheid om gezinsleden aan te sluiten aan gunstig tarief)
* Korting op hospitalisatie bij opname in het ziekenhuis voor medewerkers en voor inwonende gezinsleden
* Maaltijdcheques na 1 jaar
* Mogelijkheid tot fietsleasing
* Eindejaarspremie, flexibiliteitspremie
* Woon\-werkvergoeding: maximale fietsvergoeding, gratis openbaar vervoer, vergoeding auto/moto/bromfiets
* Kinderdagverblijf Beregoed gelegen op campus Sint – Lucas
* Gratis parkeergelegenheid
* Maaltijden aan gunstige prijzen
* Korting in diverse handelszaken, pretparken, wellness, …
* Organisatie van heel wat leuke evenementen zoals sportactiviteiten, Nieuwjaarsfeest, …


Verneem je graag nog meer over onze aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen? Neem dan gerust een kijkje op: https://www.azstlucas.be/waarom\-kiezen\-voor\-az\-sint\-lucas

  

**Contact**  

Voor bijkomende informatie kan je terecht bij Sarah Plu, medewerker werving \& selectie, op het nummer 09 224 68 17\.

  

  

AZ Sint\-Lucas \& Volkskliniek  

Dienst personeel \& organisatie  

Groenebriel 1  

9000 Gent  

  

**INTERESSE?**  

  

Stuur dan **uiterlijk op 20/09/2025** jouw motivatiebrief met cv elektronisch door via onze jobsite.

jobs.title: DevOps/SecOps Medewerker
jobs.description:
**Wie zijn wij ?**  

Als welzijnspartner voor werkgevers bouwt **Mensura** aan een wereld waarin zo veel mogelijk mensen lang, gezond en gelukkig kunnen werken. Werk draagt duurzaam bij en werkt positief in op gezondheid. Daarom zetten we in op betekenisvol werk dat mensen verbindt en engageert. Door welzijn goed te organiseren, zorgen we bij meer dan 50 000 werkgevers voor winst op alle fronten: tevreden medewerkers, lager ziekteverzuim, minder arbeidsongevallen, hogere betrokkenheid, meer retentie en betere bedrijfsresultaten.  



  

**Functiebeschrijving**  

Als medewerker binnen het **DevOps/SecOps\-team** werk je mee aan het opzetten en onderhouden van een snelle en kwalitatieve softwareoplevering, gebaseerd op algemeen aanvaarde DevOps\-principes. Daarnaast ondersteun je als SecOps\-medewerker de dagelijkse uitvoering en opvolging van securityoperaties. Je voert securitygerelateerde taken uit, draagt bij aan de opleiding van interne medewerkers en helpt mee om security awareness binnen de organisatie verder te versterken.


**Wat ga je doen?**


* Je werkt mee aan de implementatie en verdere optimalisatie van DevOps\-, SecOps\- en Continuous Delivery\-processen.
* Je ondersteunt en faciliteert software releases en draagt actief bij aan release\-managementprocessen, zodat wijzigingen gecontroleerd en betrouwbaar in productie worden gebracht.
* Je werkt met algemene ALM\-concepten, zoals version control, branching, package management, build\- en release management en Infrastructure\-as\-Code.
* Je werkt met CI/CD\-tooling en technologieën binnen een .NET\- en Azure\-context.
* Je ontwerpt en implementeert technische oplossingen op Azure.
* Je identificeert opportuniteiten om bestaande processen te vereenvoudigen, te versnellen en te automatiseren.
* Je vormt een brug tussen IT Development en Security Operations en werkt nauw samen met beide teams.
* Je voert, als back\-up, SecOps\-taken uit en ondersteunt de dagelijkse securityoperaties.
* Je werkt mee aan securitygerelateerde initiatieven en draagt bij aan het verhogen van security awareness bij interne medewerkers.
* Je draagt bij aan de voorbereiding en begeleiding van interne communicatie\- en adoptietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld bij de uitrol van nieuwe security\- of IT\-initiatieven.
* Je werkt nauw samen met externe leveranciers en partners en bewaakt mee de kwaliteit, veiligheid en continuïteit van de geleverde diensten.
* Je werkt binnen een Agile omgeving.


  

**Jij hebt in je bagage**  

* Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol.
* Je hebt bij voorkeur kennis van Git version control, Azure DevOps build \& release management, PowerShell en andere scripting, Windows Server, Microsoft Azure\-services en de M365 Security Suite.
* Ervaring met ontwikkeling (C\#, .NET) en databases (SQL Server) is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste.
* Je hebt kennis van of interesse in cybersecurity in al zijn aspecten.
* Je begrijpt de relatie tussen softwareontwikkeling, security, change management en release management en weet hierin de juiste prioriteiten te stellen.
* Je bent een teamplayer.
* Je ziet werk, neemt initiatief en doet zelf voorstellen. Je weet hiervoor draagvlak te creëren en veranderingen duurzaam te implementeren.
* Je hebt een hands\-on mentaliteit.
* Je beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden.
* Je beschikt over sterke communicatie\- en presentatievaardigheden en voelt je comfortabel om groepen toe te spreken.
* Je kunt complexe technische materie begrijpelijk vertalen naar business stakeholders en eindgebruikers.
* Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Frans.
* Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Hasselt.


  

**Wat jij bij Mensura krijgt**  


✅ Je job zit vol variatie. Welkom in een organisatie die oog heeft voor jou. En voor jouw groei, ontwikkeling en toekomst.


✅ Een aantrekkelijk loon. Met bedrijfswagen, smartphone, groeps\- en hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques en eco\-cheques.


✅ 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen \+ 3 Mensura\-extralegale feestdagen.


✅ 12 of 18 ADV dagen. Jaarlijks zelf te kiezen, op basis van een tewerkstellingsduur (38u/40u of 37u/40u).


✅ Onze bedrijfscultuur zet in op innovatie: we investeren in nieuwe technologieën, zetten partnerships op met start\-ups en stappen mee in academisch onderzoek.


✅ Ons luisterend oor voor wat jij verwacht. Aandacht voor het welzijn van al onze medewerkers, zowel fysiek als mentaal. En een breed scala aan beweeguitdagingen, vitaliteitsonderzoeken en psychosociale ondersteuning.

  


  

**Interesse ?**  


Zin om deel uit te maken van Mensura? Solliciteer dan zo snel mogelijk via onze website.


**Deadline solliciteren: 11/10/2026**


Wat kan je nadien verwachten ?


* Ons Talent Acquisition Team analyseert jouw sollicitatie.


* Je bent geselecteerd voor een interview met HR ? Dan krijg je een uitnodiging voor een gesprek via Teams.


* Na een positief eerste gesprek volgt een tweede gesprek op locatie met de betrokken teamleader.


* Alles positief verlopen ? We bieden je een vast contract aan.
  




Heb je nog een vraag of wil je meer informatie over deze functie? Neem dan zeker contact op met ons Talent Acquisition Team op hr\-recruitment@mensura.be.

jobs.description:
**Job Ref:** INT25929**Branch:** Courtyard by Marriott, Ghent**Location:** Courtyard by Marriott, Ghent**Salary/Benefits:** x**Contract type:** Permanent**Hours:** Full Time**Hours per week:** 38**Posted date:** 11/09/2026**Closing date:** 01/12/2026 **Creëer een thuis voor gasten bij Courtyard by Marriott Gent!**



Ben jij iemand die energie haalt uit het verwelkomen van mensen, met oprechte interesse en een gastvrije flair? Dan hebben wij dé plek voor jou in het Front Office team van het splinternieuwe Courtyard by Marriott in Gent!



Bij ons draait gastvrijheid niet alleen om service – het gaat om het creëren van betekenisvolle momenten. Of je nu ervaring hebt in de hotellerie of net je eerste stappen wil zetten in een internationale omgeving: als jij passie hebt voor gastvrijheid, dan helpen wij je groeien.


**Wat ga je doen als Hotelreceptionist(e)?**



Jij bent het eerste gezicht dat onze gasten zien – en ook degene die ze niet snel vergeten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat iedereen zich meteen welkom en thuis voelt.



Je taken zijn gevarieerd en impactvol:


* Je ontvangt gasten hartelijk en helpt hen bij check\-in en check\-out volgens de kwaliteitsstandaarden van Marriott.
* Je bent hét aanspreekpunt voor vragen, verzoeken of zorgen – steeds met een luisterend oor en oplossingsgerichte aanpak.
* Je kent Gent als je broekzak en deelt graag tips over lokale hotspots, eetgelegenheden en verborgen parels.
* Je denkt commercieel mee en promoot onze hotelservices door actief bijkomende diensten aan te bevelen.
* Je registreert feedback en klachten zorgvuldig, en zorgt samen met je team voor een snelle en professionele opvolging.
* Je bedient ook de bar naast de receptie: je serveert drankjes en kleine gerechten aan onze gasten, steeds met dezelfde gastvrije flair.


Kortom: je bent de host, vertrouwenspersoon, de probleemoplosser én de ambassadeur van ons hotel – allemaal tegelijk.


**Wie zoeken we?**



Je bent iemand die:


* Oprecht houdt van mensen en graag een positieve indruk nalaat.
* Goed functioneert in een team, maar ook zelfstandig initiatief neemt.
* Openstaat voor flexibele werkuren, namelijk shifts tussen 7u en 23u, ook in weekends.
* Zoekt naar voltijds (38u) of deeltijds werk.
* Vlot communiceert in het Nederlands en Engels (kennis van andere talen is een plus).
* Ervaring in hospitalitysector is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw houding en leergoesting zijn voor ons minstens zo belangrijk.


Een diploma in Hotelmanagement of relevante ervaring aan de receptie is een plus, maar niet vereist. Wat telt, is jouw enthousiasme, betrokkenheid en klantgerichte mindset.


**Wat bieden we jou?**


* Een duurzaam engagement via een contract van onbepaalde duur
* Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket, inclusief:
	+ DKV hospitalisatieverzekering
	+ Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
	+ Wereldwijde personeelskortingen binnen Marriott International
* Een flexibele werkregeling: wij ondersteunen een gezonde werk\-privébalans en passen ons aan elkaar aan. Een niet\-traditioneel 9\-tot\-5 schema heeft ook voordelen – haal je kinderen van school, ga naar die sportles op dinsdag, of geniet van je vrije tijd terwijl anderen werken
* Een unieke start vanaf het prille begin! Help mee aan een spraakmakende hotelopening, waar je vanaf dag één impact kan maken op het Front Office team
* Ruimte voor groei, via het Marriott trainingsplatform en coaching on the job
* Een open en ondersteunende bedrijfscultuur – we geloven in teamwork, vertrouwen en plezier op het werk


**Over ons**



In een groene oase op een vlot bereikbare locatie in Gent vind je onze unieke hospitality\-hub: een samenwerking tussen Courtyard by Marriott, Holiday Inn Express en Residence Inn by Marriott. Deze drie hotels vormen samen een bruisende plek waar gastvrijheid, comfort en beleving centraal staan. De hub omvat een state\-of\-the\-art event center en het verfijnde Arno Ristorante, een Toscaans fine\-dining restaurant.



Courtyard by Marriott opent zijn deuren in oktober 2025\. Het hotel telt 174 stijlvolle kamers en biedt gasten een inspirerende mix van elegantie en functionaliteit. Dankzij de samenwerking tussen de hotels, het event center en de fb outlets creëren we een naadloze ervaring voor zowel zakenreizigers als toeristen. Your stay, your way — daar staan wij voor.


**Bereikbaarheid**



Onze locatie is gemakkelijk bereikbaar, waar je ook vandaan komt. Het hotel ligt op het adres Akkerhage 2B, 9000 Gent, vlak bij afrit 9 (U.Z. Gent) van de E17\. Kom je met de auto? Dan parkeer je zorgeloos op onze ruime gratis parking. Fietsers, steppers of speedpedelecers vinden vlot hun weg via veilige en goed aangelegde fietspaden tot aan de ingang, met een handige fietsenstalling ter plaatse. Ook het openbaar vervoer brengt je moeiteloos tot bij ons: tram\- en bushaltes bevinden zich op wandelafstand, met vlotte verbindingen via De Lijn.


**Solliciteren? Graag!**



Klik op de knop ‘Solliciteer nu’. Je wordt doorgestuurd naar onze Engelstalige jobsite Aimbridge Hospitality. Onderaan de pagina kan je eenvoudig je cv en gegevens achterlaten.



Zien we een match? Dan hoor je snel van ons voor een eerste kennismakingsgesprek.


**Iedereen welkom**



Bij Marriott en Aimbridge geloven we in de kracht van een divers team. We verwelkomen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden, identiteiten en ervaringsniveaus. Wat voor ons telt? Jouw enthousiasme, talent en de zin om samen een gastvrije plek te creëren waar iedereen zich welkom voelt.



Ready to make an impact?



We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

**Welcome to Courtyard by Marriott Ghent**
==========================================


**ENJOY GHENT FROM OUR ULTRA MODERN COMFORTABLE HOTEL**
-------------------------------------------------------



Courtyard By Marriott Ghent invites travelers to visit this vibrant and authentic Belgian city. Conveniently situated in this gateway location with convenient access to the tech lane, business parks and multiple transport links. Courtyard by Marriott Ghent features 174 meticulously designed rooms, each offering all the modern amenities a twenty first century traveler could need. You can also enjoy authentic Belgian cuisine with colleagues, family or friends in Brasserie Stroom as well as sampling a wide range of Belgian craft beers. If you are feeling active you could work out in our on site fitness centre fully equipped with all the latest equipment and then the following morning enjoy the famous Courtyard by Marriott buffet breakfast in Stroom. If you're planning a business meeting, the Boardroom provides a bright and spacious meeting room with contemporary decor , up\-to\-date audiovisual technology and a flexible break out area

jobs.title: E-Commerce Project Management Intern - Nestlé
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** **Where will you work?** Nestlé’s offices in Brussels \& Homeworking  

**When will you start?** As from February 2027  

**How long will it last?** 6 months  

If you are passionate about eCommerce and eager to learn how digital channels drive growth in the FMCG sector, Nestlé offers an exciting **6\-month paid internship**. You will work closely with the eCommerce Manager to strengthen the online presence of some of Nestlé’s most iconic brands, including Nescafé, KitKat, Nesquik, Garden Gourmet, Maggi, and many more, across **Pure Players** (Amazon, VeePee) and **Brick \& Mortar** retailers (Delhaize, Carrefour, Colruyt), while supporting the development of online\-only customers such as Happy Hour and Too Good To Go. **Your Responsibilities:**  

* Own the **E\-content** process and coordinate eContent\-related discussions during eCommerce meetings with Nestlé categories and brands
* Upload, maintain, and optimize product content across customer platforms and service providers, including product descriptions, images, ingredients, and advanced E\-content when required
* Update E\-content following product relaunches, assortment changes, and retailer\-specific requirements
* Act as the internal and external E\-content specialist, collaborating with cross\-functional teams and customers to ensure content excellence
* Support the E\-commerce Manager in developing sales opportunities with online\-only customers such as **Happy Hour** and **Too Good To Go**
* Coordinate promotional and operational activities by planning volumes with category teams, validating plans with customers, ensuring smooth execution, and responding to customer inquiries
* Contribute to strengthening Nestlé's E\-commerce footprint and identifying opportunities to improve online visibility and performance across customer channels

 **What will make you successful?**  

* You are Fluent in French and/or Dutch and have a strong command of English
* You have obtained or are currently pursuing a degree in Business Administration, Management, Digital Marketing, Sales or a related field
* You demonstrate strong **communication** skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build positive relationships
* You are **confident** and possess strong **sociability**, daring to **challenge others** with an open and commercial mindset
* You are flexible, **independent** and **proactive** in taking initiative \& ownership of your tasks
* You are **IT‑literate** and proficient in the Microsoft Office Pack, with solid skills in PowerPoint and Excel
* You demonstrate a strong affinity with E‑Commerce and feel comfortable working in a digital‑focused environment
* Ideally you have a genuine interest in the FMCG world

 ***We can only accept students not requiring a work permit or visa to be eligible to perform an internship in Belgium.***

**What we offer**  

* Great opportunity to learn to work in a FMCG, international environment
* Part of a diverse intern community
* Fun and educational events organized for the intern community, with opportunities to broaden your network
* Possibility to do a **school internship** **via a university agreement** or a voluntary internship **after graduating** **via a CIP** (Convention D ‘Immersion Professionnelle)
* Competitive internship allowance: 250€ \-1200€ net per month (38hrs \- 5 days) depending on the type of internship contract
* Transport reimbursement
* 3\.5 days of paid leave
* 10 days possibility to work from abroad
* Flexibility to work from home 3 days a week
* Pet friendly office with unlimited coffee and fruits

  

**Recruitment Process*** **1st step:** CV screening. We will review your background, experience, and fit for the position
* **2nd****step:** Online HR interview. This conversation will focus on your motivation, availability, personality, and alignment with our company culture
* **3****rd****step:** Online Hiring manager interview. Meet your future internship manager to learn more about the role and discuss how you can contribute to the team

 **Any questions?**  

  

Our recruiters would be glad to answer any pending questions. Feel free to send your questions to careers@be.nestle.com.  

  

*Respect is at the heart of Nestlé's culture, of which room for differences is an important part. Differences between people who buy our products and in our workplace. We believe it is important that everyone feels welcome and safe at Nestlé, regardless your gender, religion, cultural background, age, disability or who you love. We are convinced that diversity leads to more creativity and innovation and moves our organization forward. That is why we actively work to create a culture and leadership that offers equal opportunities for all!*

jobs.title: Nachtzorgkundige (19u)
jobs.description:
### **Onderneming**

*emeis* is een van de grootste zorgverleners in België. Goede zorg is teamwork, dus staan we altijd klaar om elkaar te helpen en van elkaar te leren. De naam *emeis*, geïnspireerd door het Oud\-Griekse ‘wij’, weerspiegelt de hechte band met onze bewoners, hun families en de samenleving als geheel. In onze woonzorgcentra en assistentiewoningen is het goed leven én werken.


### **Functie**


Als nachtzorgkundige bij *emeis* help je bewoners om zo zelfstandig en comfortabel mogelijk te leven. Een **warme, huiselijke sfeer** waarin iedereen zich goed voelt, daar doe jij het voor! Jij maakt het graag persoonlijk, dus betrek je ook de families van de bewoners bij de zorg.


### **Profiel**

**Jij zorgt, ook wanneer de wereld slaapt**
-------------------------------------------


Voor onze bewoners zoeken we een **enthousiaste nachtzorgkundige** die met zorg, aandacht en een warm hart klaarstaat tijdens de nacht.


Je haalt energie uit het contact met bewoners, bent nieuwsgierig en leert graag bij. In een **multidisciplinair team** voel je je helemaal op je plek en je gaat steeds voor één ding: **de beste en meest kwaliteitsvolle zorg voor onze bewoners**.

### **Dit breng je mee**

* Je hebt een **diploma zorgkundige**, of je hebt het **eerste jaar van de opleiding verpleegkunde succesvol afgerond**.
* Je beschikt over een **geldig visum van de FOD Volksgezondheid**.
* Je spreekt **vlot Nederlands**.
* Je werkt **nauwgezet** en vindt het belangrijk om procedures correct op te volgen.
* Je bent betrokken, betrouwbaar en hebt een **oprechte interesse in het welzijn van onze bewoners**.

### **En wie ben jij?**


Een diploma en de juiste kwalificaties zijn belangrijk, maar we kijken ook graag naar de persoon achter het diploma. Misschien ben jij iemand die rust brengt, goed kan luisteren, snel schakelt of net dat tikkeltje extra aandacht geeft.

**Wat jouw persoonlijke troeven ook zijn: we horen ze graag.**


Krijg je na het lezen van deze vacature zin om kennis te maken? **Laat dan zeker van je horen. We kijken ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten!**

### **Aanbod**


Werken als **nachtzorgkundige** is pittig. Verantwoordelijkheid, emotionele momenten en onverwachte situaties horen erbij. Maar jouw werk is vooral **waardevol en betekenisvol**. Jij zorgt voor rust, veiligheid en een vertrouwd gevoel tijdens de nacht.


Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat jij je goed voelt in je job. Je komt terecht in een **warm en gezellig team** waar we samen de nacht aanpakken, elkaar ondersteunen én tijd maken voor een lach.

### **Dit mag je van ons verwachten:**

* **Werkzekerheid:** een deeltijds contract van 19u per week flexibel in te vullen.
* **Correcte verloning:** volgens IFIC 11, met behoud van anciënniteit (**€ 2\.949 – € 3\.776 bruto**).
* **Extra voordelen:** maaltijdcheques, woon\-werkvergoeding, hospitalisatieverzekering, eindejaarspremie, attractiviteitspremie en kortingen via Benefits@Work.
* **Aandacht voor je gezin:** kinderopvang tijdens de schoolvakanties.
* **Ruimte om te groeien:** interne opleidingen en ontwikkelingskansen.
* **Een fijne werkomgeving:** een ruime ontspanningsruimte en een groene omgeving waar je je snel thuis voelt.

**Jij zorgt voor onze bewoners. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij je goed voelt in je job**

### **Talen**

The role requires excellent stakeholder management, strong analytical capabilities, ownership, and the ability to lead end\-to\-end features and opuses while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and customer experience considerations.


Your missions:

* Support change management activities and user onboarding for new solutions.

jobs.title: Chauffeur CE – camion à conteneurs
