Als Senior Software Developer \& Software Architect (w/m/d) gestalten Sie die Softwarearchitektur unserer innovativen Röntgendiffraktometrie\-Lösungen und wirken gleichzeitig aktiv an deren Entwicklung mit. Sie schaffen damit die technische Basis für präzise Messungen und anspruchsvolle Materialanalysen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams entwickeln Sie zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen, setzen zentrale Komponenten selbst um und prägen deren technologische Weiterentwicklung maßgeblich mit.


### **Aufgabenbereich:**


* Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer und wartbarer Softwarearchitekturen
* Aktive Mitarbeit in der Softwareentwicklung sowie Konzeption und Implementierung anspruchsvoller Softwarekomponenten
* Definition und Sicherstellung von Architekturprinzipien, technischen Standards und Guidelines
* Technische Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen über den gesamten Software\-Lifecycle
* Auswahl und Bewertung geeigneter Technologien, Frameworks und Architekturkonzepte
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklung, Product Ownern und weiteren technischen Stakeholdern
* Durchführung von Code und Architecture Reviews sowie Identifikation technischer Risiken und Optimierungspotenziale
* Sicherstellung von Softwarequalität, Performance, Security und langfristiger Wartbarkeit
* Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen und Weitergabe von technischem Know\-how
### **Ihr Profil:**


* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Software Engineering oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung sowie im Software Design bzw. in der Softwarearchitektur
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Architekturkonzepte, Design Patterns und Software\-Engineering\-Prinzipien
* Fundierte praktische Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in C\#/.NET
* Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Softwarelösungen
* Erfahrung mit modernen Entwicklungsprozessen, APIs, Datenbanken und CI/CD
* Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam im Team voranzutreiben
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
### **Was wir bieten:**


* Einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz in unserem expandierenden, international agierenden Hightech\-Unternehmen
* Eine innovative Unternehmenskultur, die Raum für Spitzenleistungen bietet und die Stellung als Technologieführer am Weltmarkt sichert
* Ein wertorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das ein kollegiales Miteinander fördert und aktive Mitgestaltung fordert
* Eine herausfordernde Aufgabe mit Selbstverantwortung und persönlichem Gestaltungsspielraum
* Eine intensive individuelle Einschulung

Fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildung  
* 

Wir bieten Ihnen eine faire und marktkonforme Vergütung auf Basis des Kollektivvertrags für Angestellte im Metallgewerbe \- angepasst an die regionalen Gegebenheiten des steirischen Arbeitsmarkts. Das Mindestgehalt für diese Position beträgt € 4\.500 brutto pro Monat (auf Vollzeitbasis). Persönlichkeit, Kompetenz und Erfahrung zählen bei uns mehr als starre Vorgaben. Deshalb legen wir Ihr tatsächliches Bruttogehalt individuell fest und honorieren Ihre Qualifikationen selbstverständlich mit einer entsprechenden Überzahlung.

jobs.title: Consultant Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Austria
 Full\-time permanent position
  
#### **About the Role**


As a **Consultant Test Automation Engineer**, you assist our clients in automating their test processes as well as guaranteeing the quality of their software solutions. With your technical expertise and experience in test automation, you play a crucial role in the successful execution of client projects.
  

  

With **18 offices across 7 countries and over 900 employees**, we offer you the opportunity to work on exciting projects with prestigious clients. We promote your professional and personal development from day one and offer flexible working hours as well as the option to work remotely. Our corporate culture is familial, open, and appreciative, providing plenty of room for your personal development. The minimum gross monthly salary for this role under the IT collective agreement is € 3,175\. Your actual compensation will be defined jointly, depending on your qualifications and experience.


#### **Responsibilities**

* You design, develop and maintain automated test cases (UI and services) within our customer\-specific tool landscape.
* You evaluate customer requirements and existing test cases to identify automation opportunities.
* After executing the tests, you analyze the results and use them to continuously improve test coverage and software quality.
* Your expertise allows you to guide the team in selecting the best tools for the job.
* By developing customized test automation strategies, you streamline the progress of our customer projects.
* In addition to defining and creating necessary test data, you ensure the proper execution of the tests.
#### **Qualifications**

* You have 3 years of experience in software testing, ideally with a focus on automated testing.
* You are familiar with automation and testing tools such as TOSCA, Selenium, SoapUI, Ranorex, or similar platforms.
* You have programming experience in languages such as Java, C\#, C\+\+, Groovy Script or equivalent technologies.
* Your trolley is always ready to roll, and you are happy to use it regularly for business trips.
* With business fluent German language skills (C1\) and ISTQB certification, you fulfil two key requirements for a successful start with us.
#### **The Benefits We Bring to You:**

Remote work
 Flexible working hours
 Exciting projects
 Modern hardware and equipment
 Supportive, family\-oriented environment
 Tailored training and development opportunities
 Career growth opportunities
 Team events
 Attractive, performance\-based salary

**We look forward to hearing from you!**

* ING Bank


  
* ration with key stakeholders, harness product delivery

* **Networking**: Collaborate closely with other chapters leads within and outside the tribe and Identify synergies with other tribes.
* **Ensure a highly skilled and motivated chapter:** that shares knowledge and lessons learned
* Ensure a safe, open, experimental, continuous learning, collaborative culture
* **Help improve our engineering practices**
* **Responsible of the transformation agenda** applicable to the assets of the subdomain
* **Responsible of keeping the alignment with group standards**
* **Responsible of ensuring the required levels of service** in all environments with the assets under scope

**What are we looking for?**


**Proven track record and technical skills**


**Essential:**

* Engineering’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience
* Proactivity is a must; we are expecting a LEADER.
* Architectural skills
* Experience in Data Projects based on Public Cloud Technologies.
* Strong knowledge and development experience of Public Cloud (Azure or GCP)
* Desirable data migration to cloud projects.
* AI adoption process experience.
* AI development experience on Public Cloud.
* Passionate
* Strong analytical, people management and communication skills
* Negotiation skills
* Broad net working inside the bank
* Able to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative
* Improvement spirit looking for better solutions and questioning the what for we do the things
* Loving to collaborate with different people
* Making things happen and ‘can do’ attitude
* DevOps and Agile culture

Nice to have:


* Preferably with managerial experience within an agile organization, and inspiration to continuing working in this matter.
* Without fear of escalating problems within the International Group

**What do we offer?**


The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

  

  

Check out what is waiting for you!


**Balance That Works.**


We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.


**Meal allowance.**


Receive your meal allowance in the way that best suits you: through a meal card or directly in your payroll, giving you greater flexibility and convenience in managing your everyday needs.


**More than an office.**


In our offices you can find doctor’s office, hairdresser, gym, Employee Concierge (to help you with your errands) and much more!


**Health and life insurance.**


We help you protect what matters most to you, including you and your immediate family.


**Flexible remuneration.**


Enjoy access to services such as nursery vouchers, public transport and training support, as well as other benefits through our flexible remuneration model.


**Commuting made easier.**


Our free shuttle service connects different areas of Madrid with ING MAD, helping make your commute to the office more comfortable and convenient.


**Banking benefits.**


Loans with preferential banking conditions.


Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.


And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!


**More vitality and more belonging**


Our 360º wellbeing approach supports employees across Financial, Physical, Mental and Social Wellbeing.


On\-site physiotherapy service.


A strong wellbeing culture, including Wellhub access, sports communities and activities.


Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI\+), Leonas \& RIÑG.


International Remote work program.


**Get to know Us**


We are a team of more than 1900 people sharing one idea: **doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves**, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.


A **fully online bank** where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with **agile methodologies**.


And although we are based in Spain, we **are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.**


We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of **Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging** to foster a culture of **collaboration and innovation** that represents all collectives in the society.


And even though we look orange on the outside, **we are green on the inside**. Our ambition in Sustainability is **Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey**. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.


**Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA.** If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!


*At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.*


**Job Application Safety Reminder**

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:


**Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.


**Check the sender’s email carefully:** Legitimate communication will always come from **@ing.com** and/or **@myworkday.com**.


**No payments or banking details will ever be requested:** If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

En **ING** estamos buscando un/a **Data \& AI Engineering Manager**.


Tu rol y entorno de trabajo:


Como **Data \& AI Engineering Manager**, proporcionarás liderazgo técnico estratégico para todos los productos y servicios dentro del ecosistema de datos, incluidas las plataformas de datos, los procesos de entrega de datos y la propuesta de fundamentos de IA. Serás responsable de los siguientes productos:


Ejecución de las Plataformas de Datos de Nueva Generación:


* Nuevo proceso de extremo a extremo para Productos de Datos basado en **Google Cloud Platform**.
* Procesos de Big Data en la nube.
* Gestión de Datos (gobierno y calidad) en la nube.
* Garantizar el funcionamiento de las Plataformas de Datos en un entorno de nube híbrida.
* Trabajar con el equipo de Innovación y Fundamentos de IA.

Tus principales responsabilidades:


Responsabilidades del producto:


* Ser responsable de la ejecución de las iniciativas de Data Driven Banking.
* Co\-crear el “CÓMO” junto con la persona responsable de negocio y la persona responsable de Data Driven Banking.
* Alinear con la persona responsable de negocio la estrategia IT más adecuada para el desarrollo de productos nuevos o existentes.
* Garantizar la entrega de negocio y el cumplimiento de los estándares tecnológicos.
* Proporcionar soluciones para mejorar la fiabilidad, escalabilidad y rendimiento de los servicios.
* Mantenerse al día sobre las mejores tecnologías que puedan mejorar nuestros sistemas.
* Definir la composición de los equipos/squads IT.
* Definir la organización del squad/producto/programa junto con la persona responsable de negocio.
* Gestionar el desarrollo de productos de extremo a extremo, garantizando una integración y entrega fluidas:


	+ Definir junto con el equipo de gestión IT de la tribu los acuerdos de ingeniería que garanticen el Time to Market y la calidad del producto requerida en el banco como parte de la DoD.
* Diseñar sistemas pensando en la resiliencia y gestionar de forma proactiva los incidentes para minimizar el tiempo de inactividad y garantizar la continuidad. Dar soporte a Producción mediante el análisis y resolución de errores que puedan surgir. Contribuir a mejorar la disciplina técnica colaborando con el capítulo técnico transversal. Aprender de los errores.
* Resiliencia desde el diseño y gestión proactiva de incidentes.
* Contribuir a la gestión de incidentes en producción.
* Identificar la mejor forma de trabajo para alcanzar el rendimiento adecuado dentro de la tribu.
* Definir e identificar las brechas IT en cada equipo/producto/proyecto para mejorar los controles de calidad IT y ofrecer la mejor solución a nuestros/as clientes/as.

Desarrollo de personas:


* Liderar equipos de Data Engineers.
* Mejorar nuestras prácticas de ingeniería, priorizando la calidad frente a la cantidad.
* Garantizar el desarrollo profesional de cada Data Engineer.

Gestión presupuestaria y colaboración con Finanzas y proveedores/as externos/as:


* Ser la mano derecha de las principales personas interesadas, alineando la transformación tecnológica con la evolución del negocio y aprovechando las necesidades de negocio para transformar e innovar.

En tu subdominio de tribu junto con la persona responsable del Área IT:


* Ejecutar la estrategia del CIO.
* Propiedad integral de producto: la persona Engineering Manager, dentro de su dominio y en colaboración con las principales personas interesadas, impulsa la entrega de producto.
* Eficiencia: centrarse en la evolución del producto y en la eficiencia operativa para lograr un entorno tecnológico más saludable y sostenible.
* Networking: colaborar estrechamente con otras personas líderes de capítulos dentro y fuera de la tribu e identificar sinergias con otras tribus.
* Garantizar un capítulo altamente cualificado y motivado que comparta conocimiento y lecciones aprendidas.
* Garantizar una cultura segura, abierta, experimental, colaborativa y de aprendizaje continuo.
* Ayudar a mejorar nuestras prácticas de ingeniería.
* Ser responsable de la agenda de transformación aplicable a los activos del subdominio.
* Ser responsable de mantener la alineación con los estándares del grupo.
* Ser responsable de garantizar los niveles de servicio requeridos en todos los entornos para los activos bajo su responsabilidad.

¿Qué estamos buscando?


Trayectoria demostrada y habilidades técnicas


Imprescindible:


* Titulación en Ingeniería y un mínimo de 10 años de experiencia.
* La proactividad es imprescindible; esperamos una persona LÍDER.
* Habilidades de arquitectura.
* Experiencia en proyectos de datos basados en tecnologías de nube pública.
* Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia de desarrollo en nube pública (Azure o GCP).
* Valorable experiencia en proyectos de migración de datos a la nube.
* Experiencia en procesos de adopción de IA.
* Experiencia en desarrollo de IA sobre nube pública.
* Pasión por la tecnología.
* Fuertes capacidades analíticas, de gestión de personas y de comunicación.
* Habilidades de negociación.
* Amplia red de contactos dentro del banco.
* Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y tomar la iniciativa.
* Mentalidad de mejora continua, buscando mejores soluciones y cuestionando el propósito de las cosas que hacemos.
* Gusto por colaborar con diferentes personas.
* Capacidad de hacer que las cosas sucedan y actitud de “sí se puede”.
* Cultura DevOps y Agile.

Deseable:


* Preferiblemente experiencia de gestión dentro de una organización ágil y motivación para seguir desarrollándose en este ámbito.
* No tener reparos en escalar problemas dentro del Grupo Internacional.

¿Qué ofrecemos?


El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o los aprendizajes que adquieres son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué ocurre con tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te satisfaga en todos los sentidos y, por eso, cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.


¡Descubre todo lo que te espera!


Sé flexible, amiga/o.


Nuestro modelo se basa en la flexibilidad y la responsabilidad. Teniendo en cuenta las necesidades tanto de nuestra clientela como de nuestras personas empleadas, decidirás conjuntamente qué días trabajas desde casa y qué días vienes a **ING MAD** para dar lo mejor de ti. Hazlo a tu manera.


Tarjeta restaurante.


Para que pensar qué comer no ocupe tu tiempo ni tus antojos.


Nuestra casa será tu casa.


En nuestras oficinas encontrarás soluciones de movilidad eléctrica, servicio médico, peluquería, gimnasio, The Good Service (para ayudarte con tus gestiones) y mucho más.


Seguro de salud.


Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijos/as).


Seguro de vida.


Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.


Retribución flexible.


Además, disfrutarás de nuestro modelo de retribución flexible. De una manera fiscalmente más ventajosa, podrás acceder a otros servicios como guardería, tarjeta de transporte, ayudas para formación…


Servicio gratuito de lanzadera de empresa.


No importa dónde vivas. Disponemos de 6 rutas (Norte, Centro, Sur, A5, A42 y A6\) para llevarte cómodamente a nuestra oficina de ING en Madrid.


Beneficios bancarios.


* Préstamos especiales con condiciones más ventajosas.
* Condiciones especiales de hipoteca después de 6 meses trabajando en el banco.
* ¡Y podrás beneficiarte de nuestro plan de pensiones después de solo 1 mes con nosotras/os!

Más vitalidad y más sentimiento de pertenencia.


* Atención integral 360º a la persona empleada (bienestar físico, mental, conexión social y propósito).
* Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.
* Clínicas con deportistas profesionales de nivel mundial.
* Servicio Gympass.
* Redes de personas empleadas: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI\+), Leonas y RIÑG.
* Programa internacional de trabajo remoto.

Conócenos


Somos un equipo de más de 1\.700 personas que comparten una misma idea: aportar nuestro granito de arena para ayudar a nuestra clientela a construir un futuro mejor, proporcionándoles las herramientas necesarias para llegar donde quieren estar.


Un banco totalmente online donde la tecnología, la innovación, la simplicidad y la transparencia son los ingredientes principales, y el primero en trabajar con metodologías ágiles.


Y aunque estamos ubicadas/os en España, tenemos la suerte de formar parte de un banco internacional con presencia en más de 40 países.


Estamos orgullosas/os de contar con un equipo diverso y nos comprometemos a seguir desarrollando una cultura de Diversidad, Inclusión y Pertenencia que fomente la colaboración y la innovación, representando a todos los colectivos de la sociedad.


Y aunque por fuera parezcamos naranjas, por dentro somos verdes. Nuestra ambición en sostenibilidad es impulsar tu viaje y el nuestro hacia la sostenibilidad. Estamos recorriendo nuestro propio camino, pero también estaremos al lado de nuestra clientela cuando decida emprender el suyo.


Hacer que las cosas sucedan, ayudar a otras personas a tener éxito y estar siempre un paso por delante: ese es nuestro ADN. Si te miras al espejo y tu reflejo coincide con nuestra forma de ser y trabajar… ¡estamos deseando conocerte!

jobs.title: Product Manager - Integrations & API
jobs.description:
**Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.**

  

**Join us** **on the**  

**Product Management** **team** **as a** **Product Manager – Integrations \&** **API’s**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.  

**Start your journey with Anova today****!**

 **Role Summary:**



The Product Manager owns a significant product domain within Anova Unify — from multi\-year strategy through to execution, adoption, and business outcomes. You set the vision for your area, build conviction through deep customer and market insight, and drive delivery in close partnership with engineering and design. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence roadmap direction across the broader product organization, and are a go\-to thought partner for senior leadership.



This role's center of gravity is outcomes — customer value realized, revenue retained and grown, and platform capability that compounds over time. You're as comfortable in a customer conversation as you are in a data model discussion or a board\-level briefing. You mentor more junior PMs and raise the bar for how the team thinks about product quality, discovery rigor, and measurable impact.

  

**Where you’ll work:**

  


This is a hybrid role based out of our Porto office. In practice, most of your work can be done remotely, with occasional in\-office time in Porto for team collaboration — a flexibility our team consistently tell us they value.

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage.
* Own the go\-to\-market. Define pricing and positioning for your area in partnership with Marketing and Sales leadership. Enable the field with competitive intelligence, winning narratives, and objection handling.
* Set domain strategy. Define the multi\-year product vision for your area. Ground it in customer insight, competitive dynamics, and Anova's strategic priorities. Build and maintain the roadmap with clear outcome targets.
* Drive AI\-first product thinking. Identify where ML and AI (forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, workflow automation) create meaningful customer value in your domain. Build a clear point of view on what to build, what to buy, and what to partner for — and move it from idea to shipped capability.
* Partner with engineering on architecture and trade\-offs. Engage credibly on system design, API contracts, data models, and integration architecture. Make principled trade\-offs between scope, speed, and technical quality — and document your reasoning.
* Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
* Shape the customer success motion. Codify what success looks like for customers in your domain. Influence the playbooks, onboarding milestones, health scoring, and AI\-assisted scale programs that Customer Success runs.
* Mentor and develop PMs. Coach junior and mid\-level PMs on discovery methods, spec quality, prioritization discipline, and stakeholder communication. Model the standard for written PM artifacts across the team.
* Enable adoption. With each release, ensure the team is ready to help customers get value from what you've shipped.
  


**Outcomes you'll own:**

  


* Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your work toward understanding customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business, will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to our customer's value in servicing their customers.
* Platform growth and customer value realization. Your domain drives measurable customer outcomes — reduced operating costs, faster time\-to\-value, or expanded use cases. You track and improve these metrics continuously.
* Greater than 90% customer device productivity. Through solving real value\-adding problems for customers, providing best in class reliable uptime, drive customers to maintain their device portfolio live and healthy.
* Net Revenue Retention. Customers in your area renew, expand, and advocate. You own the product\-side inputs to NRR — adoption, engagement, and satisfaction — and make disciplined trade\-offs to protect gross margin.
* Roadmap quality and conviction. A rigorous, evidence\-backed roadmap that the organization trusts. You can defend every priority with data, customer insight, and a clear strategic rationale.
* Cross\-functional alignment. Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing are aligned on what's being built and why. Ambiguity is resolved upstream, not during delivery.
* Team development. You raise the craft of product management around you — through direct mentorship of PMs, strong written artifacts others learn from, and a culture of honest, evidence\-based decision\-making.

  


**How you'll work at Anova:**


* You write to think. Specs, strategy memos, one\-pagers, and decision frameworks are how we align a global, distributed team. Your written artifacts are models others reference. AI can help; writing well remains your skill to own.
* You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis. You have a seasoned, nuanced point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products, and you actively shape Anova's perspective on both.
* You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature. You build the instrumentation plan alongside the spec. You know when data is sufficient to decide and when it isn't.

  


**What you’ll need to succeed:**  

**Minimum Requirements \-**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with APIs, systems integration, and software deployment.
* 6\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product strategy and business outcomes.
* 10\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, systems integration, or comparable technical roles.
* You've built from scratch more than once — new products, new markets, new internal capabilities — and you have the experience to prove it. The more times you've started from nothing and shipped something that mattered, the better.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software that drove material business results — measured in adoption, retention, or revenue.
* Experience owning multi\-year product strategy and translating it into a prioritized, evidence\-backed roadmap.
* Deep customer discovery practice — structured interview programs, synthesis frameworks, and the ability to build conviction from ambiguous signals.
* Demonstrated experience using AI and LLM tools in a product management context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
* A clear, developed point of view on how AI should show up in B2B industrial products — both in internal operations and in customer\-facing capability.
* Ability to write compelling, structured strategy documents, specs, and narratives for executive and cross\-functional audiences.
* Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on APIs, data models, integration architecture, and system trade\-offs with engineering leaders.
* Data fluency: design metrics frameworks, build instrumentation plans, analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence\-based roadmap calls.
* Experience influencing pricing and go\-to\-market decisions for a product area.

  


**Preferred Qualifications \-**


* Prior product management in IIoT, connected\-hardware, or industrial technology environments.
* Experience shipping ML or AI\-driven features — forecasting, anomaly detection, decision support, or workflow automation — in a SaaS environment.
* Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies.
* Experience mentoring or managing junior PMs or leading a product pod.
* Domain knowledge in industrial operations, field service, supply chain, or logistics.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns — ERP, dispatch, routing, or billing system connectivity.
  


**Physical Requirements** **\-**


* Willingness and ability to travel up to 30–40% domestically and internationally.
* Travel won’t consistently be 30\-40%, however at times this individual must be able to travel up to that percentage monthly
* Ability to perform typical office tasks, including sitting or standing for extended periods, using a computer, communicating effectively, and occasionally lifting light items

  


**ABOUT ANOVA**



We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

  



We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

 **If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.**

  

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

**About Us**
Planet is a leading technology company transforming payments by putting customer experience first. We offer integrated solutions that include payment processing, VAT refunds, dynamic currency conversion, and management services for merchants in the Retail and Hospitality sectors worldwide.


In recent years, we have experienced significant growth, expanding our services and global presence.


With strong private equity investors, Advent International and Eurazeo, we have the financial capital and expertise to grow our capabilities and reach through acquisitions.


Our mission is to create a world of connected commerce where payments are simple, secure, and seamless, enabling our partners to deliver exceptional experiences to their customers.

 **Role overview:**


Planet is scaling AI\-first engineering across its technology organisation, and the AI Enablement team is helping turn that ambition into day\-to\-day reality.


We are looking for **Senior AI Developer Experience Engineers** to join the team and help drive adoption across Engineering. This is a hands\-on role focused on AI Fluency, developer experience, internal enablement tooling, and measurable improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.


You will work closely with teams across Engineering, partnering directly with developers, QAs, product owners, scrum masters, business analysts, and managers to help them adopt better ways of working with AI. This is not a role from the sidelines. You will spend time with teams, understand where they struggle, coach them in practical contexts, and help embed better habits into real delivery work.


We are looking for people with strong engineering foundations who also bring a strong human touch. You should be someone who communicates clearly, builds trust easily, works well with different personalities, and knows how to bring people with you. Success in this role depends as much on credibility with engineers as it does on your ability to explain, facilitate, coach, and create momentum across the organisation.


You will help enable more than 300 engineers, alongside a broader set of SDLC roles, through structured AI Fluency sessions, hands\-on pairing, internal agents and workflows, reusable guidance, and support for priority initiatives. Over time, the role will also help drive adoption of broader platform and toolchain capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness across Planet.

 **What You'll Do:**

* Deliver AI Fluency sessions across Engineering and SDLC roles, from prompt engineering fundamentals to more advanced agentic coding workflows and practical AI\-first ways of working
* Work closely with teams across Engineering, building strong relationships, understanding where they struggle, and helping them adopt AI and better workflows in a practical, team\-friendly way
* Pair directly with developers and teams to improve adoption in real delivery work, helping them use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations, and related capabilities effectively and responsibly.
* Help maintain and improve internal enablement tooling, including AI agents, automations, templates, prompts, workflows, and supporting assets used across the organisation.
* Create high\-quality enablement content, including guides, templates, examples, recorded sessions, best practices, and role\-specific learning material that teams can actually use.
* Assess and track AI maturity across teams using Planet’s AI Fluency model, helping identify where support is needed and where stronger patterns can be scaled.
* Support priority initiatives with dedicated AI\-first coaching, helping delivery teams apply better workflows, better prompting, and more effective use of internal tools in live projects.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture and Platform teams so enablement stays aligned with engineering standards, platform capabilities, system landscape, and the way Planet builds software.
* Capture adoption signals, usage insights, and learning feedback, and feed these into the AI Centre of Excellence and broader leadership reporting.
* Over time, help expand enablement beyond AI tooling into broader developer experience and platform adoption across the engineering toolchain.

 **Who you are:**

* Strong software engineering background, with experience building or maintaining production systems and a solid understanding of the full SDLC.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cody, Claude Code, or similar.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly, run hands\-on workshops, and adapt your style to different audiences across Engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a genuine human touch. You build trust, work well with different personalities, and enjoy helping teams improve in a practical and collaborative way.
* Credibility with engineers. You are comfortable pairing with developers, discussing implementation trade\-offs, and helping teams improve how they work in practice.
* Experience creating strong technical content such as guides, tutorials, documentation, or internal learning material.
* A genuine interest in developer experience, engineering productivity, and helping teams adopt better ways of working.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in developer experience, developer enablement, developer advocacy, or internal technical coaching.
* Understanding of enterprise engineering environments, including APIs, system design patterns, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure, and engineering governance.
* Strong understanding of prompt design, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, and practical AI usage patterns in software engineering.
* Experience defining or tracking adoption metrics, maturity models, developer productivity indicators, or ROI\-oriented enablement measures.
* Experience with workflow automation and internal tooling, including platforms such as N8N or similar.
* Familiarity with fintech, payments, or regulated engineering environments.

**Tech Environment**


AI and enablement tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, internal AI agents, workflow automations


Engineering ecosystem: GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Terraform


Languages and stacks: Java, .NET, TypeScript, Python, and others across Planet teams

 **Why Planet**


Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.


Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast\-paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel\-good connected commerce.


We would love to hear from you. Apply now.


At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

  

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.


  
### **About Us**

**Company Background**


Planet provides integrated software, payment and technology solutions for its customers in the Hospitality and Retail sectors and worldwide via a network of global Financial Services Partners.


Founded over 35 years ago, we have evolved our services, delivering an innovative digital commerce platform that puts customer experience first.


With headquarters in London and around 3,000 expert employees located across six continents we serve customers in over 120 markets.

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer - Associate
jobs.description:
**About us**

  

For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. And when it comes to developing industrial solutions to reduce carbon emissions, ExxonMobil is truly the leader.


We don't stop at "good enough." We are committed to doing what's right, even if it's difficult or unpopular. We hold ourselves to high standards, challenge what's possible and invest in innovation to meet society's critical needs.


Real change begins with bold questions, drive, and ambition. Here, your talent, determination and contributions shape how far you'll go and the impact you'll make along the way.


Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders.

  

**Our Culture**


We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day.


**ExxonMobil in Hungary**
-------------------------


ExxonMobil Hungary was established in 2004\. Our diverse and multinational workforce of \~1,500 fellow colleagues has been powering ExxonMobil’s global businesses ever since. We are proud to work in an inclusive, safe, and vibrant work environment and we are aiming to provide an exciting, long\-term career to all our employees. We develop together, we grow together. Proudly awarded as Responsible employer of the year and received HRKomm award for Diverse workplace and award for Ergonomic program.


**What role will you play in our team**
---------------------------------------


As a **Full Stack Web Developer \- Associate**, you will contribute to the development and support of modern web applications across the frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure layers. **This role is ideal for an early\-career software engineer looking to build expertise in full\-stack development, cloud\-native applications, and modern software engineering practices.**


In this role, you will work closely with senior developers and architects to build high\-quality backend services, responsive web applications, and scalable cloud solutions. You will participate in developing APIs, implementing user\-facing features, supporting deployment pipelines, and troubleshooting issues across the application stack.


You will also gain exposure to containerization, monitoring and observability, software security, and cloud technologies such as Microsoft Azure. We are looking for a motivated developer with a strong foundation in software development, a passion for learning, and a desire to grow into a well\-rounded full\-stack engineer.


**What you will do**
--------------------


* Develop and maintain frontend and backend components of web\-based applications.
* Implement user\-facing features using modern web technologies and integrate them with backend services and APIs.
* Contribute to building and maintaining backend services using C\# and .NET.
* Develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and business logic following software engineering best practices.
* Assist in developing responsive web interfaces using modern frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement intuitive and user\-friendly experiences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Participate in unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and code reviews.
* Manage source code using Git and follow established development workflows.
* Support cloud\-hosted solutions and gain experience configuring and managing Microsoft Azure environments.
* Assist with deployment activities and make changes to CI/CD pipeline configurations when required.
* Gain hands\-on experience with containerized application development using Docker and cloud\-native deployment practices.
* Support application monitoring and observability through metrics, logging, and tracing tools.
* Follow secure coding practices and contribute to application security and vulnerability remediation efforts.
* Collaborate closely with senior developers while continuously expanding technical skills across frontend, backend, cloud, and infrastructure domains.
**About You: Skills and Qualifications**
----------------------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience developing web applications through professional experience, internships, academic projects, or personal projects.
* Solid understanding of C\# and the .NET ecosystem.
* Basic knowledge of frontend development using JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one modern framework such as Angular or React.
* Understanding of HTML, CSS, and modern web development principles.
* Familiarity with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
* Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP fundamentals, and web services development.
* Experience using Git and common source code management workflows.
* Knowledge of software testing principles and experience writing unit tests.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow within a development team.

### **Preferred**


* Experience with Microsoft Azure or other cloud computing platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker or container\-based development workflows.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.).
* Exposure to monitoring and observability tools.
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts and authentication mechanisms.
* Knowledge of software security principles and secure coding practices.

### **Advantageous**


* Experience with microservices architectures and cloud\-native application development.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or application orchestration platforms.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts and vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, automation, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience working with logging, metrics, tracing, and application performance monitoring solutions.
* Interest in continuous improvement, modern engineering practices, and emerging technologies.
**Your Benefits**
-----------------


**An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life. ExxonMobil Hungary offers a variety of benefits to support and protect your health and financial wellbeing.**

  

From Day 1:


* Premium\+: Annual bonus to recognize active service with ExxonMobil on top of your competitive pay
* Private Health insurance and Employee assistance Program
* Life insurance
* Opportunities to enhance communication and language skills, job specific and broader trainings, mentoring, self\-development opportunities, tuition assistance program supporting studies with business relevance
* Wellness programs with a wide range of activities including ergo breaks, ergonomics support, office yoga, massage and much more!
  

With Continued employment:


* Voluntary Pension Fund (after 3 months of employment)
* Cafeteria (after 3 months of employment)
* Service Awards (at key service anniversary milestones)
  

**Please note benefits may be changed from time to time without notice, subject to applicable law.**


**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------


Learn more at our **website**
  

Follow us on**LinkedIN**
  

Like us on**Facebook** **\&** **Youtube**


**ExxonMobil is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.**

**Job Description**  

We are currently seeking qualified candidates for a key consultant role to support a Health Information Exchange (HIE) project in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.  

**Job Description:** Senior Technical \& Business Consultant – FHIR, NPHIES \& HIE  

**Position Title:** Senior Technical \& Business Consultant – FHIR \& NPHIES  

**Contract Duration:** 4\-Month Fixed\-Term Contract (Onsite, KSA) (Possibility of contract extension through end of 2027\)  

**Location:** Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Onsite)  

Required Experience: 8–10 Years (Minimum 5 years in HealthTech)  

Language Requirements: English (Fluent) \& Arabic (Mandatory)  

**Role Overview**  

The Technical Consultant will serve as a strategic advisor and technical expert supporting the client’s initiatives within the NPHIES ecosystem. This role demands a deep understanding of healthcare interoperability standards, particularly FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources), and the broader Saudi healthcare landscape, including payer\-provider systems, financial health services, and digital transformation goals. The consultant will work closely with cross\-functional teams technical, business, and delivery to ensure successful implementation, integration, and optimization of healthcare solutions aligned with NPHIES standards and regulatory frameworks. The role requires a unique blend of strong business acumen and solid technical expertise. The successful candidate will be involved in a variety of activities, including validating the business requirements of new releases, reviewing technical architecture and data structures, and overseeing the alignment of technical and business operations within the system. knowledge in Revenue Cycle \& Payors is required.  

Key Responsibilities  

Domain Expertise \& Advisory: Provide expert guidance on FHIR standards, HL7 protocols, and healthcare interoperability. Advise on best practices for integrating NPHIES requirements into existing healthcare systems. Stay current with regulatory updates and digital health trends in Saudi Arabia.  

Client Engagement \& Needs Assessment: Collaborate with client stakeholders to understand strategic goals, operational challenges, and technical requirements. Conduct gap analysis and recommend tailored solutions for interoperability, data exchange, and financial workflows.  

Solution Architecture \& Integration: Design and review system architectures that support FHIR\-based data exchange and NPHIES compliance. Recommend integration strategies for HIS, HIE, payer systems, and provider platforms. Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to streamline healthcare operations, reduce costs, and improve data accuracy and accessibility. Support automation and digitalization of financial health services with a focus on Revenue Cycle \& Payors.  

 Technology Enablement: Recommend tools, platforms, and technologies that support scalable and secure healthcare data management. Support adoption of cloud\-based solutions, APIs, and microservices architectures.  

Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, QA, and Delivery teams to ensure functional alignment and successful rollout. Participate in solution reviews, testing, and validation of new functionalities and release software updates.  

Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a trusted SME for NPHIES\-related initiatives, providing insights and training to internal and client teams. Support documentation, workshops, and knowledge transfer sessions.  

Required Skills \& Qualifications Education: BSc. Degree in Software Engineering, MIS, or Computer Science.  

Total \& Industry Experience: 8–10 years experienced, with solid technical background in SQL, HL7, and healthcare.  

Minimum 5 years’ experience in Health Tech industry.  

Healthcare IT: Proven experience in healthcare IT systems (HIE, HIS, payer\-provider platforms).  

Interoperability Standards: Strong understanding of FHIR, HL7, and healthcare interoperability frameworks.  

Technical Stack \& Architecture: Strong background in software development (.NET, Java, backend/frontend technologies) and SQL. Experience with solution architecture, system integration, and enterprise platforms.  

Domain knowledge: Requires knowledge in Revenue Cycle \& Payors. Familiarity with NPHIES platform, standards, and operational models is a significant advantage.  

Project \& Business Analysis: Solid experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, documentation, project management, and delivery oversight capabilities.  

Client Skills \& Languages: Excellent client\-facing and stakeholder communication skills.  

Fluency in English; Arabic is mandatory.

Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.


By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

  

**Overview Of The Role:**  

* The Commercial Vehicles Sales Representative for the HINO Trucks Division is responsible for driving sales growth by actively seeking and engaging with prospective customers. This role focuses on achieving sales targets, maximizing profitability, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through effective relationship management and consultative selling practices. Success in this position requires strong product knowledge, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**What You Will Do:**

* Achieve and exceed monthly and annual sales targets while maximizing profitability by focusing on net sales and gross margin earnings.

#### **Customer Engagement**

  

* Contact prospective customers and manage assigned accounts within the designated territory.
* Conduct regular customer and field visits to assess business requirements, ensure satisfaction, and maintain long\-term relationships.
* Qualify customers by understanding their requirements and interests and matching them to appropriate models.

#### **Product Demonstration**

  

* Demonstrate trucks by explaining characteristics, capabilities, and features, offering test drives, and explaining warranties and services.

#### **Administrative Responsibilities**

  

* Write sales orders, secure deposits, and process paperwork in line with established business policies.
* Provide sales management with information by completing reports.
* Ensure that monthly overdue payments are within the agreed target.

#### **Professional Development**

  

* Attend all sales meetings, modular training sessions, and refresher courses to stay informed about new products.
* Communicate with the Sales Manager or Branch Manager regarding any additional training requirements.

  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  

* Strong PC skills, including proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office.
* Excellent customer service and strong communication skills.
* Solid time management and analytical skills.
* Goal\-oriented self\-starter with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced work environment.

  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  

* 3\+ years of experience in a Commercial Vehicle sales role at a dealership.
* Mandatory experience in light, medium, and heavy\-duty truck sales in UAE.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**About FACS**


At FACS, our mission is to make environments safer and healthier for the people who live and work in them. As one of the nation's leading environmental health consulting firms, we help organizations protect their people, assets, and communities. We are built on purpose, partnership, and performance, delivering measurable impact with every client engagement.

**Our Values**


We live our mission through three core values:

* **People First:** Support our team and clients, promote professional growth, and value collaboration.
* **Integrity of the Science:** Deliver accurate, reliable results through objective, evidence\-based practices.
* **Client Relationships for Life:** Build long\-term partnerships and help clients address environmental health challenges.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact:** Contribute meaningful work that empowers teams and drives results across the organization.
* **Culture:** Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission\-driven environment where your work matters.
* **Growth:** Innovate, develop your skills, and help shape the future of how we operate and deliver on our mission.
* **Visibility:** Partner directly with leadership and cross\-functional teams to make a real difference.


Ranked "Best Places to Work" for five consecutive years, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and support for professional certifications—so you can grow, thrive, and build a career with lasting impact.

*Curious to see what we do? Meet our team at* FACS Experts.


**About the Role:**


The Environmental Health Specialist will support public health and well\-being by conducting fieldwork and environmental assessments for a variety of environmental health and industrial hygiene projects. Under the direction of Project Managers, you will support projects involving asbestos, lead, mold and moisture, indoor environmental quality, air and exposure sampling, and other environmental health concerns.


This is a field\-based role that requires regular travel to local client sites and occasional travel outside the local area, depending on project needs. You will collect samples and field data, document site conditions, prepare accurate field notes, and communicate project updates to Project Managers.


This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on work, takes pride in accuracy and professionalism, and is eager to develop technical experience in environmental health and industrial hygiene. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong attention to detail, reliability, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to learn beyond their current comfort zone.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform assigned fieldwork and project tasks under the direction of Project Managers.
* Travel regularly to local client sites and occasionally to out\-of\-area locations based on project needs.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Golden State Water Company is one of the largest investor\-owned water utilities in the United States. We deliver quality, reliable water to more than 1 million people in over 80 communities throughout California. Golden State Water has been in business for more than 90 years because we put customers first.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* The Senior Environmental Specialist is a supervisory position that functions as a highly experienced professional specialist responsible for coordinating and directing the Company’s environmental compliance programs. These programs include but are not limited to compliance with National Pollution Discharge Elimination System, California Environmental Quality Act, air quality and hazardous material regulations.
* This position is also responsible for the supervision, development and performance management of the Environmental Specialist.
* This position is responsible for monitoring federal, state and local environmental regulations and legislation, and assisting the General Office, Regions and Districts in compliance with these regulations.
* This position will provide support to the Regions and Districts in preparing technical documents, reports and studies.
* Interprets and recommends actions to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations. Supports Regions and Districts in compliance activities.
* Oversees any needed Company research activities related to environmental issues. Prepares and implements studies to improve overall environmental quality control. Prepares technical reports and documents to support the Company’s operations including environmental business and functional plans including proposed budgets.
* Analyze proposed legislation, environmental impact reports, environmental documents and environmental regulations that may impact the Company. Consults with internal and external contacts to provide technical expertise and information needed to effectively guide and enable others to comply with applicable policies, rules, regulations and laws.
* Develops and supervises the training and other communications programs for employees to ensure that relevant information and procedures related to environmental health risks are effectively disseminated to management, supervisors, and all other employees. Prepare responses and reports that reflect the best interests of the Company and its customers.
* Initiates, coordinates and participates in environmental audits. Prepares environmental assessments of Company property. Recommend actions to reduce potential environmental hazards.
* Oversees and monitors the maintenance of relevant documentation to ensure accurate and timely record\-keeping for proactive management purposes and to meet regulatory guidelines for documentation and reporting.
* Serve as Company’s representative on environmental committees, both internally and externally.
* Prepare environmental policies, procedures and guidelines to ensure compliance with applicable regulations.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
**MINIMUM POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or other related sciences or related field.
* Five years environmental engineering, regulations and operations experience with demonstrated increasing responsibilities performing highly complex work desired.

Provisional appointments may not exceed three (3\) years.


Becoming a City employee means being a part of a team that cares about making a difference. Your work will shape both the present and future of San Francisco. When you work for the City, you’re choosing a job with purpose.


San Francisco Public Works (Public Works) has a far\-reaching portfolio with a $453 million annual operating budget, an active capital portfolio that exceeds $3 billion and a workforce of 1,700\-plus employees. The department operates around the clock, touching every neighborhood in San Francisco. The staff designs and manages the construction of civic buildings and streets; cleans and greens the right of way; maintains civic buildings; manages multi\-million\-dollar bond programs; trains people for jobs; keeps the right of way free of hazards; paves the roads; repairs bridges and public stairways; expands accessibility; and works at the forefront addressing some of San Francisco’s biggest challenges. With a mission to enhance the quality of life in San Francisco for residents, visitors and business owners, Public Works is committed to providing outstanding public service through an equity lens.


Please visit the “About Us” section of our website at https://www.sfpublicworks.org to learn more about the department’s core values, Racial Equity Initiative, leadership team, history, budget and more.

 **Job Description**  

San Francisco Public Works is seeking a Principal Environmental Specialist at the Project Design and Development division.


Under general direction, the Principal Environmental Specialist manages environmental programs and projects within a defined area of specialty, such as clean air, energy conservation, public outreach, environmental impacts of project construction, NEPA/CEQA compliance, recycling, or toxics and pollution reduction. This position is responsible for planning, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating environmental initiatives and ordinances which include program oversight, staff supervision, budget administration, regulatory interpretation, public communication, and support for policy development and implementation.

**IMPORTANT AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**


Your duties as Principal Environmental Specialist may include, but are not limited to the following:

* Managing complex environmental programs by developing goals, policies, strategic plans, and standard of protocol/procedures
* Supervising and assigning work to program staff
* Interpreting and applying relevant environmental laws and regulations
* Preparing budgets, monitoring expenditures to ensure adherence to the approved budget, and securing grant funding
* Supporting the administration of funding and contracting processes, including oversight of grant disbursements and consultant agreements
* Making public presentations, conducting outreach, preparing written communications, and fostering positive partnerships with community groups, nonprofit organizations, commissions and other private and public agencies
* Drafting environmental documentation, contributing to technical policy updates, coordinating permitting with regulatory agencies
* Developing environmental specifications and managing departmental environmental compliance information tracking system

  

**Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university

**AND**

**Experience:** Eight (8\) years of professional experience leading, developing, and implementing environmental programs or policies

**Substitution:**

* Additional experience as described above may substitute for the required degree on a year\-for\-year basis. Thirty (30\) semester units or forty\-five (45\) quarter units equal one year
* Possession of a Master’s degree in public administration, environmental science, environmental health, public policy, public health, or a related field may substitute for one (1\) year of experience
* Possession of a Ph.D. in public administration, environmental science, environmental health, public policy, public health, or a related field may substitute for two (2\) years of experience

**Note**  

One (1\) year of full\-time employment is considered equivalent to Two Thousand (2,000\) hours. Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40\) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full\-time employment.

**Minimum Qualification Supplemental Questionnaire (MQSQ)**  

Candidates may be required to complete an MQSQ as part of the employment application. This MQSQ is designed to obtain specific information regarding an applicant's experience in relation to the Minimum Qualifications (MQ) for this position. The MQSQ will be used to evaluate if the applicant possesses the required minimum qualifications.

**Verification**


All work experience, education, training, and other information substantiating how you meet the minimum qualifications must be included on your application by the filing deadline. Information submitted after the filing deadline will not be considered in determining whether you meet the minimum qualifications.


Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process. More information can be found at: https://sfdhr.org/info

### **Job Description and Duties**


Are you looking to be a part of a dynamic team of conservation\-minded scientists working to protect fish and wildlife resources in the coniferous forests of the Sierra Nevada (covering counties: Plumas, Butte, Sierra, Yuba, Nevada, Placer, El Dorado, Alpine, Amador and Calaveras), or the Coastal Mountain Range in Lake County?


The Department of Fish and Wildlife's Timberland Conservation and Fire Resiliency Program is seeking a motivated professional to work as an Environmental Scientist reviewing and evaluating Timber Harvest Plans,Timber Emergencies and Exemptions, and Vegetation Management Plans. This position also works in close collaboration with other Environmental Scientists and Senior Environmental Scientists, and with other state agencies as part of an interdisciplinary review team and may act as the staff lead and may provide consultative advice when working with applicants, local, state and federal agencies, stakeholders, and the general public.

The incumbent represents the Region and may act as the staff lead and provide consultative advice when working with applicants, local, state, and federal agencies, stakeholders, and the general public. ABOUT THE POSITION A list of eligible candidates will be established to fill current and future vacancies throughout Riverside County. The recruitment will remain open until filled. The County of Riverside Environmental Health Department is currently recruiting for multiple Environmental Health Specialists: Environmental Health Specialist I $63,546.87 - $98,363.36 Annually Environmental Health Specialist II $74,560.72 - $102,297.52 Annually Environmental Health Specialist III $ 78,625.04 - $112,019.44 Annually Selected candidates will be assigned to offices located in Riverside, Corona, Murrieta, Hemet and the Coachella Valley (Palm Springs and Indio). Incumbents will conduct specialized studies, inspections and investigations involved with the planning and enforcement of complex environmental health laws and regulations. Candidates selected can also expect to provide electronic reports on inspections. Divisions may include District Environmental Services, Hazardous Materials, Land Use/Water Resources, and Local Enforcement Agency. To Qualify: Candidates for the Environmental Health Specialist position are required to possess the following (further details are listed under the Minimum Qualification section below). A valid Letter of Eligibility issued by the California Department of Public Health certifying qualification as an Environmental Health Specialist Trainee OR a valid certificate of registration as an Environmental Health Specialist issued by the California Department of Public Health (please attach to your application). Work Schedule: This position requires office or field work with either a 5/40, 9/80 or 4/10 schedule. A 5/40 schedule offers five days a week. With a 9/80 schedule, you'll work nine-hour days for nine days over two weeks, with one day off every other week. And, a 4/10 schedule offering four days at ten-hours with three-day weekends. The Environmental Health Specialist I is a natural progression to Environmental Health Specialist II, which in turn leads to Environmental Health Specialist III. To advance, employees need a satisfactory performance evaluation, meet experience and educational requirements, and pass the state-administered Registered Environmental Health Specialist (REHS) exam. If these criteria aren't met within 36 months, employees may return to their previous County position or be released before the end of their probationary period. Meet The Team: The Riverside County Department of Environmental Health is a multifaceted department dedicated to protecting the health of people and the environment in Riverside County. Their mission, "to enhance the quality of life in Riverside County," is accomplished through a dedicated staff of professionals including licensed and/or certified inspectors overseeing and enforcing numerous programs, from food facility inspections to hazardous waste designed to protect both the public and the environment. EXAMPLES OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES Conduct specialized, technical field inspections and investigations to determine compliance with relevant environmental health laws and regulations. Gather or lead in the gathering of evidence of violations and non-compliance with environmental health laws and regulations. Prepare inspection reports, legal notices, citations, notices of violations, and other investigative reports for the enforcement of environmental health laws and regulations. Issue official notices of corrective action and abatement; make follow-up investigations to ensure compliance. Act as a department liaison with various state, federal, and local agencies and partners. May serve in a lead capacity and provide assistance and technical guidance to entry or intermediate Environmental Health Specialists. Attend training sessions and participate in the development and implementation of staff training programs. Prepare reports and evidence for presentation at Administrative Hearings and to present cases to the court on behalf of the County. DISTRICT ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES In Addition To The General Essential Duties Listed Above: Conduct regulatory inspections and investigations of retail food facilities, public pools and spas, mobile home parks, organized camps, tobacco retailers, and related facilities as required. Review and investigate public complaints of foodborne illness, recreational water illness, unpermitted food sales, drownings, mobile home parks, tobacco, and household trash and sewage issues. Collect food, water and/or sewage, and related samples for laboratory analysis. Instruct facility operators on health and safety methods and principles. Apply enforcement techniques as needed to gain compliance. Coordinate with other agencies to facilitate compliance on investigations as listed above. HAZARDOUS MATERIALS In Addition To The General Essential Duties Listed Above: Conduct moderate to complex inspections and investigations of all types of hazardous waste and hazardous materials facilities including underground storage tank systems to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations pertaining to waste storage, treatment, handling, transportation, disposal, and record-keeping. Perform hazardous materials mitigation or categorization evaluations in the field. Oversee the mitigation of hazardous substance releases during emergency or disaster situations under the authority of the Public Health Officer; assist in field supervision of hazardous waste clean-up operations. Handle detection and safety equipment and ensure that sufficient inventories of up-to-date equipment are available for use/deployment on a regular basis, and in the event of emergency responses. Prepare and maintain records of inspections and investigations. Make joint inspections with federal, state, and local agencies as required. May participate as part of the County Hazardous Materials 24-hour Emergency Response Team. LAND USE/WATER RESOURCES In Addition To The General Essential Duties Listed Above: Conduct moderate to complex compliance inspections and investigations of private drinking water wells and small water systems. Review plans submitted for the construction of on-site sewage disposal systems, water wells and small water systems. Assess the quality of drinking water in designated regions. LOCAL ENFORCEMENT AGENCY In Addition To The General Essential Duties Listed Above: Conduct routine compliance inspections and investigations of facilities and individuals performing tattooing, body piercing, and permanent make-up. Conduct routine investigations of complaints concerning improper disposal of garbage, rubbish, sewage, and other unsanitary conditions on private and public property. Conduct periodic inspections and complaint investigations of solid waste, liquid waste, and medical waste handling facilities and businesses. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS ALL LEVELS Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, which included coursework that enables the applicant to meet the Registered Environmental Health Specialist minimum educational standards prescribed by the California Department of Public Health. ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH SPECIALIST I $63,546.87 - $98,363.36 Annually To learn more about the Environmental Health Specialist I classification - click here . License/Certificate: Possession of a valid Letter of Eligibility issued by the California Department of Public Health certifying qualification as an Environmental Health Specialist Trainee. The letter must be issued within the last 30 months to be considered valid. Visit the California Department of Public Health to learn more about obtaining a Letter of Eligibility. __________________________________________________________________________ ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH SPECIALIST II $74,560.72 - $102,297.52 Annually To learn more about the Environmental Health Specialist II Classification click here . License/Certificate: Possession of a valid certificate of registration as an Environmental Health Specialist issued by the California Department of Public Health. __________________________________________________________________________ ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH SPECIALIST III $ 78,625.04 - $112,019.44 Annually To learn more about the Environmental Health Specialist III - click here . Experience: One year of experience equivalent to an Environmental Health Specialist II with the County of Riverside. AND License/Certificate: Possession of a valid certificate of registration as an Environmental Health Specialist issued by the California Department of Public Health. __________________________________________________________________________ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS (All Levels): License/Certificate: Possession of a valid California Driver's License Physical Requirements: Independent body mobility to stand, climb stairs and ladders, walk on uneven ground or wet, slippery floors at construction sites, retail food, public pools, mobile home parks, composting facilities, landfills and large excavated areas, manufacturing plants, and hazardous materials handling/storing facilities; upper body strength to reach and move items from high shelves; manual dexterity to hand-write and use personal computers; corrected vision to read standard text, labels, color change indication test papers, monitoring equipment display screens, and computer screens. Additional Physical Requirements for incumbents assigned to the Hazardous Materials Program: Strength to move 55-gallon drums of materials (with drum dolly); strength to lift and carry tools or personal protection and test equipment up to 25 pounds in weight; physical capability to wear personal protective equipment including Level A, B, C and D suits and cartridge respirator; ability to lift materials weighing up to 70 pounds.
